(* Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
   bigops.bigop_I_gen: equality between a shifted finite product and the
   corresponding lower-bound-filtered finite product. This file contains
   no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool.

Fixpoint bigop {H : Type}
    (n : nat) (p : nat -> bool) (nil : H)
    (op : H -> H -> H) (f : nat -> H) : H :=
  match n with
  | O => nil
  | S k =>
      if p k
      then op (f k) (bigop k p nil op f)

Theorem bigops_bigop_I_gen :

      (fun i => p (Nat.add i a))
      1 Nat.mul
      (fun i => f (Nat.add i a)) =
    bigop b
      (fun i => andb (Nat.leb a i) (p i))
      1 Nat.mul
      (fun i => f i).

    (count environment offset)

      1
    (let* ((index (- count 1))
           (source-index (+ index offset))
           (rest
            (logipedia-bigops-igen-shifted-product
             index environment offset)))
      (if (logipedia-bigops-igen-predicate
           environment source-index)
          (*

    (bound environment lower-bound)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix bound)))

      1

            (logipedia-bigops-igen-filtered-product

           (<= lower-bound index)
           (logipedia-bigops-igen-predicate environment index))
          (*

    (environment bound)

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact bigops.bigop_I_gen
-- (catalog title "bigops.bigop_I_gen"): reindexing a Boolean-filtered product
-- of natural numbers from an interval to offsets from its lower bound.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module bigop_I_gen where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _≤_
infixr 6 _and_

data _≤_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} -> zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} -> m ≤ n -> suc m ≤ suc n

_and_ : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
true and q = q
false and q = false

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

bigop :
  {H : Set} ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Bool) ->
  H ->
  (H -> H -> H) ->
  (Nat -> H) ->
  H
bigop zero p nil op f = nil
bigop (suc n) p nil op f with p n
... | true = op (f n) (bigop n p nil op f)
... | false = bigop n p nil op f

bigop-I-gen : Set
bigop-I-gen =
  (a b : Nat) ->
  (p : Nat -> Bool) ->
  (f : Nat -> Nat) ->
  a ≤ b ->
  bigop
    (b - a)
    (\ i -> p (i + a))
    1
    _*_
    (\ i -> f (i + a))
  ≡
  bigop
    b
    (\ i -> leb a i and p i)
    1
    _*_
    f

% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia artifact bigops.bigop_I_gen:
% shifting the lower endpoint of a predicate-filtered natural-number product
% is equivalent to filtering the original prefix product. This file contains no proof.

bigops_bigop_I_gen: THEORY
BEGIN
  bigop_nat(
      count: nat,
      predicate: [nat -> bool],
      value: [nat -> nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF predicate(count - 1) THEN
      value(count - 1)
        * bigop_nat(count - 1, predicate, value)
    ELSE
      bigop_nat(count - 1, predicate, value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  bigop_I_gen: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: nat), (p: [nat -> bool]), (f: [nat -> nat]):
      a <= b IMPLIES
        bigop_nat(
          b - a,
          (LAMBDA (i: nat): p(i + a)),
          (LAMBDA (i: nat): f(i + a)))
        =
        bigop_nat(
          b,
          (LAMBDA (i: nat): a <= i AND p(i)),
          (LAMBDA (i: nat): f(i)))
END bigops_bigop_I_gen

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; bigops.bigop_Strue, catalog title "bigops.bigop_Strue": when the
;; Boolean selector at a natural index is true, the successor-bounded
;; polymorphic big operation prepends that index's value.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; At each bound k, the source proposition observes only the prefixes through
;; k and the finitely many operation calls made by the fold.  These finite
;; traces are complete for the proposition: total source functions restrict
;; to them, and each trace extends to total functions by the defaults below.

(defun logipedia-bigops-strue-bool-list-p (values)
  (if (endp values)
      (equal values nil)
    (and
     (booleanp (car values))
     (logipedia-bigops-strue-bool-list-p (cdr values)))))

(defun logipedia-bigops-strue-operation-at
    (operation-table nil-value left right)
  (let ((entry (assoc-equal (list left right) operation-table)))
    (if entry
        (cdr entry)
      nil-value)))

(defun logipedia-bigops-strue-bigop
    (index predicate-prefix nil-value operation-table sequence-prefix)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (zp index)
      nil-value
    (let* ((prior-index (- index 1))
           (rest
            (logipedia-bigops-strue-bigop
             prior-index
             predicate-prefix
             nil-value
             operation-table
             sequence-prefix)))
      (if (nth prior-index predicate-prefix)
          (logipedia-bigops-strue-operation-at
           operation-table
           nil-value
           (nth prior-index sequence-prefix)
           rest)
        rest))))

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-bigop-strue-statement ()
  (forall
   (k predicate-prefix nil-value operation-table sequence-prefix)
   (implies
    (and
     (natp k)
     (logipedia-bigops-strue-bool-list-p predicate-prefix)
     (true-listp sequence-prefix)
     (alistp operation-table)
     (< k (len predicate-prefix))
     (< k (len sequence-prefix))
     (equal (nth k predicate-prefix) t))
    (equal
     (logipedia-bigops-strue-bigop
      (+ 1 k)
      predicate-prefix
      nil-value
      operation-table
      sequence-prefix)
     (logipedia-bigops-strue-operation-at
      operation-table
      nil-value
      (nth k sequence-prefix)
      (logipedia-bigops-strue-bigop
       k
       predicate-prefix
       nil-value
       operation-table
       sequence-prefix))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

BEGIN

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact "bigops.bigop_iso"
-- (catalog title "bigops.bigop_iso"): invariance of a Boolean-filtered finite
-- product of natural numbers under a value-preserving isomorphism of its selected
-- prefix indices. This file contains no proof.

namespace bigops

def bigop (H : Type) :
    Nat -> (Nat -> Bool) -> H -> (H -> H -> H) -> (Nat -> H) -> H
  | 0, _p, nil, _op, _f => nil
  | n + 1, p, nil, op, f =>
      match p n with
      | true => op (f n) (bigop H n p nil op f)
      | false => bigop H n p nil op f

def sub_hk
    (h k : Nat -> Nat) (n1 n2 : Nat) (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool)
    (_f1 _f2 : Nat -> Nat) : Prop :=
  forall i : Nat, i < n1 -> p1 i = true ->
    (h i < n2 /\ p2 (h i) = true) /\ k (h i) = i

def iso
    (n1 n2 : Nat) (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool) (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat) : Prop :=
  exists h k : Nat -> Nat,
    ((forall i : Nat, i < n1 -> p1 i = true -> f1 i = f2 (h i)) /\
      sub_hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) /\
    sub_hk k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1

theorem bigop_iso
    (n1 n2 : Nat) (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool) (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat)
    (hiso : iso n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) :
    bigop Nat n1 p1 1 Nat.mul f1 = bigop Nat n2 p2 1 Nat.mul f2 := sorry

end bigops

;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; bigops.bigop_iso, catalog title "bigops.bigop_iso": isomorphic
;; Boolean-selected families of natural numbers have equal finite products.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source proposition observes p1 and f1 only below n1, and p2 and f2
;; only below n2. Exact typed prefixes record precisely those observations:
;; each source function restricts to such a prefix, and each prefix extends
;; to a total function by using nil or 0 outside it.

(defun logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-bool-list-p (values)
  (if (endp values)
      (equal values nil)
    (and (booleanp (car values))
         (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-bool-list-p (cdr values)))))

(defun logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-nat-list-p (values)
  (if (endp values)
      (equal values nil)
    (and (natp (car values))
         (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-nat-list-p (cdr values)))))

;; This combines the source value-agreement clause with sub_hk in the
;; n1-to-n2 direction. Every selected source index maps to a selected target
;; index, its value is preserved, and the reverse prefix maps it back.

(defun logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-forward-p
    (count n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      t
    (let* ((index (- count 1))
           (image (nth index h)))
      (and
       (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-forward-p
        index n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k)
       (or
        (not (equal (nth index p1) t))
        (and
         (< image n2)
         (equal (nth image p2) t)
         (equal (nth index f1) (nth image f2))
         (equal (nth image k) index)))))))

;; This is the reverse sub_hk clause. It does not impose another value
;; equation, matching the asymmetric value-agreement clause in source iso.

(defun logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-reverse-p
    (count n1 p2 p1 k h)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      t
    (let* ((index (- count 1))
           (image (nth index k)))
      (and
       (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-reverse-p
        index n1 p2 p1 k h)
       (or
        (not (equal (nth index p2) t))
        (and
         (< image n1)
         (equal (nth image p1) t)
         (equal (nth image h) index)))))))

;; The source existentially quantifies total natural-valued h and k. Since h
;; is observed only below n1 and k only below n2, exact natural prefixes of
;; those lengths are bidirectionally equivalent witnesses and keep them
;; internal to the definition of iso.

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-isomorphic-p
    (n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2)
  (exists (h k)
    (and
     (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-nat-list-p h)
     (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-nat-list-p k)
     (equal (len h) n1)
     (equal (len k) n2)
     (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-forward-p
      n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k)
     (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-reverse-p
      n2 n1 p2 p1 k h))))

;; element 1. A bound count covers exactly the indices below count.

(defun logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-filtered-product
    (count predicate-prefix function-prefix)

  (if (zp count)
      1
    (let* ((index (- count 1))
           (rest
            (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-filtered-product
             index predicate-prefix function-prefix)))
      (if (equal (nth index predicate-prefix) t)
          (* (nth index function-prefix) rest)
        rest))))

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-statement ()
  (forall (n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n1)
      (natp n2)
      (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-bool-list-p p1)
      (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-bool-list-p p2)
      (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-nat-list-p f1)
      (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-nat-list-p f2)
      (equal (len p1) n1)
      (equal (len f1) n1)
      (equal (len p2) n2)
      (equal (len f2) n2)
      (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-isomorphic-p
       n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2))
     (equal
      (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-filtered-product n1 p1 f1)
      (logipedia-bigops-bigop-iso-filtered-product n2 p2 f2)))))

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact bigops.bigop_iso
-- (catalog title "bigops.bigop_iso"): invariance of a Boolean-filtered finite
-- product of natural numbers under an isomorphism of its selected indices.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module bigop_iso where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level)

infix 4 _<_
infixr 3 _∧_

data _<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<succ : {n : Nat} -> zero < suc n
  succ<succ : {m n : Nat} -> m < n -> suc m < suc n

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

bigop :
  {level : Level} ->
  {H : Set level} ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Bool) ->
  H ->
  (H -> H -> H) ->
  (Nat -> H) ->
  H
bigop zero p nil op f = nil
bigop (suc n) p nil op f with p n
... | true = op (f n) (bigop n p nil op f)
... | false = bigop n p nil op f

sub-hk :
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Bool) ->
  (Nat -> Bool) ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
sub-hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 =
  (i : Nat) ->
  i < n1 ->
  p1 i ≡ true ->
  ((h i < n2) ∧ (p2 (h i) ≡ true)) ∧
  (k (h i) ≡ i)

iso :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Bool) ->
  (Nat -> Bool) ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
iso n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 =
  Σ (Nat -> Nat) (\ h ->
    Σ (Nat -> Nat) (\ k ->
      (((i : Nat) ->
          i < n1 ->
          p1 i ≡ true ->
          f1 i ≡ f2 (h i))
       ∧ sub-hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2)
      ∧ sub-hk k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1))

bigop-iso : Set
bigop-iso =
  (n1 n2 : Nat) ->
  (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool) ->
  (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat) ->
  iso n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 ->
  bigop n1 p1 1 _*_ f1 ≡
  bigop n2 p2 1 _*_ f2

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
  bigops.bigop_iso, catalog title "bigops.bigop_iso": Boolean-filtered finite
  products of natural numbers are invariant under the source's isomorphism of
  selected indices. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory;

val logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop_def = Define `
  (logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop 0 (p : num -> bool) (f : num -> num) = 1) /\
  (logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop (SUC n) p f =
    if p n then
      f n * logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop n p f
    else
      logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop n p f)
`;

val logipedia_bigops_sub_hk_def = Define `
  logipedia_bigops_sub_hk
    (h : num -> num)
    (k : num -> num)
    (n1 : num)
    (n2 : num)
    (p1 : num -> bool)
    (p2 : num -> bool)
    (f1 : num -> num)
    (f2 : num -> num) <=>
  !i : num.
    i < n1
    ==>
    p1 i = T
    ==>
    (h i < n2 /\ p2 (h i) = T) /\ k (h i) = i
`;

val logipedia_bigops_iso_def = Define `
  logipedia_bigops_iso
    (n1 : num)
    (n2 : num)
    (p1 : num -> bool)
    (p2 : num -> bool)
    (f1 : num -> num)
    (f2 : num -> num) <=>
  ?h k : num -> num.
    ((!i : num.
        i < n1
        ==>
        p1 i = T
        ==>
        f1 i = f2 (h i)) /\
      logipedia_bigops_sub_hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) /\
    logipedia_bigops_sub_hk k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1
`;

val bigops_bigop_iso =
  ``!n1 n2 : num.
      !(p1 : num -> bool) (p2 : num -> bool).
      !(f1 : num -> num) (f2 : num -> num).
        logipedia_bigops_iso n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2
        ==>
        logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop n1 p1 f1 =
        logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop n2 p2 f2``;

                            /\

                                (

                            (

    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    RVSUM_1, MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n1,n2 being Nat,
      p1,p2 being Function of NAT,BOOLEAN,
      f1,f2 being Function of NAT,NAT st
    ex h,k being Function of NAT,NAT st
      (for i being Nat st i < n1 & p1.i = TRUE holds
        f1.i = f2.(h.i) &
        h.i < n2 &
        p2.(h.i) = TRUE &
        k.(h.i) = i) &
      (for j being Nat st j < n2 & p2.j = TRUE holds
        k.j < n1 &
        p1.(k.j) = TRUE &
        h.(k.j) = j)
  holds

      len left = n1 &
      (for r being Nat st r in dom left holds

        (p1.(r-'1) = FALSE implies left.r = 1)) &

        (p2.(r-'1) = TRUE implies right.r = f2.(r-'1)) &
        (p2.(r-'1) = FALSE implies right.r = 1)) &
      Product left = Product right
proof
end;
::$P+

title: bigop_iso
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia artifact bigops.bigop_iso:
% predicate-filtered finite products of natural numbers are equal under an
% isomorphism of their selected indices and values. This file contains no proof.

bigops_bigop_iso: THEORY
BEGIN
  bigop_nat(
      count: nat,
      predicate: [nat -> bool],
      value: [nat -> nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF predicate(count - 1) THEN
      value(count - 1)
        * bigop_nat(count - 1, predicate, value)
    ELSE
      bigop_nat(count - 1, predicate, value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sub_hk(
      h, k: [nat -> nat],
      n1, n2: nat,
      p1, p2: [nat -> bool],
      f1, f2: [nat -> nat]): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i < n1 IMPLIES
        p1(i) = TRUE IMPLIES
          (h(i) < n2 AND p2(h(i)) = TRUE)
            AND k(h(i)) = i

  iso(
      n1, n2: nat,
      p1, p2: [nat -> bool],
      f1, f2: [nat -> nat]): bool =
    EXISTS (h, k: [nat -> nat]):
      ((FORALL (i: nat):
          i < n1 IMPLIES
            p1(i) = TRUE IMPLIES
              f1(i) = f2(h(i)))
        AND sub_hk(h, k, n1, n2, p1, p2, f1, f2))
      AND sub_hk(k, h, n2, n1, p2, p1, f2, f1)

  bigop_iso: bool =
    FORALL (n1, n2: nat),
        (p1, p2: [nat -> bool]),
        (f1, f2: [nat -> nat]):
      iso(n1, n2, p1, p2, f1, f2) IMPLIES
        bigop_nat(n1, p1, f1) = bigop_nat(n2, p2, f2)
END bigops_bigop_iso

val _ = new_constant (

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
  bigops.eq_bigop_S: for every carrier type and natural number n, the
  polymorphic bigop operator at the successor of n is Leibniz equal to its
  body operator as a curried function of Boolean predicates, identities,
  binary operations, and sequences. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The carrier h and index n remain arbitrary. The two class expressions
  represent the source terms bigop h (S n) and bigop_body h (S n). Their
  common type is encoded by full SetMM function spaces, with {0,1} as the
  Boolean carrier:

    (NN0 -> Bool) -> h -> (h -> h -> h) -> (NN0 -> h) -> h.

  A predicate on this function type is represented extensionally by a subset
  p. The bounded universal implication is therefore the source definition of
  Leibniz equality: every predicate holding of bigop h (S n) also holds of
  bigop_body h (S n). The final declaration is an unproved $a statement
  encoding; this corpus file adds no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c LogBigopSucc LogBigopBodySucc LogBigopSuccType $.

log-bigop-succ-syntax $a class ( LogBigopSucc h n ) $.
log-bigop-body-succ-syntax $a class ( LogBigopBodySucc h n ) $.
log-bigop-succ-type-syntax $a class ( LogBigopSuccType h ) $.

log-bigop-succ-type-definition $a |- ( LogBigopSuccType h ) =
  (
    (
      (
        ( h ^m ( h ^m NN0 ) )
        ^m
        ( ( h ^m h ) ^m h )
      )
      ^m
      h
    )
    ^m
    ( { 0 , 1 } ^m NN0 )
  )
$.

${
  $d h n p $.

  logipedia-bigops-eq-bigop-s $a |-
    A. h A. n e. NN0
      (
        (
          ( LogBigopSucc h n ) e. ( LogBigopSuccType h )
          /\
          ( LogBigopBodySucc h n ) e. ( LogBigopSuccType h )
        )
        /\
        A. p e. ~P ( LogBigopSuccType h )
          (
            ( LogBigopSucc h n ) e. p
            ->
            ( LogBigopBodySucc h n ) e. p
          )
      )
  $.
$}

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; bigops.eq_bigop_body_O, catalog title "bigops.eq_bigop_body_O": at natural
;; index zero, the polymorphic bigop body is Leibniz-equal to the four-argument
;; function that returns its nil argument. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Reified source types and applications expose the arbitrary carrier H,
;; p : nat -> bool, nil : H, op : H -> H -> H, and f : nat -> H.

(defstub logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-member-p (h-type value) t)
(defstub logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-p-at (p index) t)
(defstub logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-op-at (op left right) t)
(defstub logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-f-at (f index) t)

(defstub logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-generic-apply
  (h-type function-value p nil-value op f)
  t)

;; bigop_body H n is represented as a value at the complete source function
;; type (nat -> bool) -> H -> (H -> H -> H) -> (nat -> H) -> H.

(defstub logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-bigop-body (h-type index) t)

;; This concrete reified value is the source lambda
;; (fun p nil op f => nil).

(defun logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-constant-nil-function (h-type)
  (list 'logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-constant-nil-function h-type))

(defun logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-apply
    (h-type function-value p nil-value op f)
  (if
      (equal
       function-value
       (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-constant-nil-function h-type))
      nil-value
    (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-generic-apply
     h-type function-value p nil-value op f)))

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-nat-bool-function-p (p)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (booleanp
      (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-p-at p index)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-binary-operation-p (h-type op)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-member-p h-type left)
      (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-member-p h-type right))
     (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-member-p
      h-type
      (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-op-at op left right)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-nat-function-p (h-type f)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-member-p
      h-type
      (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-f-at f index)))))

(defun logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-arguments-p
    (h-type p nil-value op f)
  (and
   (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-nat-bool-function-p p)
   (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-member-p h-type nil-value)
   (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-binary-operation-p h-type op)
   (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-nat-function-p h-type f)))

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-function-value-p
    (h-type function-value)
  (forall (p nil-value op f)
    (implies
     (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-arguments-p
      h-type p nil-value op f)
     (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-member-p
      h-type
      (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-apply
       h-type function-value p nil-value op f)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-bigop-body-typed-p ()
  (forall (h-type index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-function-value-p
      h-type
      (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-bigop-body h-type index)))))

;; Equality of the reified function values is identity at the full source
;; function type, and hence represents the displayed Leibniz equality.

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-eq-bigop-body-o-leibniz-p ()
  (forall (h-type)
    (equal
     (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-bigop-body h-type 0)
     (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-constant-nil-function h-type))))

;; This pointwise clause explicitly exposes the source lambda binders. It is
;; definitionally entailed by the value equality above because APPLY returns
;; NIL-VALUE for the concrete constant-nil function tag.

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-eq-bigop-body-o-pointwise-p ()
  (forall (h-type p nil-value op f)
    (implies
     (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-arguments-p
      h-type p nil-value op f)
     (equal
      (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-apply
       h-type
       (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-bigop-body h-type 0)
       p
       nil-value
       op
       f)
      nil-value))))

(defun logipedia-bigops-eq-bigop-body-o-statement ()
  (implies
   (logipedia-bigops-eq-body-o-bigop-body-typed-p)
   (and
    (logipedia-bigops-eq-bigop-body-o-leibniz-p)
    (logipedia-bigops-eq-bigop-body-o-pointwise-p))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact "bigops.eq_bigop_body_S"
-- (catalog title "bigops.eq_bigop_body_S"): Leibniz equality identifies the
-- successor-indexed big-operation body with its Boolean-controlled recursive step.
-- This file contains no proof.

namespace bigops

def Leibniz (A : Type) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : A → Prop, P x → P y

-- itpeval-source-signature: logipedia:bigops.bigop as bigop
axiom bigop : (H : Type) → Nat → (Nat → Bool) → H → (H → H → H) → (Nat → H) → H

-- itpeval-source-signature: logipedia:bigops.bigop_body as bigop_body
axiom bigop_body : (H : Type) → Nat → (Nat → Bool) → H → (H → H → H) → (Nat → H) → H

theorem eq_bigop_body_S :
    ∀ (H : Type) (n : Nat),
      Leibniz ((Nat → Bool) → H → (H → H → H) → (Nat → H) → H)
        (bigop_body H (Nat.succ n))
        (fun (p : Nat → Bool) (nil : H) (op : H → H → H) (f : Nat → H) ↦
          match p n with
          | true => op (f n) (bigop H n p nil op f)
          | false => bigop H n p nil op f) := sorry

end bigops

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact bigops.eq_bigop_body_S
-- (catalog title "bigops.eq_bigop_body_S"): Leibniz equality at every
-- successor index between the generic big-operation body and its
-- Boolean-selected recursive step, for every carrier type. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module eq_bigop_body_S where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; suc)

Bigop :
  {level : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc level)
Bigop {level} =
  (H : Set level) ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Bool) ->
  H ->
  (H -> H -> H) ->
  (Nat -> H) ->
  H

Leibniz :
  {level : Level} ->
  (A : Set level) ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set (lsuc level)
Leibniz {level} A x y =
  (P : A -> Set level) ->
  P x ->
  P y

match-bool-type :
  {level : Level} ->
  {H : Set level} ->
  H ->
  H ->
  Bool ->
  H
match-bool-type case-true case-false true = case-true
match-bool-type case-true case-false false = case-false

module Statement
  {level : Level}
  (bigop bigop-body : Bigop {level}) where

  eq-bigop-body-S :
    Set (lsuc level)
  eq-bigop-body-S =
    (H : Set level) ->
    (n : Nat) ->
    Leibniz
      ((Nat -> Bool) -> H -> (H -> H -> H) -> (Nat -> H) -> H)
      (bigop-body H (suc n))
      (\ p nil op f ->
        match-bool-type
          (op (f n) (bigop H n p nil op f))
          (bigop H n p nil op f)
          (p n))

title: let_clause_10471
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact "bigops.let_clause_10471"
-- (catalog title "bigops.let_clause_10471"): a let-clause induction step relating
-- Boolean-filtered finite products through inverse index maps and concluding the
-- natural-number quotient-remainder decomposition. This file contains no proof.

namespace bigops

def bigop (H : Type) :
    Nat -> (Nat -> Bool) -> H -> (H -> H -> H) -> (Nat -> H) -> H
  | 0, _p, nil, _op, _f => nil
  | n + 1, p, nil, op, f =>
      match p n with
      | true => op (f n) (bigop H n p nil op f)
      | false => bigop H n p nil op f

def sub_hk
    (h k : Nat -> Nat) (n1 n2 : Nat) (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool)
    (_f1 _f2 : Nat -> Nat) : Prop :=
  forall i : Nat, i < n1 -> p1 i = true ->
    (h i < n2 /\ p2 (h i) = true) /\ k (h i) = i

def iso
    (n1 n2 : Nat) (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool) (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat) : Prop :=
  exists h k : Nat -> Nat,
    ((forall i : Nat, i < n1 -> p1 i = true -> f1 i = f2 (h i)) /\
      sub_hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) /\
    sub_hk k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1

theorem let_clause_10471
    (n1 n2 : Nat) (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool) (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat)
    (hiso : iso n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) :
    forall h : Nat -> Nat,
      (exists k : Nat -> Nat,
        (((forall i : Nat, i < n1 -> p1 i = true -> f1 i = f2 (h i)) /\
          sub_hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) /\
        sub_hk k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1)) ->
      forall k : Nat -> Nat,
        (((forall i : Nat, i < n1 -> p1 i = true -> f1 i = f2 (h i)) /\
          sub_hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) /\
        sub_hk k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1) ->
        ((forall i : Nat, i < n1 -> p1 i = true -> f1 i = f2 (h i)) /\
          sub_hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) ->
        (forall i : Nat, i < n1 -> p1 i = true -> f1 i = f2 (h i)) ->
        forall _i m : Nat,
          (forall f : Nat -> Bool,
            0 <= n1 ->
            sub_hk h k 0 m p1 f f1 f2 ->
            sub_hk k h m 0 f p1 f2 f1 ->
            bigop Nat 0 p1 1 Nat.mul f1 = bigop Nat m f 1 Nat.mul f2) ->
          forall p20 : Nat -> Bool,
            0 <= n1 ->
            sub_hk h k 0 (m + 1) p1 p20 f1 f2 ->
            sub_hk k h (m + 1) 0 p20 p1 f2 f1 ->
            forall x2571 x2572 : Nat,
              x2571 = x2572 * Nat.div x2571 x2572 + Nat.mod x2571 x2572 := sorry

end bigops

title: let_clause_10471
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
  bigops.let_clause_10471 (catalog title "bigops.let_clause_10471"):
  a let-clause proposition about an isomorphism of filtered finite products
  and the quotient-remainder identity on natural numbers. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool.

Fixpoint bigop {H : Type}
    (n : nat) (p : nat -> bool) (nil : H)
    (op : H -> H -> H) (f : nat -> H) : H :=
  match n with
  | O => nil
  | S k =>
      if p k
      then op (f k) (bigop k p nil op f)
      else bigop k p nil op f
  end.

Definition sub_hk
    (h k : nat -> nat) (n1 n2 : nat)
    (p1 p2 : nat -> bool) (f1 f2 : nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  forall i : nat,
    i < n1 ->
    p1 i = true ->
    (h i < n2 /\ p2 (h i) = true) /\ k (h i) = i.

Definition same_selected_values
    (n : nat) (p : nat -> bool)
    (f1 f2 h : nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  forall i : nat,
    i < n ->
    p i = true ->
    f1 i = f2 (h i).

Definition iso
    (n1 n2 : nat) (p1 p2 : nat -> bool)
    (f1 f2 : nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  exists h k : nat -> nat,
    (same_selected_values n1 p1 f1 f2 h /\
      sub_hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) /\
    sub_hk k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1.

Definition source_div (n d : nat) : nat :=
  match d with
  | O => S n
  | S d' => Nat.div n (S d')
  end.

Definition source_mod (n d : nat) : nat :=
  match d with
  | O => n
  | S d' => Nat.modulo n (S d')
  end.

Theorem bigops_let_clause_10471 :
  forall (n1 n2 : nat)
         (p1 p2 : nat -> bool)
         (f1 f2 : nat -> nat),
    iso n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 ->
    forall h : nat -> nat,
      (exists k : nat -> nat,
        (same_selected_values n1 p1 f1 f2 h /\
          sub_hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) /\
        sub_hk k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1) ->
      forall k : nat -> nat,
        ((same_selected_values n1 p1 f1 f2 h /\
            sub_hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) /\
          sub_hk k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1) ->
        (same_selected_values n1 p1 f1 f2 h /\
          sub_hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) ->
        same_selected_values n1 p1 f1 f2 h ->
        forall i m : nat,
          (forall f : nat -> bool,
            0 <= n1 ->
            sub_hk h k 0 m p1 f f1 f2 ->
            sub_hk k h m 0 f p1 f2 f1 ->
            bigop 0 p1 1 Nat.mul f1 =
            bigop m f 1 Nat.mul f2) ->
          forall p20 : nat -> bool,
            0 <= n1 ->
            sub_hk h k 0 (S m) p1 p20 f1 f2 ->
            sub_hk k h (S m) 0 p20 p1 f2 f1 ->
            forall x2571 x2572 : nat,
              x2571 =
              Nat.add
                (Nat.mul x2572 (source_div x2571 x2572))
                (source_mod x2571 x2572).
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact bigops.let_clause_10471:
  a let-clause implication preserving filtered-product isomorphism premises and
  concluding the natural-number quotient-remainder decomposition. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory let_clause_10471
  imports Main
begin

fun bigop ::
  "nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow>
    ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'a"
where
  "bigop 0 p nil op f = nil"
| "bigop (Suc n) p nil op f =
    (if p n
     then op (f n) (bigop n p nil op f)
     else bigop n p nil op f)"

definition sub_hk ::
  "(nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
    nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
    (nat \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow>
    (nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "sub_hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>i. i < n1 \<longrightarrow> p1 i = True \<longrightarrow>
      (h i < n2 \<and> p2 (h i) = True) \<and> k (h i) = i)"

definition iso ::
  "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
    (nat \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow>

;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; bigops.let_clause_10471 (catalog title: bigops.let_clause_10471):
;; nested isomorphism and filtered-product hypotheses imply the natural-number
;; division algorithm identity. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame unary function objects provide ACL2's statement-level representation
;; of the source functions nat -> nat and nat -> bool.

(defun bigops-10471-apply (function argument)
  (apply$ function (list argument)))

(defun-sk bigops-10471-nat-values-p (function)
  (forall (argument)
    (implies
     (natp argument)
     (natp (bigops-10471-apply function argument)))))

(defun bigops-10471-nat-function-p (function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (bigops-10471-nat-values-p function)))

(defun-sk bigops-10471-bool-values-p (function)
  (forall (argument)
    (implies
     (natp argument)
     (booleanp (bigops-10471-apply function argument)))))

(defun bigops-10471-bool-function-p (function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (bigops-10471-bool-values-p function)))

;; This is the natural-number specialization of bigops.bigop used by the
;; source statement: indices below BOUND whose predicate is true are
;; multiplied, with neutral element 1.

(defun bigops-10471-product (bound predicate function)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix bound)))
  (if (zp bound)
      1
    (let* ((index (1- bound))
           (rest
            (bigops-10471-product
             index predicate function)))
      (if (equal
           (bigops-10471-apply predicate index)
           t)
          (* (bigops-10471-apply function index)
             rest)
        rest))))

;; The source library totalizes division by zero with div(n,0) = n+1 and
;; mod(n,0) = n. For a positive divisor it uses ordinary Euclidean division.

(defun bigops-10471-div (dividend divisor)
  (if (zp divisor)
      (+ dividend 1)
    (floor dividend divisor)))

(defun bigops-10471-mod (dividend divisor)
  (if (zp divisor)
      dividend
    (mod dividend divisor)))

;; sub_hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2. The final two parameters are retained
;; because they occur in the source signature, although its definition does
;; not inspect them.

(defun-sk bigops-10471-sub-hk-p
    (h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (< index n1)
      (equal (bigops-10471-apply p1 index) t))
     (let ((image (bigops-10471-apply h index)))
       (and
        (< image n2)
        (equal (bigops-10471-apply p2 image) t)
        (equal
         (bigops-10471-apply k image)
         index))))))

(defun-sk bigops-10471-same-values-p
    (n1 p1 f1 f2 h)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (< index n1)
      (equal (bigops-10471-apply p1 index) t))
     (equal
      (bigops-10471-apply f1 index)
      (bigops-10471-apply
       f2
       (bigops-10471-apply h index))))))

(defun bigops-10471-full-pairing-p
    (n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k)
  (and
   (and
    (bigops-10471-same-values-p n1 p1 f1 f2 h)
    (bigops-10471-sub-hk-p
     h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2))
   (bigops-10471-sub-hk-p
    k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1)))

(defun bigops-10471-forward-pairing-p
    (n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k)
  (and
   (bigops-10471-same-values-p n1 p1 f1 f2 h)
   (bigops-10471-sub-hk-p
    h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2)))

(defun-sk bigops-10471-iso-p
    (n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2)
  (exists (h k)
    (and
     (bigops-10471-nat-function-p h)
     (bigops-10471-nat-function-p k)
     (bigops-10471-full-pairing-p
      n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k))))

(defun-sk bigops-10471-k-exists-p
    (n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h)
  (exists (k)
    (and
     (bigops-10471-nat-function-p k)
     (bigops-10471-full-pairing-p
      n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k))))

;; This is the source's universally quantified premise over the Boolean
;; function f. The explicit 0 <= n1 hypothesis is preserved.

(defun-sk bigops-10471-product-premise-p
    (n1 p1 f1 f2 h k m)
  (forall (f)
    (implies
     (bigops-10471-bool-function-p f)
     (implies
      (<= 0 n1)
      (implies
       (bigops-10471-sub-hk-p
        h k 0 m p1 f f1 f2)
       (implies
        (bigops-10471-sub-hk-p
         k h m 0 f p1 f2 f1)
        (equal
         (bigops-10471-product 0 p1 f1)
         (bigops-10471-product m f f2))))))))

(defun-sk bigops-10471-division-identity-p ()
  (forall (x2571 x2572)
    (implies
     (and (natp x2571) (natp x2572))
     (equal
      x2571
      (+
       (* x2572
          (bigops-10471-div x2571 x2572))
       (bigops-10471-mod x2571 x2572))))))

(defun-sk bigops-10471-p20-clause-p
    (n1 p1 f1 f2 h k m)
  (forall (p20)
    (implies
     (bigops-10471-bool-function-p p20)
     (implies
      (<= 0 n1)
      (implies
       (bigops-10471-sub-hk-p
        h k 0 (+ m 1) p1 p20 f1 f2)
       (implies
        (bigops-10471-sub-hk-p
         k h (+ m 1) 0 p20 p1 f2 f1)
        (bigops-10471-division-identity-p)))))))

;; INNER-INDEX is intentionally quantified although it is not used after its
;; binder, matching the source statement's forall i, forall m scope.

(defun-sk bigops-10471-index-and-m-clause-p
    (n1 p1 f1 f2 h k)
  (forall (inner-index m)
    (implies
     (and (natp inner-index) (natp m))
     (implies
      (bigops-10471-product-premise-p
       n1 p1 f1 f2 h k m)
      (bigops-10471-p20-clause-p
       n1 p1 f1 f2 h k m)))))

(defun-sk bigops-10471-k-clause-p
    (n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h)
  (forall (k)
    (implies
     (bigops-10471-nat-function-p k)
     (implies
      (bigops-10471-full-pairing-p
       n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k)
      (implies
       (bigops-10471-forward-pairing-p
        n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k)
       (implies
        (bigops-10471-same-values-p n1 p1 f1 f2 h)
        (bigops-10471-index-and-m-clause-p
         n1 p1 f1 f2 h k)))))))

(defun-sk bigops-10471-h-clause-p
    (n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2)
  (forall (h)
    (implies
     (bigops-10471-nat-function-p h)
     (implies
      (bigops-10471-k-exists-p
       n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h)
      (bigops-10471-k-clause-p
       n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h)))))

(defun logipedia-bigops-let-clause-10471-statement
    (n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n1)
    (natp n2)
    (bigops-10471-bool-function-p p1)
    (bigops-10471-bool-function-p p2)
    (bigops-10471-nat-function-p f1)
    (bigops-10471-nat-function-p f2))
   (implies
    (bigops-10471-iso-p n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2)
    (bigops-10471-h-clause-p
     n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
-- bigops.let_clause_10471: a nested big-operator induction context concluding
-- the natural-number quotient and remainder decomposition; this file contains no proof.
{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module let-clause-10471 where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; true; false)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _<_ _≤_
infixr 3 _∧_

data _<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<succ : {n : Nat} -> zero < suc n
  succ<succ : {m n : Nat} -> m < n -> suc m < suc n

data _≤_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} -> zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} -> m ≤ n -> suc m ≤ suc n

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  field
    first : A
    second : B

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

bigop :
  {level : Level} ->
  {H : Set level} ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Bool) ->
  H ->
  (H -> H -> H) ->
  (Nat -> H) ->
  H
bigop zero p nil op f = nil
bigop (suc n) p nil op f with p n
... | true = op (f n) (bigop n p nil op f)
... | false = bigop n p nil op f

mod-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
mod-aux zero m n = m
mod-aux (suc fuel) m n with leb m n
... | true = m
... | false = mod-aux fuel (m - suc n) n

mod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
mod n zero = n
mod n (suc p) = mod-aux n n p

div-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
div-aux zero m n = zero
div-aux (suc fuel) m n with leb m n
... | true = zero
... | false = suc (div-aux fuel (m - suc n) n)

div : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
div n zero = suc n
div n (suc p) = div-aux n n p

same :
  (n1 : Nat) ->
  (p1 : Nat -> Bool) ->
  (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat) ->
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
same n1 p1 f1 f2 h =
  (j : Nat) ->
  j < n1 ->
  p1 j ≡ true ->
  f1 j ≡ f2 (h j)

sub-hk :
  (h k : Nat -> Nat) ->
  (n1 n2 : Nat) ->
  (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool) ->
  (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
sub-hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 =
  (j : Nat) ->
  j < n1 ->
  p1 j ≡ true ->
  (h j < n2 ∧ p2 (h j) ≡ true) ∧ k (h j) ≡ j

full :
  (n1 n2 : Nat) ->
  (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool) ->
  (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat) ->
  (h k : Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
full n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k =
  (same n1 p1 f1 f2 h ∧ sub-hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) ∧
  sub-hk k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1

partial :
  (n1 n2 : Nat) ->
  (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool) ->
  (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat) ->
  (h k : Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
partial n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k =
  same n1 p1 f1 f2 h ∧ sub-hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2

iso :
  (n1 n2 : Nat) ->
  (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool) ->
  (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
iso n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 =
  Σ (Nat -> Nat) (\ h ->
    Σ (Nat -> Nat) (\ k ->
      full n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k))

induction-hypothesis :
  (n1 : Nat) ->
  (p1 : Nat -> Bool) ->
  (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat) ->
  (h k : Nat -> Nat) ->
  Nat ->
  Set
induction-hypothesis n1 p1 f1 f2 h k m =
  (f : Nat -> Bool) ->
  zero ≤ n1 ->
  sub-hk h k zero m p1 f f1 f2 ->
  sub-hk k h m zero f p1 f2 f1 ->
  bigop zero p1 1 _*_ f1 ≡ bigop m f 1 _*_ f2

let-clause-10471 : Set
let-clause-10471 =
  (n1 n2 : Nat) ->
  (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool) ->
  (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat) ->
  iso n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 ->
  (h : Nat -> Nat) ->
  Σ (Nat -> Nat) (\ k -> full n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k) ->
  (k : Nat -> Nat) ->
  full n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k ->
  partial n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 h k ->
  same n1 p1 f1 f2 h ->
  (i m : Nat) ->
  induction-hypothesis n1 p1 f1 f2 h k m ->
  (p20 : Nat -> Bool) ->
  zero ≤ n1 ->
  sub-hk h k zero (suc m) p1 p20 f1 f2 ->
  sub-hk k h (suc m) zero p20 p1 f2 f1 ->
  (x2571 x2572 : Nat) ->
  x2571 ≡ x2572 * div x2571 x2572 + mod x2571 x2572

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
  bigops.let_clause_10471, catalog title "bigops.let_clause_10471": a nested
  proposition about Boolean-selected natural-number products and mutually
  inverse selected-index maps, concluding the natural-number
  quotient-remainder identity. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory;

val logipedia_bigops_source_div_def = Define `
  logipedia_bigops_source_div n m =
    if m = 0 then SUC n else n DIV m
`;

val logipedia_bigops_source_mod_def = Define `
  logipedia_bigops_source_mod n m =
    if m = 0 then n else n MOD m
`;

val logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop_def = Define `
  (logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop 0 (p : num -> bool) (f : num -> num) = 1) /\
  (logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop (SUC n) p f =
    if p n then
      f n * logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop n p f
    else
      logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop n p f)
`;

val logipedia_bigops_sub_hk_def = Define `
  logipedia_bigops_sub_hk
    (h : num -> num)
    (k : num -> num)
    (n1 : num)
    (n2 : num)
    (p1 : num -> bool)
    (p2 : num -> bool)
    (f1 : num -> num)
    (f2 : num -> num) <=>
  !i : num.
    i < n1
    ==>
    p1 i = T
    ==>
    (h i < n2 /\ p2 (h i) = T) /\ k (h i) = i
`;

val logipedia_bigops_iso_def = Define `
  logipedia_bigops_iso
    (n1 : num)
    (n2 : num)
    (p1 : num -> bool)
    (p2 : num -> bool)
    (f1 : num -> num)
    (f2 : num -> num) <=>
  ?h k : num -> num.
    ((!i : num.
        i < n1
        ==>
        p1 i = T
        ==>
        f1 i = f2 (h i)) /\
      logipedia_bigops_sub_hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) /\
    logipedia_bigops_sub_hk k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1
`;

val bigops_let_clause_10471 =
  ``!n1 n2 : num.
      !(p1 : num -> bool) (p2 : num -> bool).
      !(f1 : num -> num) (f2 : num -> num).
        logipedia_bigops_iso n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2
        ==>
        !h : num -> num.
          (?k : num -> num.
             (((!j : num.
                  j < n1
                  ==>
                  p1 j = T
                  ==>
                  f1 j = f2 (h j)) /\
                logipedia_bigops_sub_hk
                  h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) /\
              logipedia_bigops_sub_hk
                k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1))
          ==>
          !k : num -> num.
            (((!j : num.
                 j < n1
                 ==>
                 p1 j = T
                 ==>
                 f1 j = f2 (h j)) /\
               logipedia_bigops_sub_hk
                 h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2) /\
             logipedia_bigops_sub_hk
               k h n2 n1 p2 p1 f2 f1)
            ==>
            ((!j : num.
                j < n1
                ==>
                p1 j = T
                ==>
                f1 j = f2 (h j)) /\
              logipedia_bigops_sub_hk
                h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2)
            ==>
            (!j : num.
               j < n1
               ==>
               p1 j = T
               ==>
               f1 j = f2 (h j))
            ==>
            !i : num.
              !m : num.
                (!f : num -> bool.
                   0 <= n1
                   ==>
                   logipedia_bigops_sub_hk
                     h k 0 m p1 f f1 f2
                   ==>
                   logipedia_bigops_sub_hk
                     k h m 0 f p1 f2 f1
                   ==>
                   logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop 0 p1 f1 =
                   logipedia_bigops_nat_bigop m f f2)

${

    ( LogSubHK h k a b p q f g )
    <->
    A. i e. NN0
      (

${

$}

log-nat-div-definition $a |- (

:: bidirectional index maps, filtered products, and division with remainder.

:: zero divisor: mod(x,0) = x and div(x,0) = x+1. This file contains no proof.

    NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1,

    FINSEQ_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_3, RVSUM_1, MARGREL1, XBOOLEAN, WAYBEL_4,

    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1,

    INT_1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_2, RVSUM_1, FINSEQOP,
    MARGREL1;

    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    RVSUM_1, MARGREL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

definition
  let n,m be Nat;
  func Aux(n,m) -> Nat equals
    n+1 if m = 0 otherwise n div m;
  correctness;

  func AuxBottom(n,m) -> Nat equals
    n if m = 0 otherwise n mod m;
  correctness;
end;

::$P-
theorem
  for n1,n2 being Nat,
      p1,p2 being Function of NAT,BOOLEAN,
      f1,f2 being Function of NAT,NAT st
    ex h0,k0 being Function of NAT,NAT st
      ((for i0 being Nat st i0 < n1 & p1.i0 = TRUE holds
          f1.i0 = f2.(h0.i0)) &
       (for i0 being Nat st i0 < n1 & p1.i0 = TRUE holds
          h0.i0 < n2 &
          p2.(h0.i0) = TRUE &
          k0.(h0.i0) = i0)) &
      (for j0 being Nat st j0 < n2 & p2.j0 = TRUE holds
        k0.j0 < n1 &
        p1.(k0.j0) = TRUE &
        h0.(k0.j0) = j0)
  holds
    for h being Function of NAT,NAT st
      ex k being Function of NAT,NAT st
        ((for i0 being Nat st i0 < n1 & p1.i0 = TRUE holds
            f1.i0 = f2.(h.i0)) &
         (for i0 being Nat st i0 < n1 & p1.i0 = TRUE holds
            h.i0 < n2 &
            p2.(h.i0) = TRUE &
            k.(h.i0) = i0)) &
        (for j0 being Nat st j0 < n2 & p2.j0 = TRUE holds
          k.j0 < n1 &
          p1.(k.j0) = TRUE &
          h.(k.j0) = j0)
    holds
      for k being Function of NAT,NAT st
        ((for i0 being Nat st i0 < n1 & p1.i0 = TRUE holds
            f1.i0 = f2.(h.i0)) &
         (for i0 being Nat st i0 < n1 & p1.i0 = TRUE holds
            h.i0 < n2 &
            p2.(h.i0) = TRUE &
            k.(h.i0) = i0)) &
        (for j0 being Nat st j0 < n2 & p2.j0 = TRUE holds
          k.j0 < n1 &
          p1.(k.j0) = TRUE &
          h.(k.j0) = j0)
      holds
        (((for i0 being Nat st i0 < n1 & p1.i0 = TRUE holds
              f1.i0 = f2.(h.i0)) &
          (for i0 being Nat st i0 < n1 & p1.i0 = TRUE holds
            h.i0 < n2 &
            p2.(h.i0) = TRUE &
            k.(h.i0) = i0)) implies
        ((for i0 being Nat st i0 < n1 & p1.i0 = TRUE holds
            f1.i0 = f2.(h.i0)) implies
          for i,m being Nat holds
            (for f being Function of NAT,BOOLEAN holds
              0 <= n1 implies
              ((for i0 being Nat st i0 < 0 & p1.i0 = TRUE holds
                  h.i0 < m &
                  f.(h.i0) = TRUE &
                  k.(h.i0) = i0) implies
              ((for j0 being Nat st j0 < m & f.j0 = TRUE holds
                  k.j0 < 0 &
                  p1.(k.j0) = TRUE &
                  h.(k.j0) = j0) implies
                ex left,right being FinSequence of NAT st
                  len left = 0 &
                  (for r being Nat st r in dom left holds
                    (p1.(r-'1) = TRUE implies
                      left.r = f1.(r-'1)) &
                    (p1.(r-'1) = FALSE implies left.r = 1)) &
                  len right = m &
                  (for r being Nat st r in dom right holds
                    (f.(r-'1) = TRUE implies
                      right.r = f2.(r-'1)) &
                    (f.(r-'1) = FALSE implies right.r = 1)) &
                  Product left = Product right))) implies
            for p20 being Function of NAT,BOOLEAN holds
              0 <= n1 implies
              ((for i0 being Nat st i0 < 0 & p1.i0 = TRUE holds
                  h.i0 < m+1 &
                  p20.(h.i0) = TRUE &
                  k.(h.i0) = i0) implies
              ((for j0 being Nat st j0 < m+1 & p20.j0 = TRUE holds
                  k.j0 < 0 &
                  p1.(k.j0) = TRUE &
                  h.(k.j0) = j0) implies
                for x2571,x2572 being Nat holds
                  x2571 =
                    x2572 *
                      Aux(x2571,x2572) +
                    AuxBottom(x2571,x2572)))))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: let_clause_10471
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia artifact bigops.let_clause_10471:
% a nested let-clause induction statement for predicate-filtered natural-number
% products, index isomorphisms, and quotient-remainder decomposition. This file
% contains no proof.

bigops_let_clause_10471: THEORY
BEGIN
  bigop_nat(
      count: nat,
      predicate: [nat -> bool],
      value: [nat -> nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF predicate(count - 1) THEN
      value(count - 1)
        * bigop_nat(count - 1, predicate, value)
    ELSE
      bigop_nat(count - 1, predicate, value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sub_hk(
      h, k: [nat -> nat],
      n1, n2: nat,
      p1, p2: [nat -> bool],
      f1, f2: [nat -> nat]): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i < n1 IMPLIES
        p1(i) = TRUE IMPLIES
          (h(i) < n2 AND p2(h(i)) = TRUE)
            AND k(h(i)) = i

  same_values(
      h: [nat -> nat],
      n1: nat,
      p1: [nat -> bool],
      f1, f2: [nat -> nat]): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i < n1 IMPLIES
        p1(i) = TRUE IMPLIES
          f1(i) = f2(h(i))

  iso(
      n1, n2: nat,
      p1, p2: [nat -> bool],
      f1, f2: [nat -> nat]): bool =
    EXISTS (h, k: [nat -> nat]):
      (same_values(h, n1, p1, f1, f2)
        AND sub_hk(h, k, n1, n2, p1, p2, f1, f2))
      AND sub_hk(k, h, n2, n1, p2, p1, f2, f1)

  quotient_aux(n, m, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0 OR m = 0 OR n < m THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1 + quotient_aux(n - m, m, fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(n, m, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0 OR m = 0 OR n < m THEN
      n
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(n - m, m, fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  source_div(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n + 1
    ELSE
      quotient_aux(n, m, n + 1)
    ENDIF

  source_mod(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(n, m, n + 1)
    ENDIF

  let_clause_10471: bool =
    FORALL (n1, n2: nat),
        (p1, p2: [nat -> bool]),
        (f1, f2: [nat -> nat]):
      iso(n1, n2, p1, p2, f1, f2) IMPLIES
        FORALL (h: [nat -> nat]):
          (EXISTS (witness_k: [nat -> nat]):
            (same_values(h, n1, p1, f1, f2)
              AND sub_hk(
                h, witness_k, n1, n2, p1, p2, f1, f2))
            AND sub_hk(
              witness_k, h, n2, n1, p2, p1, f2, f1))
          IMPLIES
            FORALL (k: [nat -> nat]):
              ((same_values(h, n1, p1, f1, f2)
                  AND sub_hk(h, k, n1, n2, p1, p2, f1, f2))
                AND sub_hk(k, h, n2, n1, p2, p1, f2, f1))
              IMPLIES
                (same_values(h, n1, p1, f1, f2)
                  AND sub_hk(h, k, n1, n2, p1, p2, f1, f2))
                IMPLIES
                  same_values(h, n1, p1, f1, f2)
                  IMPLIES
                    FORALL (i, m: nat):
                      (FORALL (f: [nat -> bool]):
                        0 <= n1 IMPLIES
                          sub_hk(h, k, 0, m, p1, f, f1, f2)
                          IMPLIES
                            sub_hk(k, h, m, 0, f, p1, f2, f1)
                            IMPLIES
                              bigop_nat(0, p1, f1)
                                = bigop_nat(m, f, f2))
                      IMPLIES
                        FORALL (p20: [nat -> bool]):
                          0 <= n1 IMPLIES
                            sub_hk(
                              h, k, 0, m + 1, p1, p20, f1, f2)
                            IMPLIES
                              sub_hk(
                                k, h, m + 1, 0, p20, p1, f2, f1)
                              IMPLIES
                                FORALL (x2571, x2572: nat):
                                  x2571
                                    = x2572
                                        * source_div(x2571, x2572)
                                      + source_mod(x2571, x2572)
END bigops_let_clause_10471

-- (catalog title "bigops.same_bigop"): Boolean-filtered big operations agree
-- below a bound when their predicates and selected function values agree.

namespace bigops

def sameF_upto (A : Type) (k : Nat) (f g : Nat → A) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Nat, i < k → f i = g i

def sameF_p (A : Type) (k : Nat) (p : Nat → Bool) (f g : Nat → A) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Nat, i < k → p i = true → f i = g i

def bigop (H : Type) :
    Nat → (Nat → Bool) → H → (H → H → H) → (Nat → H) → H
  | 0, _p, nil, _op, _f => nil
  | n + 1, p, nil, op, f =>
      match p n with

      | false => bigop H n p nil op f

theorem same_bigop
    (B : Type) (k : Nat) (p1 p2 : Nat → Bool) (nil : B)
    (op : B → B → B) (f g : Nat → B)
    (hp : sameF_upto Bool k p1 p2)
    (hfg : sameF_p B k p1 f g) :
    bigop B k p1 nil op f = bigop B k p2 nil op g := sorry

Definition sameF_upto {A : Type}
    (k : nat) (f g : nat -> A) : Prop :=
  forall i : nat,

    (k : nat) (p : nat -> bool) (f g : nat -> A) : Prop :=
  forall i : nat,

;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; bigops.same_bigop, catalog title "bigops.same_bigop": two Boolean-selected
;; polymorphic big operations below the same natural bound are equal when
;; their selectors agree there and their selected values agree there.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; At bound k, the source proposition observes p1, p2, f, and g only below k.
;; Their exact length-k prefixes therefore preserve every observation. In the
;; other direction, each prefix extends to a total natural-indexed function by
;; using nil, respectively nil-value, from k onward.
;;
;; Each fold makes finitely many calls to op. Restricting a source operation to
;; those argument pairs gives an alist with the same two fold results.
;; Conversely, the evaluator below is a total binary operation, using
;; nil-value away from recorded pairs. Carrier values are equality-preserving
;; ACL2 codes: a source instance restricts to finitely many values that can be
;; injected into the ACL2 universe, while every ACL2 trace is a source instance
;; over that universe. Thus the trace statement and source statement imply one
;; another without bounding k or the source carrier.

(defun logipedia-bigops-same-bigop-bool-list-p (values)
  (if (endp values)
      (equal values nil)
    (and
     (booleanp (car values))
     (logipedia-bigops-same-bigop-bool-list-p (cdr values)))))

;; These are the restrictions of source sameF_upto and sameF_p to [0,k).

(defun logipedia-bigops-same-bigop-samef-upto
    (predicate-prefix-1 predicate-prefix-2)
  (if (endp predicate-prefix-1)
      (equal predicate-prefix-2 nil)
    (and
     (consp predicate-prefix-2)
     (equal (car predicate-prefix-1)
            (car predicate-prefix-2))
     (logipedia-bigops-same-bigop-samef-upto
      (cdr predicate-prefix-1)
      (cdr predicate-prefix-2)))))

(defun logipedia-bigops-same-bigop-samef-p
    (predicate-prefix sequence-prefix-f sequence-prefix-g)
  (if (endp predicate-prefix)
      t
    (and
     (consp sequence-prefix-f)
     (consp sequence-prefix-g)
     (implies
      (equal (car predicate-prefix) t)
      (equal (car sequence-prefix-f)
             (car sequence-prefix-g)))
     (logipedia-bigops-same-bigop-samef-p
      (cdr predicate-prefix)
      (cdr sequence-prefix-f)
      (cdr sequence-prefix-g)))))

(defun logipedia-bigops-same-bigop-operation-at
    (operation-table nil-value left right)
  (let ((entry (assoc-equal (list left right) operation-table)))
    (if entry
        (cdr entry)
      nil-value)))

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact bigops.same_bigop
-- (catalog title "bigops.same_bigop"): equality of Boolean-filtered big
-- operations when their selectors and selected values agree below the bound.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module same_bigop where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _≤_ _<_

data _≤_ (n : Nat) : Nat -> Set where
  le-refl : n ≤ n
  le-step : {m : Nat} -> n ≤ m -> n ≤ suc m

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
n < m = suc n ≤ m

sameF-upto :
  {level : Level} ->
  {A : Set level} ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  Set level
sameF-upto k f g =
  (i : Nat) ->
  i < k ->
  f i ≡ g i

sameF-p :
  {level : Level} ->
  {A : Set level} ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Bool) ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  Set level
sameF-p k p f g =
  (i : Nat) ->
  i < k ->
  p i ≡ true ->
  f i ≡ g i

bigop :
  {level : Level} ->
  {H : Set level} ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Bool) ->
  H ->
  (H -> H -> H) ->
  (Nat -> H) ->
  H
bigop zero p nil op f = nil
bigop (suc n) p nil op f with p n
... | true = op (f n) (bigop n p nil op f)
... | false = bigop n p nil op f

same-bigop :
  {level : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc level)
same-bigop {level} =
  (B : Set level) ->
  (k : Nat) ->
  (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool) ->
  (nil : B) ->
  (op : B -> B -> B) ->
  (f g : Nat -> B) ->
  sameF-upto k p1 p2 ->
  sameF-p k p1 f g ->
  bigop k p1 nil op f ≡ bigop k p2 nil op g

        logipedia_bigops_sameF_p k p1 f g ==>

content:
% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact bigops.same_bigop:
% predicate-filtered big operations are equal when their predicates agree
% below the bound and their selected values agree. This file contains no proof.

bigops_same_bigop[B: TYPE+]: THEORY
BEGIN
  sameF_upto(
      k: nat,
      p1, p2: [nat -> bool]): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i < k IMPLIES p1(i) = p2(i)

  sameF_p(
      k: nat,
      p: [nat -> bool],
      f, g: [nat -> B]): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i < k IMPLIES
        (p(i) = TRUE IMPLIES f(i) = g(i))

  bigop(
      count: nat,
      p: [nat -> bool],
      nil: B,
      op: [B -> [B -> B]],
      f: [nat -> B]): RECURSIVE B =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      nil
    ELSIF p(count - 1) THEN
      op(f(count - 1))(bigop(count - 1, p, nil, op, f))
    ELSE
      bigop(count - 1, p, nil, op, f)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  same_bigop: bool =
    FORALL (k: nat), (p1, p2: [nat -> bool]), (nil: B),
        (op: [B -> [B -> B]]), (f, g: [nat -> B]):
      sameF_upto(k, p1, p2) IMPLIES
        (sameF_p(k, p1, f, g) IMPLIES
          bigop(k, p1, nil, op, f) =
            bigop(k, p2, nil, op, g))
END bigops_same_bigop

% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact bigops.sub_lt:
% when one natural-number prefix is no longer than another, identity maps give
% selected-index correspondence for any predicate and value sequence. This file contains no proof.

bigops_sub_lt: THEORY
BEGIN
  sub_hk(
      h, k: [nat -> nat],
      n1, n2: nat,
      p1, p2: [nat -> bool],
      f1, f2: [nat -> nat]): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i < n1 IMPLIES
        p1(i) = TRUE IMPLIES
          (h(i) < n2 AND p2(h(i)) = TRUE)
            AND k(h(i)) = i

  sub_lt: FORMULA
    FORALL (e: [nat -> nat]), (p: [nat -> bool]), (n, m: nat):
      n <= m IMPLIES
        sub_hk(
          (LAMBDA (x: nat): x),
          (LAMBDA (x: nat): x),
          n, m, p, p, e, e)
END bigops_sub_lt

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact "bigops.sym_eq_bigop_O"
-- (catalog title "bigops.sym_eq_bigop_O"): directed Leibniz equality at index zero
-- between the fixed Boolean-filtered big-operation families. This file contains no proof.

namespace bigops

def Leibniz (A : Type) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : A → Prop, P x → P y

def bigop (H : Type) :
    Nat → (Nat → Bool) → H → (H → H → H) → (Nat → H) → H
  | 0, _p, nil, _op, _f => nil
  | n + 1, p, nil, op, f =>
      match p n with
      | true => op (f n) (bigop H n p nil op f)
      | false => bigop H n p nil op f

def bigop_body (H : Type) :
    Nat → (Nat → Bool) → H → (H → H → H) → (Nat → H) → H
  | 0, _p, nil, _op, _f => nil
  | n + 1, p, nil, op, f =>
      match p n with
      | true => op (f n) (bigop H n p nil op f)
      | false => bigop H n p nil op f

theorem sym_eq_bigop_O :
    ∀ H : Type,
      Leibniz ((Nat → Bool) → H → (H → H → H) → (Nat → H) → H)
        (bigop_body H 0) (bigop H 0) := sorry

end bigops

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; bigops.sym_eq_bigop_body_O, catalog title "bigops.sym_eq_bigop_body_O":
;; at natural index zero, the function returning its neutral argument is
;; Leibniz-equal at the full higher-order function type to the polymorphic
;; bigop body. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Conservative interfaces for arbitrary carriers, the function arguments,
;; and application of reified higher-order function values.

(defstub logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-member-p (h-type value) t)
(defstub logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-predicate-at (predicate index) t)
(defstub logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-operation-at
  (operation left right)
  t)
(defstub logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-sequence-at (sequence index) t)

(defstub logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-generic-apply
  (h-type function-value predicate nil-value operation sequence)
  t)

(defstub logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-bigop-body (h-type index) t)

;; This reified value is the source lambda
;; (fun predicate nil-value operation sequence => nil-value).

(defun logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-constant-nil-function (h-type)
  (list 'logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-constant-nil-function h-type))

(defun logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-apply
    (h-type function-value predicate nil-value operation sequence)
  (if
      (equal
       function-value
       (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-constant-nil-function h-type))
      nil-value
    (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-generic-apply
     h-type function-value predicate nil-value operation sequence)))

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-nat-bool-function-p (predicate)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (booleanp
      (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-predicate-at predicate index)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-binary-operation-p
    (h-type operation)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-member-p h-type left)
      (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-member-p h-type right))
     (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-member-p
      h-type
      (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-operation-at operation left right)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-nat-sequence-p (h-type sequence)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-member-p
      h-type
      (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-sequence-at sequence index)))))

(defun logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-arguments-p
    (h-type predicate nil-value operation sequence)
  (and
   (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-nat-bool-function-p predicate)
   (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-member-p h-type nil-value)
   (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-binary-operation-p h-type operation)
   (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-nat-sequence-p h-type sequence)))

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-function-value-p
    (h-type function-value)
  (forall (predicate nil-value operation sequence)
    (implies
     (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-arguments-p
      h-type predicate nil-value operation sequence)
     (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-member-p
      h-type
      (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-apply
       h-type
       function-value
       predicate
       nil-value
       operation
       sequence)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-bigop-body-typed-p ()
  (forall (h-type index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-function-value-p
      h-type
      (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-bigop-body h-type index)))))

;; ACL2 equality of the reified values is identity at the complete source
;; function type, hence the source Leibniz equality rather than merely
;; pointwise agreement.

(defun-sk logipedia-bigops-sym-eq-bigop-body-o-leibniz-p ()
  (forall (h-type)
    (equal
     (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-constant-nil-function h-type)
     (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-bigop-body h-type 0))))

(defun logipedia-bigops-sym-eq-bigop-body-o-statement ()
  (implies
   (logipedia-bigops-sym-body-o-bigop-body-typed-p)
   (logipedia-bigops-sym-eq-bigop-body-o-leibniz-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- big-operation body, for every carrier type. This file contains no proof.

module sym_eq_bigop_body_O where

  A ->

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact bigops.sym_eq_bigop_body_S
-- (catalog title "bigops.sym_eq_bigop_body_S"): Leibniz equality at every
-- successor index from the Boolean-selected recursive step to the generic
-- big-operation body, for every carrier type. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module sym_eq_bigop_body_S where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; suc)

Bigop :
  {level : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc level)
Bigop {level} =
  (H : Set level) ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Bool) ->
  H ->
  (H -> H -> H) ->
  (Nat -> H) ->
  H

Leibniz :
  {level : Level} ->
  (A : Set level) ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set (lsuc level)
Leibniz {level} A x y =
  (P : A -> Set level) ->
  P x ->
  P y

match-bool-type :
  {level : Level} ->
  {H : Set level} ->
  H ->
  H ->
  Bool ->
  H
match-bool-type case-true case-false true = case-true
match-bool-type case-true case-false false = case-false

module Statement
  {level : Level}
  (bigop bigop-body : Bigop {level}) where

  sym-eq-bigop-body-S :
    Set (lsuc level)
  sym-eq-bigop-body-S =
    (H : Set level) ->
    (n : Nat) ->
    Leibniz
      ((Nat -> Bool) -> H -> (H -> H -> H) -> (Nat -> H) -> H)
      (\ p nil op f ->
        match-bool-type
          (op (f n) (bigop H n p nil op f))
          (bigop H n p nil op f)
          (p n))
      (bigop-body H (suc n))

title: sym_eq_bigop_body_S
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
  bigops.sym_eq_bigop_body_S: at every successor natural-number index,
  Leibniz equality relates the Boolean-selected clause that combines the
  current family value with the preceding bigop result to bigop_body. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory;

val logipedia_bigops_operator_type =
  numSyntax.num -->
  (numSyntax.num --> Type.bool) -->
  Type.alpha -->
  (Type.alpha --> Type.alpha --> Type.alpha) -->
  (numSyntax.num --> Type.alpha) -->
  Type.alpha;

val logipedia_leibniz_def = new_definition (
  "logipedia_leibniz_def",
  ``logipedia_leibniz (x : 'a) (y : 'a) <=>
      !P : 'a -> bool. P x ==> P y``);

val _ = new_constant (
  "logipedia_bigops_bigop",
  logipedia_bigops_operator_type);

val _ = new_constant (
  "logipedia_bigops_bigop_body",
  logipedia_bigops_operator_type);

val bigops_sym_eq_bigop_body_S =
  ``!n : num.
      logipedia_leibniz
        (\(p : num -> bool) (nil : 'a) (op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
          (f : num -> 'a).
            if p n then
              op (f n) (logipedia_bigops_bigop n p nil op f)
            else
              logipedia_bigops_bigop n p nil op f)
        (logipedia_bigops_bigop_body (SUC n))``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
  bigops.sym_eq_bigop_body_S: for every carrier type and natural number n,
  the curried function that includes f(n) with the binary operation exactly
  when the Boolean predicate holds at n is Leibniz equal to the successor
  bigop body. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The carrier h and index n remain arbitrary. Full SetMM function spaces
  encode the source type

    (NN0 -> Bool) -> h -> (h -> h -> h) -> (NN0 -> h) -> h,

  with {0,1} as the Boolean carrier. LogBigop h n represents the source
  bigop at n, and LogBigopBodySucc h n represents bigop_body at S n. The
  nested maps-to expression is the source lambda p, nil, op, f, while the
  SetMM conditional tests p(n) = 1. A predicate on the common function type
  is represented extensionally by a subset q, so the bounded universal
  implication is precisely the source Leibniz equality in its stated
  direction. All declarations are unproved $a statement encodings; this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c LogBigop LogBigopBodySucc LogBigopBodySuccType $.

log-bigop-syntax $a class ( LogBigop h n ) $.
log-bigop-body-succ-syntax $a class ( LogBigopBodySucc h n ) $.
log-bigop-body-succ-type-syntax $a class ( LogBigopBodySuccType h ) $.

log-bigop-body-succ-type-definition $a |- ( LogBigopBodySuccType h ) =
  (
    (
      (
        ( h ^m ( h ^m NN0 ) )
        ^m
        ( ( h ^m h ) ^m h )
      )
      ^m
      h
    )
    ^m
    ( { 0 , 1 } ^m NN0 )
  )
$.

${
  $d f h n o p q x $.

  logipedia-bigops-sym-eq-bigop-body-s $a |-
    A. h A. n e. NN0
      (
        (
          ( LogBigopBodySucc h n ) e. ( LogBigopBodySuccType h )
          /\
          (
            ( LogBigop h n ) e. ( LogBigopBodySuccType h )
            /\
            (
              p e. ( { 0 , 1 } ^m NN0 ) |->
                (
                  x e. h |->
                    (
                      o e. ( ( h ^m h ) ^m h ) |->
                        (
                          f e. ( h ^m NN0 ) |->
                            if (
                              ( p ` n ) = 1 ,
                              (
                                ( o ` ( f ` n ) )
                                `
                                ( ( ( ( ( LogBigop h n ) ` p ) ` x ) ` o ) ` f )
                              ) ,
                              ( ( ( ( ( LogBigop h n ) ` p ) ` x ) ` o ) ` f )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            ) e. ( LogBigopBodySuccType h )
          )
        )
        /\
        A. q e. ~P ( LogBigopBodySuccType h )
          (
            (
              p e. ( { 0 , 1 } ^m NN0 ) |->
                (
                  x e. h |->
                    (
                      o e. ( ( h ^m h ) ^m h ) |->
                        (
                          f e. ( h ^m NN0 ) |->
                            if (
                              ( p ` n ) = 1 ,
                              (
                                ( o ` ( f ` n ) )
                                `
                                ( ( ( ( ( LogBigop h n ) ` p ) ` x ) ` o ) ` f )
                              ) ,
                              ( ( ( ( ( LogBigop h n ) ` p ) ` x ) ` o ) ` f )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            ) e. q
            ->
            ( LogBigopBodySucc h n ) e. q
          )
      )
  $.
$}

content:
% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact bigops.sym_eq_bigop_body_S
% (catalog title "bigops.sym_eq_bigop_body_S"): at every successor index, the
% conditional big-operation function is Leibniz-equal to the big-operation body.
% This file contains no proof.

bigops_sym_eq_bigop_body_S[
  H: TYPE+
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  bigop, bigop_body:
    [nat ->
      [[nat -> bool] ->
        [H ->
          [[H -> [H -> H]] ->
            [[nat -> H] -> H]]]]]

  sym_eq_bigop_body_S: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      (LAMBDA (p: [nat -> bool]):
        (LAMBDA (nil: H):
          (LAMBDA (op: [H -> [H -> H]]):
            (LAMBDA (f: [nat -> H]):
              IF p(n) THEN
                op(f(n))(bigop(n)(p)(nil)(op)(f))
              ELSE
                bigop(n)(p)(nil)(op)(f)
              ENDIF)))) =
        bigop_body(n + 1)
END bigops_sym_eq_bigop_body_S

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact "bigops.transitive_sub"
-- (catalog title "bigops.transitive_sub"): transitivity of bounded correspondences
-- preserving Boolean-selected indices. The final two source parameters are retained
-- even though the source definition does not inspect them. This file contains no proof.

namespace bigops

def sub_hk
    (h k : Nat -> Nat) (n1 n2 : Nat) (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool)
    (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat) : Prop :=
  forall i : Nat, i < n1 -> p1 i = true ->
    ((h i < n2 /\ p2 (h i) = true) /\ k (h i) = i)

theorem transitive_sub
    (h1 k1 h2 k2 : Nat -> Nat) (n1 n2 n3 : Nat)
    (p1 p2 p3 : Nat -> Bool) (f1 f2 f3 : Nat -> Nat)
    (hsub1 : sub_hk h1 k1 n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2)
    (hsub2 : sub_hk h2 k2 n2 n3 p2 p3 f2 f3) :
    sub_hk (fun x => h2 (h1 x)) (fun x => k1 (k2 x))
      n1 n3 p1 p3 f1 f3 := sorry

end bigops

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
  bigops.transitive_sub (catalog title "bigops.transitive_sub"):
  transitivity of selected finite-range index embeddings under composition.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Bool.Bool.

Definition sub_hk
    (h k : nat -> nat) (n1 n2 : nat)
    (p1 p2 : nat -> bool) (f1 f2 : nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  forall i : nat,
    i < n1 ->
    p1 i = true ->
    (h i < n2 /\ p2 (h i) = true) /\ k (h i) = i.

Theorem bigops_transitive_sub :
  forall (h1 k1 h2 k2 : nat -> nat)
         (n1 n2 n3 : nat)
         (p1 p2 p3 : nat -> bool)
         (f1 f2 f3 : nat -> nat),
    sub_hk h1 k1 n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 ->
    sub_hk h2 k2 n2 n3 p2 p3 f2 f3 ->

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact bigops.transitive_sub
-- (catalog title "bigops.transitive_sub"): the sub_hk relation on selected
-- indices is transitive under composition. Its final two source parameters are
-- retained even though the source definition does not inspect them.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module transitive_sub where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _<_
infixr 3 _∧_

data _<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<succ : {n : Nat} -> zero < suc n
  succ<succ : {m n : Nat} -> m < n -> suc m < suc n

record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

sub-hk :
  (h k : Nat -> Nat) ->
  (n1 n2 : Nat) ->
  (p1 p2 : Nat -> Bool) ->
  (f1 f2 : Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
sub-hk h k n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 =
  (i : Nat) ->
  i < n1 ->
  p1 i ≡ true ->
  ((h i < n2) ∧ (p2 (h i) ≡ true)) ∧
  (k (h i) ≡ i)

transitive-sub : Set
transitive-sub =
  (h1 k1 h2 k2 : Nat -> Nat) ->
  (n1 n2 n3 : Nat) ->
  (p1 p2 p3 : Nat -> Bool) ->
  (f1 f2 f3 : Nat -> Nat) ->
  sub-hk h1 k1 n1 n2 p1 p2 f1 f2 ->
  sub-hk h2 k2 n2 n3 p2 p3 f2 f3 ->
  sub-hk
    (λ x -> h2 (h1 x))
    (λ x -> k1 (k2 x))
    n1
    n3
    p1
    p3
    f1
    f3

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)

  (P : Set level) → P → P

  (P : Set level) → P

  Set level →
  Set level →
  Bool →

  (x y : Bool) →
  x ≡ y →
  match-bool-type
    (match-bool-type (ChurchTrue level) (ChurchFalse level) y)
    (match-bool-type (ChurchFalse level) (ChurchTrue level) y)

% Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia artifact cong.let_clause_1034,
% catalog title "cong.let_clause_1034": every natural number is its source
% remainder plus the divisor times its source quotient, under the stated
% positive-parameter assumption. This file contains no proof.

let_clause_1034: THEORY
BEGIN

  quotient_aux(n, divisor, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0 OR divisor = 0 OR n < divisor THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1 + quotient_aux(n - divisor, divisor, fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(n, divisor, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0 OR divisor = 0 OR n < divisor THEN
      n
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(n - divisor, divisor, fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  source_div(n, divisor: nat): nat =
    IF divisor = 0 THEN
      n + 1
    ELSE
      quotient_aux(n, divisor, n + 1)
    ENDIF

  source_mod(n, divisor: nat): nat =
    IF divisor = 0 THEN
      n
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(n, divisor, n + 1)
    ENDIF

  let_clause_1034_statement: bool =
    FORALL (n, m, p: nat):
      0 < p IMPLIES
        FORALL (x2515, x2516: nat):
          x2515 =
            source_mod(x2515, x2516)
              + x2516 * source_div(x2515, x2516)

        congruent(y, z, p) IMPLIES
          congruent(x, z, p)

% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
% div_mod.axiom_div_aux_body_S (catalog title
% "div_mod.axiom_div_aux_body_S"): at every successor natural index, the
% auxiliary division body is related by the source equality to the curried
% function returning zero when m <= n and otherwise one plus the preceding
% auxiliary division value after truncated subtraction. This file contains no
% proof.

div_mod_axiom_div_aux_body_S: THEORY
BEGIN
  connectives_equal:
    [[nat -> [nat -> nat]] -> [[nat -> [nat -> nat]] -> bool]]

  div_aux, div_aux_body: [nat -> [nat -> [nat -> nat]]]

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  axiom_div_aux_body_S_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      connectives_equal(div_aux_body(p + 1))
        (LAMBDA (m: nat):
          (LAMBDA (n: nat):
            IF m <= n THEN
              0
            ELSE
              div_aux(p)(nat_subtract(m, n + 1))(n) + 1
            ENDIF))

END div_mod_axiom_div_aux_body_S

open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_)

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

match-bool-type : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Bool -> A
match-bool-type case-true case-false true = case-true
match-bool-type case-true case-false false = case-false
