      (mod-aux-body (suc p))
      (\ m n ->
        match-bool-type
          m
          (mod-aux p (m - suc n) n)

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact "div_mod.div_aux_mod_aux"
-- (catalog title "div_mod.div_aux_mod_aux"): the fuel-indexed division and modulus
-- auxiliaries decompose a natural number into quotient times the successor divisor
-- plus remainder. This file contains no proof.

namespace div_mod

def modAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, n, _m => n
  | Nat.succ p, n, m =>
      if n ≤ m then n else modAux p (n - Nat.succ m) m

def divAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, _n, _m => 0
  | Nat.succ p, n, m =>
      if n ≤ m then 0 else Nat.succ (divAux p (n - Nat.succ m) m)

theorem div_aux_mod_aux :
    ∀ p n m : Nat,
      n = divAux p n m * Nat.succ m + modAux p n m := sorry

end div_mod

  the fuel-indexed natural-number division and remainder auxiliaries
  decompose every dividend as quotient times the successor of the divisor
  parameter, plus the remainder. This file contains no proof.
*)

Fixpoint div_aux (p n m : nat) {struct p} : nat :=
  match p with
  | O => O
  | S q =>
      if Nat.leb n m
      then O
      else S (div_aux q (n - S m) m)
  end.

Fixpoint mod_aux (p n m : nat) {struct p} : nat :=
  match p with
  | O => n
  | S q =>
      if Nat.leb n m
      then n
      else mod_aux q (n - S m) m
  end.

Theorem div_mod_div_aux_mod_aux :
  forall p n m : nat,
    n = div_aux p n m * S m + mod_aux p n m.

BEGIN

    FORALL (p, n, m: nat):

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact "div_mod.div_mod"
-- (catalog title "div_mod.div_mod"): division with remainder for the source's
-- fuel-recursive natural-number quotient and remainder functions. This file
-- contains no proof.

namespace div_mod

def modAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, n, _m => n
  | Nat.succ p, n, m =>
      if n ≤ m then n else modAux p (n - Nat.succ m) m

def divAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, _n, _m => 0
  | Nat.succ p, n, m =>
      if n ≤ m then 0 else Nat.succ (divAux p (n - Nat.succ m) m)

def mod (n m : Nat) : Nat :=
  match m with
  | 0 => n
  | Nat.succ p => modAux n n p

def div (n m : Nat) : Nat :=
  match m with
  | 0 => Nat.succ n
  | Nat.succ p => divAux n n p

theorem div_mod :
    ∀ n m : Nat,
      n = div n m * m + mod n m := sorry

end div_mod

-- div_mod.div_mod_spec_div_mod (catalog title

-- natural divisor, the fuel-defined quotient and remainder satisfy the
-- remainder bound and quotient-remainder decomposition. This file contains no proof.

module div_mod_spec_div_mod where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<_

data _<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero < suc n
  suc<suc : {m n : Nat} -> m < n -> suc m < suc n

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

mod-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
mod-aux zero n m = n
mod-aux (suc p) n m with leb n m
... | true = n
... | false = mod-aux p (n - suc m) m

div-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
div-aux zero n m = zero
div-aux (suc p) n m with leb n m
... | true = zero
... | false = suc (div-aux p (n - suc m) m)

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod n zero = n
naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

naturalDiv : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalDiv n zero = suc n
naturalDiv n (suc m) = div-aux n n m

record DivModSpec (n m q r : Nat) : Set where
  constructor div-mod-spec-intro
  field
    remainder-bound : r < m
    quotient-remainder-decomposition : n ≡ q * m + r

div-mod-spec-div-mod : Set
div-mod-spec-div-mod =
  (n m : Nat) ->
  zero < m ->
  DivModSpec n m (naturalDiv n m) (naturalMod n m)

    ELSE

    (index dividend divisor)

% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
% div_mod.eq_div_aux_body_S (catalog title "div_mod.eq_div_aux_body_S"):
% at every successor natural index, the auxiliary division body is
% Leibniz-equal to the curried function returning zero when m <= n and
% otherwise one plus the preceding auxiliary division value after truncated
% subtraction. This file contains no proof.

div_mod_eq_div_aux_body_S: THEORY
BEGIN
  div_aux, div_aux_body: [nat -> [nat -> [nat -> nat]]]
  binary_nat_function: TYPE = [nat -> [nat -> nat]]

  leibniz(x: binary_nat_function)(y: binary_nat_function): bool =
    FORALL (P: [binary_nat_function -> bool]): P(x) IMPLIES P(y)

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  eq_div_aux_body_S_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      leibniz(div_aux_body(p + 1))
        (LAMBDA (m: nat):
          (LAMBDA (n: nat):
            IF m <= n THEN
              0
            ELSE
              div_aux(p)(nat_subtract(m, n + 1))(n) + 1
            ENDIF))
END div_mod_eq_div_aux_body_S

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact "div_mod.eq_mod_aux"
-- (catalog title "div_mod.eq_mod_aux"): at every natural fuel index, the modulus
-- auxiliary is Leibniz-equal to its naturally filtered body. This file contains no proof.

namespace div_mod

def Leibniz (A : Type) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  forall P : A -> Prop, P x -> P y

def filterNatType (R : Type) (f : Nat -> R) (p : Nat) : R :=
  f p

def modAux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      if m <= n then m else modAux p (m - Nat.succ n) n

def modAuxBody : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      if m <= n then m else modAux p (m - Nat.succ n) n

theorem eq_mod_aux :
    forall p : Nat,
      Leibniz (Nat -> Nat -> Nat) (modAux p)
        (filterNatType (Nat -> Nat -> Nat) modAuxBody p) := sorry

end div_mod

  forall P : A -> Prop, P x -> P y

def modAux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      if m <= n then m else modAux p (m - Nat.succ n) n

      Leibniz (Nat -> Nat -> Nat) (modAuxBody (Nat.succ p))
        (fun (m n : Nat) =>
          if m <= n then m
          else modAux p (m - Nat.succ n) n) := sorry

namespace div_mod

def modAux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
  | 0, n, _m => n
  | Nat.succ p, n, m =>
      if n <= m then n else modAux p (n - Nat.succ m) m

def divAux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
  | 0, _n, _m => 0
  | Nat.succ p, n, m =>
      if n <= m then 0 else Nat.succ (divAux p (n - Nat.succ m) m)

def mod (n m : Nat) : Nat :=
  match m with
  | 0 => n
  | Nat.succ p => modAux n n p

  match m with
  | 0 => Nat.succ n
  | Nat.succ p => divAux n n p

    forall a b : Nat, div a b * b = a - mod a b := sorry

end div_mod

% div_mod.eq_times_div_minus_mod (catalog title

% division and remainder operations, the quotient times the divisor equals the
% dividend minus the remainder. This file contains no proof.

eq_times_div_minus_mod: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  div_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 OR n <= m THEN
      0
    ELSE
      div_aux(p - 1, nat_subtract(n, m + 1), m) + 1
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  mod_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 OR n <= m THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(p - 1, nat_subtract(n, m + 1), m)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  div(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n + 1
    ELSE
      div_aux(n, n, m - 1)
    ENDIF

  mod(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(n, n, m - 1)
    ENDIF

  eq_times_div_minus_mod_statement: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: nat):
      div(a, b) * b = nat_subtract(a, mod(a, b))

END eq_times_div_minus_mod

% div_mod.le_mod_aux_m_m (catalog title "div_mod.le_mod_aux_m_m"):
% for natural recursion bound p and natural inputs n and m, n <= p implies
% that the auxiliary remainder is at most m. This file contains no proof.

le_mod_aux_m_m: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  mod_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =

    FORALL (p, n, m: nat):
      n <= p IMPLIES mod_aux(p, n, m) <= m

  suc<suc : {m n : Nat} -> m < n -> suc m < suc n

leb (suc m) zero = false

mod-aux zero n m = n

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod n zero = n
naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

lt-mod-m-m : Set
lt-mod-m-m =
  (n m : Nat) ->
  zero < m ->
  naturalMod n m < m

-- natural number is zero, using the module's fuel-defined natural-number
-- remainder. This file contains no proof.

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_)

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

mod-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
mod-aux zero n m = n
mod-aux (suc p) n m with leb n m
... | true = n
... | false = mod-aux p (n - suc m) m

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod n zero = n
naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

mod-O-n : Set
mod-O-n =
  (n : Nat) ->
  naturalMod zero n ≡ zero

% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact div_mod.mod_O_n
% (catalog title "div_mod.mod_O_n"): the remainder of zero modulo any natural
% number is zero, using the source's total natural-number remainder operation.
% This file contains no proof.

mod_O_n: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  mod_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 OR n <= m THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(p - 1, nat_subtract(n, m + 1), m)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  mod(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(n, n, m - 1)
    ENDIF

  mod_O_n_statement: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      mod(0, n) = 0

END mod_O_n

  ∀ P : A → Prop, P x → P y

def filterNatType (R : Type) (f : Nat → R) (p : Nat) : R :=

  | 0, _m, _n => 0

    ∀ p : Nat,

        (filterNatType (Nat → Nat → Nat) divAuxBody p) (divAux p) := sorry

% "div_mod.sym_eq_div_aux_body_S"): at every successor natural index,
% Leibniz equality relates the curried function returning zero when m <= n
% and otherwise one plus the preceding auxiliary division value after
% truncated subtraction to the auxiliary division body. This file contains
% no proof.

div_mod_sym_eq_div_aux_body_S: THEORY
BEGIN
  div_aux, div_aux_body: [nat -> [nat -> [nat -> nat]]]
  binary_nat_function: TYPE = [nat -> [nat -> nat]]

  leibniz(x: binary_nat_function)(y: binary_nat_function): bool =
    FORALL (P: [binary_nat_function -> bool]): P(x) IMPLIES P(y)

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  sym_eq_div_aux_body_S_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      leibniz(
        (LAMBDA (m: nat):
          (LAMBDA (n: nat):
            IF m <= n THEN
              0
            ELSE
              div_aux(p)(nat_subtract(m, n + 1))(n) + 1
            ENDIF)))
        (div_aux_body(p + 1))
END div_mod_sym_eq_div_aux_body_S

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact "div_mod.sym_eq_mod_aux"
-- (catalog title "div_mod.sym_eq_mod_aux"): at every natural fuel index, the naturally
-- filtered modulus body is Leibniz-equal to the modulus auxiliary. This file contains no proof.

namespace div_mod

def Leibniz (A : Type) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  forall P : A -> Prop, P x -> P y

def filterNatType (R : Type) (f : Nat -> R) (p : Nat) : R :=
  f p

def modAux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      if m <= n then m else modAux p (m - Nat.succ n) n

def modAuxBody : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      if m <= n then m else modAux p (m - Nat.succ n) n

theorem sym_eq_mod_aux :
    forall p : Nat,
      Leibniz (Nat -> Nat -> Nat)
        (filterNatType (Nat -> Nat -> Nat) modAuxBody p) (modAux p) := sorry

end div_mod

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- "div_mod.sym_eq_mod_aux_body_S" (catalog title "div_mod.sym_eq_mod_aux_body_S"):
-- Leibniz equality identifies the Boolean-controlled recursive remainder step with
-- the concrete successor-indexed modulus auxiliary body. This file contains no proof.

namespace div_mod

def Leibniz (A : Type) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  forall P : A -> Prop, P x -> P y

def modAux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      if m <= n then m else modAux p (m - Nat.succ n) n

def modAuxBody : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      if m <= n then m else modAux p (m - Nat.succ n) n

theorem sym_eq_mod_aux_body_S :
    forall p : Nat,
      Leibniz (Nat -> Nat -> Nat)
        (fun (m n : Nat) =>
          if m <= n then m
          else modAux p (m - Nat.succ n) n)
        (modAuxBody (Nat.succ p)) := sorry

end div_mod

  natural-number function that returns the dividend when it is at most the
  divisor and otherwise recursively computes the auxiliary remainder is

theory sym_eq_mod_aux_body_S
  imports Main
begin

definition logipedia_leibniz :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "logipedia_leibniz x y \<equiv>
    (\<forall>P :: 'a \<Rightarrow> bool. P x \<longrightarrow> P y)"

    logipedia_leibniz
      (\<lambda>m n.
        if m \<le> n
        then m
        else mod_aux p (m - Suc n) n)
      (mod_aux_body (Suc p) :: nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat)"

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- div_mod.sym_eq_mod_aux_body_S (catalog title
-- "div_mod.sym_eq_mod_aux_body_S"): at every successor recursion index, the
-- binary natural-number function that returns its first input when it is at
-- most its second, and otherwise returns the recursive auxiliary remainder,
-- is Leibniz-equal to the auxiliary modulus body. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module sym_eq_mod_aux_body_S where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_)

Leibniz :
  {level : Level} ->
  (A : Set level) ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set (lsuc level)
Leibniz {level} A x y =
  (P : A -> Set level) ->
  P x ->
  P y

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

match-bool-type : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Bool -> A
match-bool-type case-true case-false true = case-true
match-bool-type case-true case-false false = case-false

module Statement
  (mod-aux mod-aux-body : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat) where

  sym-eq-mod-aux-body-S : Set₁
  sym-eq-mod-aux-body-S =
    (p : Nat) ->
    Leibniz
      (Nat -> Nat -> Nat)
      (\ m n ->
        match-bool-type
          m
          (mod-aux p (m - suc n) n)
          (leb m n))
      (mod-aux-body (suc p))

% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
% div_mod.sym_eq_mod_aux_body_S (catalog title
% "div_mod.sym_eq_mod_aux_body_S"): at every successor natural index,
% Leibniz equality relates the curried function returning m when m <= n and
% otherwise the preceding auxiliary remainder value after truncated
% subtraction to the auxiliary remainder body. This file contains no proof.

div_mod_sym_eq_mod_aux_body_S: THEORY
BEGIN
  mod_aux, mod_aux_body: [nat -> [nat -> [nat -> nat]]]
  binary_nat_function: TYPE = [nat -> [nat -> nat]]

  leibniz(x: binary_nat_function)(y: binary_nat_function): bool =
    FORALL (P: [binary_nat_function -> bool]): P(x) IMPLIES P(y)

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  sym_eq_mod_aux_body_S_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      leibniz(
        (LAMBDA (m: nat):
          (LAMBDA (n: nat):
            IF m <= n THEN
              m
            ELSE
              mod_aux(p)(nat_subtract(m, n + 1))(n)
            ENDIF)))
        (mod_aux_body(p + 1))
END div_mod_sym_eq_mod_aux_body_S

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- exp.sym_eq_exp_body_S (catalog title "exp.sym_eq_exp_body_S"): for every
-- pair of natural numbers, the exponentiation value multiplied by the first
-- is Leibniz-equal to the exponentiation body at the successor of the second.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module sym_eq_exp_body_S where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; suc; _*_)

Leibniz :
  {level : Level} ->
  (A : Set level) ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set (lsuc level)
Leibniz {level} A x y =
  (P : A -> Set level) ->
  P x ->
  P y

module Statement
  (exp exp-body : Nat -> Nat -> Nat) where

  sym-eq-exp-body-S : Set₁
  sym-eq-exp-body-S =
    (n m : Nat) ->
    Leibniz Nat ((exp n m) * n) (exp-body n (suc m))

val logipedia_exp_operator_type =

val exp_sym_eq_exp_body_S =

title: sym_eq_exp_body_S
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
  exp.sym_eq_exp_body_S (logipedia__metamath__exp.sym_eq_exp_body_S),
  catalog title "exp.sym_eq_exp_body_S": for all natural numbers n and m,
  exp at n and m multiplied by n is Leibniz equal to exp_body at n and the
  successor of m. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  LogExp and LogExpBody represent the fixed source constants of type

    NN0 -> NN0 -> NN0.

  LogNatUnaryFunction and LogNatBinaryFunction explicitly encode those
  curried function spaces. SetMM's m + 1 is the source successor nat.S m,
  and SetMM multiplication preserves the source argument order
  nat.times (exp n m) n. A predicate on the natural-number carrier is
  represented extensionally by a subset p of NN0. Thus universal transport
  of membership from (exp n m) * n to exp_body n (S m) is exactly the source
  definition of leibniz.leibniz at nat.nat. Every declaration is an unproved
  $a statement encoding; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c LogExp LogExpBody LogNatUnaryFunction LogNatBinaryFunction $.

log-exp-syntax $a class ( LogExp ) $.
log-exp-body-syntax $a class ( LogExpBody ) $.
log-nat-unary-function-syntax $a class ( LogNatUnaryFunction ) $.
log-nat-binary-function-syntax $a class ( LogNatBinaryFunction ) $.

log-nat-unary-function-definition $a |-
  ( LogNatUnaryFunction ) = ( NN0 ^m NN0 )
$.

log-nat-binary-function-definition $a |-
  ( LogNatBinaryFunction ) =
    ( ( LogNatUnaryFunction ) ^m NN0 )
$.

${
  $d m n p $.

  logipedia-exp-sym-eq-exp-body-s $a |-
    (
      (
        ( LogExp ) e. ( LogNatBinaryFunction )
        /\
        ( LogExpBody ) e. ( LogNatBinaryFunction )
      )
      /\
      A. n e. NN0 A. m e. NN0
        A. p e. ~P NN0
          (
            ( ( ( ( LogExp ` n ) ` m ) x. n ) e. p )
            ->
            ( ( ( LogExpBody ` n ) ` ( m + 1 ) ) e. p )
          )
    )
  $.
$}

environ

    RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_3, ORDINAL1,
    CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, NAT_1;

    NAT_1, XTUPLE_0;
  theorems FUNCT_2;
  requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM, REAL;

begin

:: These projections represent the fixed, independently unconstrained source
:: declarations exp and exp_body.
definition
  func Aux -> Function of NAT,Funcs(NAT,NAT) equals
    (pr1(
      Funcs(NAT,Funcs(NAT,NAT)),
      Funcs(NAT,Funcs(NAT,NAT))

  coherence by FUNCT_2:66;

::$P-
theorem

    (for P being Subset of NAT st

-- "fermat.congruent_exp_pred_SO" (catalog title "fermat.congruent_exp_pred_SO"):
-- Fermat's little theorem in congruence form for a prime natural modulus and
-- a base not divisible by that prime. This file contains no proof.

namespace fermat

def divides (n m : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ q : Nat, m = n * q

def prime (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  1 < n ∧ ∀ m : Nat, divides m n → 1 < m → m = n

def congruent (n m p : Nat) : Prop :=

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
  fermat.congruent_exp_pred_SO (catalog title
  "fermat.congruent_exp_pred_SO"): Fermat's little theorem states that a
  natural number not divisible by a natural prime has predecessor-prime
  power congruent to one modulo that prime. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition fermat_divides (n m : nat) : Prop :=
  exists q : nat, m = n * q.

Definition fermat_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  1 < p /\
  forall m : nat,
    fermat_divides m p ->
    1 < m ->
    m = p.

Fixpoint fermat_exp (a n : nat) : nat :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k => fermat_exp a k * a
  end.

Definition fermat_mod (n p : nat) : nat :=
  match p with
  | O => n
  | S p' => Nat.modulo n (S p')
  end.

Definition fermat_congruent (n m p : nat) : Prop :=
  fermat_mod n p = fermat_mod m p.

Theorem congruent_exp_pred_SO :
  forall p a : nat,
    fermat_prime p ->
    ~ fermat_divides p a ->
    fermat_congruent (fermat_exp a (Nat.pred p)) 1 p.
Admitted.

  Fermat's little theorem for natural numbers, stated as congruence of
  a^(p - 1) to 1 modulo a prime p that does not divide a. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory congruent_exp_pred_SO
  imports Main
begin

definition logipedia_divides :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "logipedia_divides n m \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>q :: nat. m = n * q)"

definition logipedia_prime :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "logipedia_prime p \<longleftrightarrow>
    1 < p \<and>
    (\<forall>m :: nat. logipedia_divides m p \<longrightarrow> 1 < m \<longrightarrow> m = p)"

definition congruent :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "congruent n m p \<longleftrightarrow> n mod p = m mod p"

theorem congruent_exp_pred_SO:
  fixes p a :: nat
  assumes "logipedia_prime p"
    and "\<not> logipedia_divides p a"
  shows "congruent (a ^ (p - 1)) 1 p"
  sorry

end

-- for a prime natural modulus that does not divide a natural base, the base

-- This file contains no proof.

module congruent_exp_pred_SO where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _*_; mod-helper)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 2 _∧_
infix 4 _<_ Divides Congruent

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Empty

data _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  _,_ : A -> B -> A ∧ B

data _<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero < suc n
  suc<suc : {m n : Nat} -> m < n -> suc m < suc n

pred : Nat -> Nat
pred zero = zero
pred (suc n) = n

exp : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
exp n zero = suc zero
exp n (suc m) = exp n m * n

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor dividend =
  Σ Nat (\ quotient -> dividend ≡ divisor * quotient)

Prime : Nat -> Set
Prime p =
  (suc zero < p) ∧
  ((m : Nat) -> Divides m p -> suc zero < m -> m ≡ p)

Congruent : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
Congruent n m p =
  naturalMod n p ≡ naturalMod m p

congruent-exp-pred-SO : Set
congruent-exp-pred-SO =
  (p a : Nat) ->
  Prime p ->
  Not (Divides p a) ->
  Congruent (exp a (pred p)) (suc zero) p

% Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia artifact
% fermat.congruent_exp_pred_SO, catalog title "fermat.congruent_exp_pred_SO":
% Fermat's little theorem states that a natural number not divisible by a
% prime p has its (p - 1)-st power congruent to 1 modulo p. This file contains
% no proof.

congruent_exp_pred_SO: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    1 < value
      AND (FORALL (divisor: nat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value) IMPLIES
          (1 < divisor IMPLIES divisor = value))

  source_pred(value: nat): nat =
    IF value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE value - 1 ENDIF

  source_mod(value, modulus: nat): nat =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (remainder: nat):
        (modulus = 0 AND remainder = value)
          OR (0 < modulus AND remainder < modulus
            AND EXISTS (quotient: nat):
              value = quotient * modulus + remainder))

  congruent(left, right, modulus: nat): bool =
    source_mod(left, modulus) = source_mod(right, modulus)

  congruent_exp_pred_SO_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p, a: nat):
      prime_nat(p) IMPLIES
        (NOT nat_divides(p, a) IMPLIES
          congruent(a ^ source_pred(p), 1, p))

END congruent_exp_pred_SO

    Nat → (Nat → Bool) → H → (H → H → H) → (Nat → H) → H

      | false => bigop H n p nil op f

def congruent (left right modulus : Nat) : Prop :=
  left % modulus = right % modulus

theorem congruent_pi :

  match n with

  | S p' => Nat.modulo n (S p')

  (n : Nat) ->
  factorial n ≡
    bigop
      (suc n - suc zero)
      (\ _ -> true)
      (suc zero)

% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact fermat.eq_fact_pi_p
% (catalog title "fermat.eq_fact_pi_p"): every natural factorial equals the
% filtered prefix product of the successive positive naturals. This file
% contains no proof.

fermat_eq_fact_pi_p: THEORY
BEGIN

  source_equal(left, right: nat): bool =
    FORALL (property: [nat -> bool]):
      property(left) IMPLIES property(right)

  source_factorial(value: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF value = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      source_factorial(value - 1) * value
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  source_bigop(
      count: nat,
      predicate: [nat -> bool],
      nil: nat,
      op: [nat -> [nat -> nat]],
      value: [nat -> nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      nil
    ELSIF predicate(count - 1) THEN
      op(value(count - 1))(
        source_bigop(count - 1, predicate, nil, op, value))
    ELSE
      source_bigop(count - 1, predicate, nil, op, value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  eq_fact_pi_p_statement: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      source_equal(
        source_factorial(n),
        source_bigop(
          (n + 1) - 1,
          (LAMBDA (i: nat): TRUE),
          1,
          (LAMBDA (left: nat):
            (LAMBDA (right: nat): left * right)),
          (LAMBDA (i: nat): i + 1)))

END fermat_eq_fact_pi_p

namespace fermat

def divides (n m : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ q : Nat, m = n * q

def prime (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  1 < n ∧ ∀ m : Nat, divides m n → 1 < m → m = n

  ∀ i j : Nat, i ≤ n → j ≤ n → f i = f j → i = j

  (∀ i : Nat, i ≤ n → f i ≤ n) ∧ injn f n

theorem permut_mod :
    ∀ p a : Nat, prime p → ¬divides p a →
      permut (fun n : Nat => (a * n) % p) (Nat.pred p) := sorry

end fermat

(*

  fermat.permut_mod (catalog title "fermat.permut_mod"): multiplication by
  a natural number not divisible by a natural prime, followed by reduction
  modulo that prime, permutes the naturals from zero through the prime's
  predecessor. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition fermat_divides (n m : nat) : Prop :=
  exists q : nat, m = n * q.

Definition fermat_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  1 < p /\
  forall m : nat,
    fermat_divides m p ->
    1 < m ->
    m = p.

Definition fermat_mod (n p : nat) : nat :=
  match p with
  | O => n
  | S p' => Nat.modulo n (S p')
  end.

Definition fermat_injn (f : nat -> nat) (m : nat) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    i <= m ->
    j <= m ->
    f i = f j ->
    i = j.

Definition fermat_permut (f : nat -> nat) (m : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i : nat, i <= m -> f i <= m) /\
  fermat_injn f m.

Theorem permut_mod :
  forall p a : nat,
    fermat_prime p ->
    ~ fermat_divides p a ->
    fermat_permut
      (fun n : nat => fermat_mod (a * n) p)
      (Nat.pred p).
Admitted.

-- not divisible by a prime, followed by reduction modulo that prime, permutes
-- the naturals from zero through the prime's predecessor. This file contains

module permut_mod where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _*_; mod-helper)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 2 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_ Divides

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Empty

data _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  _,_ : A -> B -> A ∧ B

data _≤_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} -> zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} -> m ≤ n -> suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

pred : Nat -> Nat
pred zero = zero
pred (suc n) = n

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor dividend =
  Σ Nat (\ quotient -> dividend ≡ divisor * quotient)

Prime : Nat -> Set
Prime p =
  (suc zero < p) ∧
  ((m : Nat) -> Divides m p -> suc zero < m -> m ≡ p)

Injn : (Nat -> Nat) -> Nat -> Set
Injn f bound =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i ≤ bound ->
  j ≤ bound ->
  f i ≡ f j ->
  i ≡ j

Permut : (Nat -> Nat) -> Nat -> Set
Permut f bound =
  ((i : Nat) -> i ≤ bound -> f i ≤ bound) ∧
  Injn f bound

permut-mod : Set
permut-mod =
  (p a : Nat) ->
  Prime p ->
  Not (Divides p a) ->
  Permut
    (\ n -> naturalMod (a * n) p)
    (pred p)

% Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
% fermat.permut_mod, catalog title "fermat.permut_mod": multiplication by a
% natural not divisible by a prime p, followed by reduction modulo p, permutes
% the natural prefix from 0 through p - 1. This file contains no proof.

fermat_permut_mod: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    1 < value
      AND (FORALL (divisor: nat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value) IMPLIES
          (1 < divisor IMPLIES divisor = value))

  source_pred(value: nat): nat =
    IF value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE value - 1 ENDIF

  source_mod(value, modulus: nat): nat =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (remainder: nat):
        (modulus = 0 AND remainder = value)
          OR (0 < modulus AND remainder < modulus
            AND EXISTS (quotient: nat):
              value = quotient * modulus + remainder))

  prefix_permutation(f: [nat -> nat], upper: nat): bool =
    (FORALL (i: nat):
      i <= upper IMPLIES f(i) <= upper)
      AND (FORALL (i, j: nat):
        i <= upper IMPLIES
          (j <= upper IMPLIES
            (f(i) = f(j) IMPLIES i = j)))

  permut_mod_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p, a: nat):
      prime_nat(p) IMPLIES
        (NOT nat_divides(p, a) IMPLIES
          prefix_permutation(
            LAMBDA (n: nat): source_mod(a * n, p),
            source_pred(p)))

END fermat_permut_mod

  fermat.prime_to_not_divides_fact (catalog title
  "fermat.prime_to_not_divides_fact"): if n is less than a natural prime p,
  then p does not divide n factorial. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition fermat_divides (n m : nat) : Prop :=
  exists q : nat, m = n * q.

Definition fermat_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  1 < p /\
  forall m : nat,
    fermat_divides m p ->
    1 < m ->
    m = p.

Fixpoint fermat_fact (n : nat) : nat :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k => fermat_fact k * S k
  end.

Theorem prime_to_not_divides_fact :
  forall p : nat,
    fermat_prime p ->
    forall n : nat,
      n < p ->
      ~ fermat_divides p (fermat_fact n).
Admitted.

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- fermat.prime_to_not_divides_fact (catalog title
-- "fermat.prime_to_not_divides_fact"): a prime natural number does not divide
-- the factorial of any smaller natural number. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module prime_to_not_divides_fact where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 2 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_ Divides

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Empty

data _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  _,_ : A -> B -> A ∧ B

data _≤_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} -> zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} -> m ≤ n -> suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor dividend =
  Σ Nat (\ quotient -> dividend ≡ divisor * quotient)

Prime : Nat -> Set
Prime p =
  (suc zero < p) ∧
  ((m : Nat) -> Divides m p -> suc zero < m -> m ≡ p)

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  factorial n * suc n

prime-to-not-divides-fact : Set
prime-to-not-divides-fact =
  (p : Nat) ->
  Prime p ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  n < p ->
  Not (Divides p (factorial n))

title: prime_to_not_divides_fact
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
% fermat.prime_to_not_divides_fact, catalog title
% "fermat.prime_to_not_divides_fact": a prime natural p does not divide n!
% when n is a natural smaller than p. This file contains no proof.

fermat_prime_to_not_divides_fact: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    1 < value
      AND (FORALL (divisor: nat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value) IMPLIES
          (1 < divisor IMPLIES divisor = value))

  source_factorial(value: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF value = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      source_factorial(value - 1) * value
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  prime_to_not_divides_fact_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      prime_nat(p) IMPLIES
        (FORALL (n: nat):
          n < p IMPLIES
            NOT nat_divides(p, source_factorial(n)))

END fermat_prime_to_not_divides_fact

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- "gcd.axiom_gcd_aux_body_S" (catalog title "gcd.axiom_gcd_aux_body_S"):
-- at every successor recursion index, the concrete auxiliary
-- greatest-common-divisor body unfolds to its divisibility test and preceding
-- fuel-recursive call. This file contains no proof.

namespace gcd

def dividesb (n m : Nat) : Bool :=
  m % n == 0

def gcdAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      bif dividesb n m then n else gcdAux p n (m % n)

def gcdAuxBody : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      bif dividesb n m then n else gcdAux p n (m % n)

theorem axiom_gcd_aux_body_S :
    ∀ p : Nat,
      gcdAuxBody (Nat.succ p) =
        fun (m n : Nat) ↦
          bif dividesb n m then n else gcdAux p n (m % n) := sorry

end gcd

  its successor to the binary function that returns the second input when it
  divides the first, and otherwise recurses on the remainder. This file

Parameter connectives_equal : forall A : Type, A -> A -> Prop.
Parameter gcd_aux gcd_aux_body : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat.
Parameter modulo : nat -> nat -> nat.
Parameter dividesb : nat -> nat -> bool.

  forall p : nat,
    connectives_equal
      (nat -> nat -> nat)

  index equals the curried step function selected by the source divisibility
  test. This file contains no proof.

  imports Main
begin

primrec logipedia_mod_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod_aux 0 n m = n"
| "logipedia_mod_aux (Suc p) n m =
    (if n \<le> m then n else logipedia_mod_aux p (n - Suc m) m)"

definition logipedia_mod :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod n m =
    (case m of
      0 \<Rightarrow> n
    | Suc p \<Rightarrow> logipedia_mod_aux n n p)"

definition logipedia_match_bool_type :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> 'a"
where
  "logipedia_match_bool_type case_true case_false b =
    (if b then case_true else case_false)"

definition logipedia_dividesb :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "logipedia_dividesb n m = (logipedia_mod m n = 0)"

consts

  gcd_aux_body :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"

theorem axiom_gcd_aux_body_S:
  "\<forall>p :: nat.
    (gcd_aux_body (Suc p) :: nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat) =
      (\<lambda>m :: nat. \<lambda>n :: nat.
        logipedia_match_bool_type
          n
          (gcd_aux p n (logipedia_mod m n))
          (logipedia_dividesb n m))"

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- gcd.axiom_gcd_aux_body_S (catalog title "gcd.axiom_gcd_aux_body_S"):
-- at every successor recursion index, the auxiliary greatest-common-divisor
-- body equals the binary natural-number function that returns the second input
-- when it divides the first, and otherwise applies the preceding auxiliary
-- function to that input and their remainder. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module axiom_gcd_aux_body_S where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

eqb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
eqb zero zero = true
eqb zero (suc n) = false
eqb (suc m) zero = false
eqb (suc m) (suc n) = eqb m n

match-bool-type : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Bool -> A
match-bool-type case-true case-false true = case-true
match-bool-type case-true case-false false = case-false

module Statement
  (equal : (A : Set) -> A -> A -> Set)
  (mod-aux gcd-aux gcd-aux-body : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat) where

  naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
  naturalMod n zero = n
  naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

  dividesb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
  dividesb n m = eqb (naturalMod m n) zero

  axiom-gcd-aux-body-S : Set
  axiom-gcd-aux-body-S =
    (p : Nat) ->
    equal
      (Nat -> Nat -> Nat)
      (gcd-aux-body (suc p))
      (\ m n ->
        match-bool-type
          n
          (gcd-aux p n (naturalMod m n))
          (dividesb n m))

% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
% gcd.axiom_gcd_aux_body_S (catalog title "gcd.axiom_gcd_aux_body_S"): at
% every successor natural index, the auxiliary gcd body is related by the
% source equality to the curried divisibility case split between the divisor
% and the preceding auxiliary gcd call on the remainder. This file contains
% no proof.

gcd_axiom_gcd_aux_body_S: THEORY
BEGIN
  connectives_equal: [[nat -> [nat -> nat]] -> [[nat -> [nat -> nat]] -> bool]]

  gcd_aux, gcd_aux_body: [nat -> [nat -> [nat -> nat]]]

  equal_leibniz_assumption: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: [nat -> [nat -> nat]]):
      connectives_equal(x)(y) IMPLIES
        (FORALL (P: [[nat -> [nat -> nat]] -> bool]):
          P(x) IMPLIES P(y))

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  mod_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 OR n <= m THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(p - 1, nat_subtract(n, m + 1), m)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  mod(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(n, n, m - 1)
    ENDIF

  dividesb(n, m: nat): bool =
    mod(m, n) = 0

  axiom_gcd_aux_body_S_statement: bool =
    equal_leibniz_assumption IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p: nat):
        connectives_equal(gcd_aux_body(p + 1))
          (LAMBDA (m: nat):
            (LAMBDA (n: nat):
              IF dividesb(n, m) THEN
                n
              ELSE
                gcd_aux(p)(n)(mod(m, n))
              ENDIF)))

END gcd_axiom_gcd_aux_body_S

;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; gcd.commutative_gcd, catalog title "gcd.commutative_gcd": the module's
;; natural-number greatest common divisor is commutative. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source remainder is totalized by mod(dividend, 0) = dividend.

(defun logipedia-gcd-commutative-gcd-mod (dividend divisor)
  (if (zp divisor)
      (nfix dividend)
    (mod (nfix dividend) (nfix divisor))))

;; This bounded Euclidean recursion is the source module's gcd_aux: index zero
;; returns the dividend; a successor returns the divisor when it divides the
;; dividend and otherwise recurses on the corresponding remainder.

(defun logipedia-gcd-commutative-gcd-aux
    (index dividend divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (zp index)
      (nfix dividend)
    (if (equal
         (logipedia-gcd-commutative-gcd-mod dividend divisor)
         0)
        (nfix divisor)
      (logipedia-gcd-commutative-gcd-aux
       (- (nfix index) 1)
       (nfix divisor)
       (logipedia-gcd-commutative-gcd-mod
        dividend divisor)))))

;; The source gcd selects the bounded call whose recursion index is the
;; smaller input.

(defun logipedia-gcd-commutative-gcd (n m)
  (if (<= (nfix n) (nfix m))
      (logipedia-gcd-commutative-gcd-aux
       (nfix n) (nfix m) (nfix n))
    (logipedia-gcd-commutative-gcd-aux
     (nfix m) (nfix n) (nfix m))))

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-commutative-gcd-statement ()
  (forall (n m)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp m))
     (equal
      (logipedia-gcd-commutative-gcd n m)
      (logipedia-gcd-commutative-gcd m n)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- "gcd.divides_gcd_aux_mn" (catalog title "gcd.divides_gcd_aux_mn"):
-- for natural numbers p, m, and positive n with n ≤ m and n ≤ p, the source

namespace gcd

def gcdAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m

      if n ∣ m then n else gcdAux p n (m % n)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
  gcd.divides_gcd_aux_mn (catalog title "gcd.divides_gcd_aux_mn"): for
  natural numbers p, m, and positive n with n at most m and p, the
  fuel-recursive auxiliary gcd value divides both m and n. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Fixpoint gcd_aux (p m n : nat) : nat :=
  match p with
  | O => m
  | S q =>
      if Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo m n) O
      then n
      else gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n)
  end.

Definition gcd_divides (divisor value : nat) : Prop :=
  exists quotient : nat, value = divisor * quotient.

Theorem divides_gcd_aux_mn :
  forall p m n : nat,
    O < n ->
    n <= m ->
    n <= p ->
    gcd_divides (gcd_aux p m n) m /\
    gcd_divides (gcd_aux p m n) n.
Admitted.

  gcd.divides_gcd_aux_mn, catalog title "gcd.divides_gcd_aux_mn": for positive
  natural n bounded above by m and by the recursion index p, the recursively
  specified auxiliary gcd value gcd_aux p m n divides both m and n. This file
  contains no proof.

theory divides_gcd_aux_mn
  imports Main
begin

primrec logipedia_mod_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod_aux 0 n m = n"
| "logipedia_mod_aux (Suc p) n m =
    (if n \<le> m then n else logipedia_mod_aux p (n - Suc m) m)"

definition logipedia_mod :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod n m =
    (case m of
      0 \<Rightarrow> n
    | Suc p \<Rightarrow> logipedia_mod_aux n n p)"

definition logipedia_dividesb :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "logipedia_dividesb n m = (logipedia_mod m n = 0)"

fun gcd_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "gcd_aux 0 m n = m"
| "gcd_aux (Suc p) m n =
    (if logipedia_dividesb n m
     then n
     else gcd_aux p n (logipedia_mod m n))"

theorem divides_gcd_aux_mn:
  "\<forall>p m n :: nat.
    0 < n \<longrightarrow>
    n \<le> m \<longrightarrow>
    n \<le> p \<longrightarrow>
    gcd_aux p m n dvd m \<and> gcd_aux p m n dvd n"
  sorry

end

;; gcd.divides_gcd_aux_mn, catalog title "gcd.divides_gcd_aux_mn": for

;; auxiliary Euclidean gcd divides both m and n. This file contains no proof.

  (if (zp divisor)
      (nfix dividend)

    (divisor dividend)
  (equal
   (logipedia-gcd-divides-gcd-aux-mn-mod dividend divisor)
   0))

;; dividend; positive fuel returns the divisor when its Boolean divisibility
;; test succeeds and otherwise recurses on the corresponding remainder.

(defun logipedia-gcd-divides-gcd-aux-mn-aux
    (fuel dividend divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))

    (if

         divisor dividend)
        (nfix divisor)

       (- (nfix fuel) 1)

       (logipedia-gcd-divides-gcd-aux-mn-mod

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- gcd.divides_gcd_aux_mn (catalog title "gcd.divides_gcd_aux_mn"): for
-- natural p, m, and positive n with n bounded by m and p, the auxiliary
-- greatest-common-divisor value divides both m and n. This file contains no
-- proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module divides_gcd_aux_mn where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 2 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_ Divides

data _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  _,_ : A -> B -> A ∧ B

data _≤_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} -> zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} -> m ≤ n -> suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor dividend =
  Σ Nat (\ quotient -> dividend ≡ divisor * quotient)

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

eqb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
eqb zero zero = true
eqb zero (suc n) = false
eqb (suc m) zero = false
eqb (suc m) (suc n) = eqb m n

mod-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
mod-aux zero n m = n
mod-aux (suc p) n m with leb n m
... | true = n
... | false = mod-aux p (n - suc m) m

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod n zero = n
naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

dividesb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
dividesb n m = eqb (naturalMod m n) zero

gcd-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd-aux zero m n = m
gcd-aux (suc p) m n with dividesb n m
... | true = n
... | false = gcd-aux p n (naturalMod m n)

divides-gcd-aux-mn : Set
divides-gcd-aux-mn =
  (p m n : Nat) ->
  zero < n ->
  n ≤ m ->
  n ≤ p ->
  Divides (gcd-aux p m n) m ∧
  Divides (gcd-aux p m n) n

;; gcd.divides_gcd_r, catalog title "gcd.divides_gcd_r": for all natural

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source remainder is totalized by mod(dividend, 0) = dividend.

(defun logipedia-gcd-divides-gcd-r-mod (dividend divisor)
  (if (zp divisor)
      (nfix dividend)
    (mod (nfix dividend) (nfix divisor))))

;; returns the dividend; a successor returns the divisor when it divides the
;; dividend and otherwise recurses on the corresponding remainder.

    (index dividend divisor)

         0)

       (- (nfix index) 1)

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact

-- numbers n and m, their greatest common divisor divides m. This file
-- contains no proof.

module divides_gcd_r where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 Divides

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor dividend =
  Σ Nat (\ quotient -> dividend ≡ divisor * quotient)

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

eqb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
eqb zero zero = true
eqb zero (suc n) = false
eqb (suc m) zero = false
eqb (suc m) (suc n) = eqb m n

match-bool-type : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Bool -> A
match-bool-type case-true case-false true = case-true
match-bool-type case-true case-false false = case-false

mod-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
mod-aux zero n m = n
mod-aux (suc p) n m with leb n m
... | true = n
... | false = mod-aux p (n - suc m) m

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod n zero = n
naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

dividesb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
dividesb n m = eqb (naturalMod m n) zero

gcd-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd-aux zero m n = m
gcd-aux (suc p) m n with dividesb n m
... | true = n
... | false = gcd-aux p n (naturalMod m n)

gcd : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd n m =
  match-bool-type
    (gcd-aux n m n)
    (gcd-aux m n m)
    (leb n m)

divides-gcd-r : Set
divides-gcd-r =
  (n m : Nat) ->
  Divides (gcd n m) m

% gcd.divides_times_to_divides (catalog title "gcd.divides_times_to_divides"):

% This file contains no proof.

BEGIN

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):

-- for positive natural numbers p and n, if n divides m, then the fuel-recursive
-- greatest-common-divisor auxiliary applied to p, m, and n returns n.
-- This file contains no proof.

namespace gcd

def gcdAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      if n ∣ m then n else gcdAux p n (m % n)

theorem divides_to_gcd_aux :
    ∀ p m n : Nat, 0 < p → 0 < n → n ∣ m → gcdAux p m n = n := sorry

(*

  gcd.divides_to_gcd_aux (catalog title "gcd.divides_to_gcd_aux"): for
  natural numbers p, m, and n, if p and n are positive and n divides m, then
  the fuel-recursive auxiliary gcd value at p, m, and n equals n. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Fixpoint gcd_aux (p m n : nat) : nat :=
  match p with
  | O => m
  | S q =>
      if Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo m n) O
      then n
      else gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n)
  end.

Definition gcd_divides (divisor value : nat) : Prop :=
  exists quotient : nat, value = divisor * quotient.

Theorem divides_to_gcd_aux :
  forall p m n : nat,
    O < p ->
    O < n ->
    gcd_divides n m ->
    gcd_aux p m n = n.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
  gcd.divides_to_gcd_aux, catalog title "gcd.divides_to_gcd_aux": for positive
  natural numbers p and n, if n divides m then the fuel-indexed auxiliary gcd
  computation gcd_aux p m n returns n. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory divides_to_gcd_aux
  imports Main
begin

primrec logipedia_mod_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod_aux 0 n m = n"
| "logipedia_mod_aux (Suc p) n m =
    (if n \<le> m then n else logipedia_mod_aux p (n - Suc m) m)"

definition logipedia_mod :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod n m =
    (case m of
      0 \<Rightarrow> n
    | Suc p \<Rightarrow> logipedia_mod_aux n n p)"

definition logipedia_dividesb :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "logipedia_dividesb n m = (logipedia_mod m n = 0)"

fun gcd_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "gcd_aux 0 m n = m"
| "gcd_aux (Suc p) m n =
    (if logipedia_dividesb n m
     then n
     else gcd_aux p n (logipedia_mod m n))"

theorem divides_to_gcd_aux:
  "\<forall>p m n :: nat.
    0 < p \<longrightarrow>
    0 < n \<longrightarrow>
    n dvd m \<longrightarrow>
    gcd_aux p m n = n"
  sorry

end

;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; gcd.divides_to_gcd_aux, catalog title "gcd.divides_to_gcd_aux": for
;; natural p, m, and n, if p and n are positive and n divides m, the module's
;; fuel-bounded auxiliary Euclidean gcd at p, m, and n equals n. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source remainder is totalized by mod(dividend, 0) = dividend.

(defun logipedia-gcd-divides-to-gcd-aux-mod (dividend divisor)
  (if (zp divisor)
      (nfix dividend)
    (mod (nfix dividend) (nfix divisor))))

;; This is the source module's gcd_aux recursion: zero fuel returns the
;; dividend; positive fuel returns the divisor when it divides the dividend
;; and otherwise recurses on the corresponding remainder.

(defun logipedia-gcd-divides-to-gcd-aux
    (fuel dividend divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (zp fuel)
      (nfix dividend)
    (if (equal
         (logipedia-gcd-divides-to-gcd-aux-mod
          dividend divisor)
         0)
        (nfix divisor)
      (logipedia-gcd-divides-to-gcd-aux
       (- (nfix fuel) 1)
       (nfix divisor)
       (logipedia-gcd-divides-to-gcd-aux-mod
        dividend divisor)))))

;; Source divisibility is the existence of a natural quotient.

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-divides-to-gcd-aux-divides-p
    (divisor dividend)
  (exists (quotient)
    (and
     (natp divisor)
     (natp dividend)
     (natp quotient)
     (equal dividend (* divisor quotient)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-divides-to-gcd-aux-statement ()
  (forall (p m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp p)
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (< 0 p)
      (< 0 n)
      (logipedia-gcd-divides-to-gcd-aux-divides-p n m))
     (equal
      (logipedia-gcd-divides-to-gcd-aux p m n)
      n))))

-- positive natural p and n, if n divides m, the auxiliary
-- greatest-common-divisor computation with fuel p returns n. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module divides_to_gcd_aux where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≤_ _<_ Divides

data _≤_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} -> zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} -> m ≤ n -> suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor dividend =
  Σ Nat (\ quotient -> dividend ≡ divisor * quotient)

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

eqb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
eqb zero zero = true
eqb zero (suc n) = false
eqb (suc m) zero = false
eqb (suc m) (suc n) = eqb m n

mod-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
mod-aux zero n m = n
mod-aux (suc p) n m with leb n m
... | true = n
... | false = mod-aux p (n - suc m) m

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod n zero = n
naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

dividesb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
dividesb n m = eqb (naturalMod m n) zero

gcd-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd-aux zero m n = m
gcd-aux (suc p) m n with dividesb n m
... | true = n
... | false = gcd-aux p n (naturalMod m n)

divides-to-gcd-aux : Set
divides-to-gcd-aux =
  (p m n : Nat) ->
  zero < p ->
  zero < n ->
  Divides n m ->
  gcd-aux p m n ≡ n

% Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
% gcd.divides_to_gcd_aux (catalog title "gcd.divides_to_gcd_aux"): for
% positive natural p and n, if n divides m then the source fuel-recursive
% auxiliary gcd applied to p, m, and n equals n. This file contains no proof.

gcd_divides_to_gcd_aux: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  mod_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 OR n <= m THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(p - 1, nat_subtract(n, m + 1), m)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  source_mod(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(n, n, m - 1)
    ENDIF

  dividesb(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    source_mod(value, divisor) = 0

  gcd_aux(p, m, n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 THEN
      m
    ELSIF dividesb(n, m) THEN
      n
    ELSE
      gcd_aux(p - 1, n, source_mod(m, n))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  divides_to_gcd_aux_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p, m, n: nat):
      0 < p IMPLIES
        0 < n IMPLIES
          nat_divides(n, m) IMPLIES
            gcd_aux(p, m, n) = n

END gcd_divides_to_gcd_aux

title: eq_gcd_aux_body_S
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- "gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S" (catalog title "gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S"): at every
-- successor recursion index, the concrete auxiliary greatest-common-divisor
-- body is Leibniz-equal to its divisibility-controlled recursive step.
-- This file contains no proof.

namespace gcd

def Leibniz (A : Type) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : A → Prop, P x → P y

def natEqb : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, 0 => true
  | 0, Nat.succ _ => false
  | Nat.succ _, 0 => false
  | Nat.succ m, Nat.succ n => natEqb m n

def modAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m, _ => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      if m ≤ n then m else modAux p (m - Nat.succ n) n

def naturalMod (m n : Nat) : Nat :=
  match n with
  | 0 => m
  | Nat.succ p => modAux m m p

def dividesb (n m : Nat) : Bool :=
  natEqb (naturalMod m n) 0

def gcdAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m, _ => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      if dividesb n m then n else gcdAux p n (naturalMod m n)

def gcdAuxBody : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m, _ => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      if dividesb n m then n else gcdAux p n (naturalMod m n)

theorem eq_gcd_aux_body_S :
    ∀ p : Nat,
      Leibniz (Nat → Nat → Nat) (gcdAuxBody (Nat.succ p))
        (fun m n ↦
          if dividesb n m then n else gcdAux p n (naturalMod m n)) := sorry

end gcd

title: eq_gcd_aux_body_S
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
  gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S (catalog title "gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S"): for every
  natural index, the successor-indexed auxiliary gcd body is Leibniz-equal to
  the binary function that returns the second input when it divides the first,
  and otherwise recurses on the remainder. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition logipedia_leibniz (A : Type) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  forall P : A -> Prop, P x -> P y.

Definition gcd_source_modulo (m n : nat) : nat :=
  match n with
  | O => m
  | S n' => Nat.modulo m (S n')
  end.

Definition gcd_source_dividesb (n m : nat) : bool :=
  Nat.eqb (gcd_source_modulo m n) O.

Parameter gcd_aux gcd_aux_body : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat.

Theorem gcd_eq_gcd_aux_body_S :
  forall p : nat,
    logipedia_leibniz
      (nat -> nat -> nat)
      (gcd_aux_body (S p))
      (fun m n : nat =>
         if gcd_source_dividesb n m
         then n
         else gcd_aux p n (gcd_source_modulo m n)).
Admitted.

title: eq_gcd_aux_body_S
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
  gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S, catalog title "gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S": for every
  natural recursion index, the auxiliary gcd body at the successor index is
  Leibniz-equal to the curried step function selected by the source
  divisibility test. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory eq_gcd_aux_body_S
  imports Main
begin

primrec logipedia_mod_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod_aux 0 n m = n"
| "logipedia_mod_aux (Suc p) n m =
    (if n \<le> m then n else logipedia_mod_aux p (n - Suc m) m)"

definition logipedia_mod :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod n m =
    (case m of
      0 \<Rightarrow> n
    | Suc p \<Rightarrow> logipedia_mod_aux n n p)"

definition logipedia_match_bool_type :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> 'a"
where
  "logipedia_match_bool_type case_true case_false b =
    (if b then case_true else case_false)"

definition logipedia_dividesb :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "logipedia_dividesb n m = (logipedia_mod m n = 0)"

definition logipedia_leibniz :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "logipedia_leibniz x y \<equiv>
    (\<forall>P :: 'a \<Rightarrow> bool. P x \<longrightarrow> P y)"

consts
  gcd_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
  gcd_aux_body :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"

theorem eq_gcd_aux_body_S:
  "\<forall>p :: nat.
    logipedia_leibniz
      (gcd_aux_body (Suc p) :: nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat)
      (\<lambda>m :: nat. \<lambda>n :: nat.
        logipedia_match_bool_type
          n
          (gcd_aux p n (logipedia_mod m n))
          (logipedia_dividesb n m))"
  sorry

end

title: eq_gcd_aux_body_S
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S, catalog title "gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S": at every
;; successor recursion index, the auxiliary gcd body is Leibniz-equal at its
;; binary natural-number function type to the branch that returns the divisor
;; when it divides the dividend and otherwise recurses on the corresponding
;; remainder. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Conservative interfaces for the source's natural-valued auxiliary gcd
;; function and its body, whose values are binary natural-number functions.

(defstub logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux
  (index first second)
  t)

(defstub logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-body
  (index)
  t)

(defstub logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-generic-apply
  (function-value first second)
  t)

;; The source remainder is totalized by mod(m, 0) = m.

(defun logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-mod
    (dividend divisor)
  (if (zp divisor)
      (nfix dividend)
    (mod (nfix dividend) (nfix divisor))))

(defun logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-dividesb
    (divisor dividend)
  (equal
   (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-mod
    dividend divisor)
   0))

(defun logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-step-function (index)
  (list 'logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-step-function index))

(defun logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-step-function-p
    (function-value)
  (and
   (consp function-value)
   (equal
    (car function-value)
    'logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-step-function)
   (consp (cdr function-value))
   (natp (cadr function-value))
   (equal (cddr function-value) nil)))

(defun logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-apply
    (function-value dividend divisor)
  (if
      (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-step-function-p
       function-value)
      (let ((index (cadr function-value)))
        (if
         (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-dividesb
          divisor dividend)
         (nfix divisor)
         (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux
          index
          (nfix divisor)
          (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-mod
           dividend divisor))))
    (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-generic-apply
     function-value dividend divisor)))

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-typed-p ()
  (forall (index first second)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (natp first)
      (natp second))
     (natp
      (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux
       index first second)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-function-value-p
    (function-value)
  (forall (first second)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp first)
      (natp second))
     (natp
      (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-apply
       function-value first second)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-body-typed-p ()
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-function-value-p
      (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-body index)))))

;; Equality of the reified function values is Leibniz equality at the complete
;; source binary-function type, rather than merely pointwise equality.

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-leibniz-p ()
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (equal
      (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-body
       (+ 1 index))
      (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-step-function index)))))

(defun logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-statement ()
  (implies
   (and
    (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-typed-p)
    (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-body-typed-p))
   (logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-leibniz-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: eq_gcd_aux_body_S
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S (catalog title "gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S"): at every
-- successor recursion index, the auxiliary greatest-common-divisor body is
-- Leibniz-equal to the binary natural-number function that returns the second
-- input when it divides the first, and otherwise applies the preceding
-- auxiliary function to that input and their remainder. This file contains no
-- proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module eq_gcd_aux_body_S where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

Leibniz :
  {level : Level} ->
  (A : Set level) ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set (lsuc level)
Leibniz {level} A x y =
  (P : A -> Set level) ->
  P x ->
  P y

eqb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
eqb zero zero = true
eqb zero (suc n) = false
eqb (suc m) zero = false
eqb (suc m) (suc n) = eqb m n

match-bool-type : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Bool -> A
match-bool-type case-true case-false true = case-true
match-bool-type case-true case-false false = case-false

module Statement
  (mod-aux gcd-aux gcd-aux-body : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat) where

  naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
  naturalMod n zero = n
  naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

  dividesb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
  dividesb n m = eqb (naturalMod m n) zero

  eq-gcd-aux-body-S : Set₁
  eq-gcd-aux-body-S =
    (p : Nat) ->
    Leibniz
      (Nat -> Nat -> Nat)
      (gcd-aux-body (suc p))
      (\ m n ->
        match-bool-type
          n
          (gcd-aux p n (naturalMod m n))
          (dividesb n m))

$(

  (logipedia__metamath__gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S), catalog title
  "gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S": for every natural number p, the gcd auxiliary
  body at the successor of p is Leibniz equal to the binary function that
  returns n when the total remainder of m modulo n is zero and otherwise
  returns gcd_aux p n applied to that remainder. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  LogGcdAux and LogGcdAuxBody represent the fixed source constants of type

    NN0 -> NN0 -> NN0 -> NN0.

  LogNatBinaryFunction is the curried function space NN0 -> NN0 -> NN0,
  and LogNatToBinaryFunction is NN0 -> LogNatBinaryFunction. The term

    if ( n = 0 , m , ( m mod n ) )

  is exactly the source's total div_mod.mod m n. Since primes.dividesb n m
  is nat.eqb of that remainder with zero, the outer SetMM conditional is
  exactly bool.match_bool_type with true branch n and false branch
  gcd_aux p n (div_mod.mod m n). A predicate on the binary-function carrier
  is represented extensionally by a subset q of LogNatBinaryFunction.
  Therefore universal transport of membership from gcd_aux_body (S p) to
  the displayed binary function is exactly the source definition of
  leibniz.leibniz in its stated direction. The source signature and lambda
  binders fix the relevant function types, so target-side typing is not added
  as theorem content. Every declaration is an unproved $a statement encoding;
  this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c
  LogGcdAux LogGcdAuxBody
  LogNatBinaryFunction LogNatToBinaryFunction
$.

log-gcd-aux-syntax $a class ( LogGcdAux ) $.
log-gcd-aux-body-syntax $a class ( LogGcdAuxBody ) $.
log-nat-binary-function-syntax $a class ( LogNatBinaryFunction ) $.
log-nat-to-binary-function-syntax $a class
  ( LogNatToBinaryFunction )
$.

log-nat-binary-function-definition $a |-
  ( LogNatBinaryFunction ) =
    ( ( NN0 ^m NN0 ) ^m NN0 )
$.

log-nat-to-binary-function-definition $a |-
  ( LogNatToBinaryFunction ) =
    ( ( LogNatBinaryFunction ) ^m NN0 )
$.

${
  $d m n p q $.

  logipedia-gcd-eq-gcd-aux-body-s $a |-
    A. p e. NN0
      A. q e. ~P ( LogNatBinaryFunction )
        (
          ( ( LogGcdAuxBody ) ` ( p + 1 ) ) e. q
          ->
          (
            m e. NN0 |->
              (
                n e. NN0 |->
                  if (
                    if (
                      n = 0 ,
                      m ,
                      ( m mod n )
                    )
                    =
                    0 ,
                    n ,
                    (
                      (
                        ( ( LogGcdAux ) ` p )
                        `
                        n
                      )
                      `
                      if (
                        n = 0 ,
                        m ,
                        ( m mod n )
                      )
                    )
                  )
              )
          ) e. q
        )
  $.
$}

title: eq_gcd_aux_body_S
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
% gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S (catalog title "gcd.eq_gcd_aux_body_S"): at every
% successor natural index, the auxiliary gcd body is Leibniz-equal, as a
% curried binary natural-number function, to the divisibility case split
% between the divisor and the preceding auxiliary gcd call on the remainder.
% This file contains no proof.

gcd_eq_gcd_aux_body_S: THEORY
BEGIN
  binary_nat_function: TYPE = [nat -> [nat -> nat]]

  gcd_aux, gcd_aux_body: [nat -> binary_nat_function]

  leibniz(x: binary_nat_function)(y: binary_nat_function): bool =
    FORALL (P: [binary_nat_function -> bool]): P(x) IMPLIES P(y)

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  mod_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 OR n <= m THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(p - 1, nat_subtract(n, m + 1), m)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  mod(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(n, n, m - 1)
    ENDIF

  dividesb(n, m: nat): bool =
    mod(m, n) = 0

  eq_gcd_aux_body_S_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      leibniz(gcd_aux_body(p + 1))
        (LAMBDA (m: nat):
          (LAMBDA (n: nat):
            IF dividesb(n, m) THEN
              n
            ELSE
              gcd_aux(p)(n)(mod(m, n))
            ENDIF))

END gcd_eq_gcd_aux_body_S

-- between suitable natural multiples of the inputs. This file contains no proof.

theorem gcd.eq_minus_gcd :

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- gcd.eq_minus_gcd (catalog title "gcd.eq_minus_gcd"): for every pair of
-- natural numbers, natural coefficients give one of the two truncated
-- differences as their module-defined greatest common divisor. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module eq_minus_gcd where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 1 _∨_

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> A ∨ B
  right : B -> A ∨ B

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

eqb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
eqb zero zero = true
eqb zero (suc n) = false
eqb (suc m) zero = false
eqb (suc m) (suc n) = eqb m n

match-bool-type : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Bool -> A
match-bool-type case-true case-false true = case-true
match-bool-type case-true case-false false = case-false

mod-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
mod-aux zero n m = n
mod-aux (suc p) n m with leb n m
... | true = n
... | false = mod-aux p (n - suc m) m

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod n zero = n
naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

dividesb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
dividesb n m = eqb (naturalMod m n) zero

gcd-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd-aux zero m n = m
gcd-aux (suc p) m n with dividesb n m
... | true = n
... | false = gcd-aux p n (naturalMod m n)

gcd : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd n m =
  match-bool-type
    (gcd-aux n m n)
    (gcd-aux m n m)
    (leb n m)

eq-minus-gcd : Set
eq-minus-gcd =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  Σ Nat (\ a ->
    Σ Nat (\ b ->
      ((a * n) - (b * m) ≡ gcd n m) ∨
      ((b * m) - (a * n) ≡ gcd n m)))

title: eq_minus_gcd
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
% gcd.eq_minus_gcd (catalog title "gcd.eq_minus_gcd"): every pair of natural
% numbers has natural coefficients whose truncated difference, in one of the
% two orders, equals the source natural-number gcd. This file contains no proof.

gcd_eq_minus_gcd: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  mod_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 OR n <= m THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(p - 1, nat_subtract(n, m + 1), m)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  source_mod(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(n, n, m - 1)
    ENDIF

  dividesb(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    source_mod(value, divisor) = 0

  gcd_aux(p, m, n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 THEN
      m
    ELSIF dividesb(n, m) THEN
      n
    ELSE
      gcd_aux(p - 1, n, source_mod(m, n))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  source_gcd(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF n <= m THEN
      gcd_aux(n, m, n)
    ELSE
      gcd_aux(m, n, m)
    ENDIF

  eq_minus_gcd_statement: bool =
    FORALL (m, n: nat):
      EXISTS (a, b: nat):
        nat_subtract(a * n, b * m) = source_gcd(n, m)
          OR nat_subtract(b * m, a * n) = source_gcd(n, m)

END gcd_eq_minus_gcd

-- numbers p, m, and positive n with n ≤ m and n ≤ p, the fuel-recursive
-- greatest-common-divisor auxiliary is one of the two truncated differences
-- between suitable natural multiples of n and m. This file contains no proof.

namespace gcd

def gcdAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      if n ∣ m then n else gcdAux p n (m % n)

theorem eq_minus_gcd_aux :
    ∀ p m n : Nat, 0 < n → n ≤ m → n ≤ p → ∃ a b : Nat,
      a * n - b * m = gcdAux p m n ∨
      b * m - a * n = gcdAux p m n := sorry

end gcd

(*

  gcd.eq_minus_gcd_aux (catalog title "gcd.eq_minus_gcd_aux"): for positive
  natural n bounded by m and the recursion fuel p, natural coefficients
  witness that one of two truncated differences of multiples equals the
  fuel-recursive auxiliary gcd value. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Fixpoint gcd_aux (p m n : nat) : nat :=
  match p with
  | O => m
  | S q =>
      if Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo m n) O
      then n
      else gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n)
  end.

Theorem eq_minus_gcd_aux :
  forall p m n : nat,
    O < n ->
    n <= m ->
    n <= p ->
    exists a b : nat,
      a * n - b * m = gcd_aux p m n \/
      b * m - a * n = gcd_aux p m n.
Admitted.

  natural n bounded above by m and by the recursion index p, natural
  coefficients make one of the two truncated differences of multiples equal
  the recursively specified auxiliary gcd value. This file contains no proof.

theory eq_minus_gcd_aux
  imports Main
begin

primrec logipedia_mod_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod_aux 0 n m = n"
| "logipedia_mod_aux (Suc p) n m =
    (if n \<le> m then n else logipedia_mod_aux p (n - Suc m) m)"

definition logipedia_mod :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod n m =
    (case m of
      0 \<Rightarrow> n
    | Suc p \<Rightarrow> logipedia_mod_aux n n p)"

definition logipedia_dividesb :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "logipedia_dividesb n m = (logipedia_mod m n = 0)"

fun gcd_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "gcd_aux 0 m n = m"
| "gcd_aux (Suc p) m n =
    (if logipedia_dividesb n m
     then n
     else gcd_aux p n (logipedia_mod m n))"

theorem eq_minus_gcd_aux:
  "\<forall>p m n :: nat.
    0 < n \<longrightarrow>
    n \<le> m \<longrightarrow>
    n \<le> p \<longrightarrow>
    (\<exists>a b :: nat.
      a * n - b * m = gcd_aux p m n \<or>
      b * m - a * n = gcd_aux p m n)"
  sorry

end

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

eqb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
eqb zero zero = true
eqb zero (suc n) = false
eqb (suc m) zero = false

match-bool-type case-true case-false false = case-false

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat

... | true = n
... | false = gcd-aux p n (naturalMod m n)

gcd n m =
  match-bool-type
    (gcd-aux n m n)
    (gcd-aux m n m)
    (leb n m)

  (m : Nat) ->

    ∀ p q : Nat,

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
  gcd.let_clause_1544 (catalog title "gcd.let_clause_1544"): a nested
  natural-number statement about fuel-recursive gcd values and Bezout-style
  truncated differences, concluding that exchanging the order of the factors
  in one product preserves the stated equality. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Fixpoint gcd_aux (p m n : nat) : nat :=
  match p with
  | O => m
  | S q =>
      if Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo m n) O
      then n
      else gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n)
  end.

Definition gcd_divides (divisor value : nat) : Prop :=
  exists quotient : nat, value = divisor * quotient.

Theorem let_clause_1544 :
  forall p q : nat,
    (forall m n : nat,
      O < n ->
      n <= m ->
      n <= q ->
      exists a b : nat,
        a * n - b * m = gcd_aux q m n \/
        b * m - a * n = gcd_aux q m n) ->
    forall m n : nat,
      O < n ->
      n <= m ->
      n <= S q ->
      ~ gcd_divides n m ->
      forall a : nat,
        (exists b : nat,
          a * (Nat.modulo m n) - b * n =
            gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n) \/
          b * n - a * (Nat.modulo m n) =
            gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n)) ->
        forall b : nat,
          (a * (Nat.modulo m n) - b * n =
             gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n) \/
           b * n - a * (Nat.modulo m n) =
             gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n)) ->
          a * (Nat.modulo m n) - b * n =
            gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n) ->
          a * (Nat.modulo m n) - n * b =
            gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n).
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
  gcd.let_clause_1544, catalog title "gcd.let_clause_1544": under the stated
  natural-number bounds, nondivisibility, and coefficient hypotheses,
  commuting the factors in one truncated product preserves its equality to
  the fuel-indexed auxiliary gcd value. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory let_clause_1544
  imports Main
begin

primrec logipedia_mod_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod_aux 0 n m = n"
| "logipedia_mod_aux (Suc p) n m =
    (if n \<le> m then n else logipedia_mod_aux p (n - Suc m) m)"

definition logipedia_mod :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod n m =
    (case m of
      0 \<Rightarrow> n
    | Suc p \<Rightarrow> logipedia_mod_aux n n p)"

definition logipedia_dividesb :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "logipedia_dividesb n m = (logipedia_mod m n = 0)"

fun gcd_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "gcd_aux 0 m n = m"
| "gcd_aux (Suc p) m n =
    (if logipedia_dividesb n m
     then n
     else gcd_aux p n (logipedia_mod m n))"

theorem let_clause_1544:
  "\<forall>p q :: nat.
    (\<forall>m n :: nat.
      0 < n \<longrightarrow>
      n \<le> m \<longrightarrow>
      n \<le> q \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>a b :: nat.
        a * n - b * m = gcd_aux q m n \<or>
        b * m - a * n = gcd_aux q m n)) \<longrightarrow>
    (\<forall>m n :: nat.
      0 < n \<longrightarrow>
      n \<le> m \<longrightarrow>
      n \<le> Suc q \<longrightarrow>
      \<not> n dvd m \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>a :: nat.
        (\<exists>b :: nat.
          a * logipedia_mod m n - b * n =
            gcd_aux q n (logipedia_mod m n) \<or>
          b * n - a * logipedia_mod m n =
            gcd_aux q n (logipedia_mod m n)) \<longrightarrow>
        (\<forall>b :: nat.
          (a * logipedia_mod m n - b * n =
             gcd_aux q n (logipedia_mod m n) \<or>
           b * n - a * logipedia_mod m n =
             gcd_aux q n (logipedia_mod m n)) \<longrightarrow>
          a * logipedia_mod m n - b * n =
            gcd_aux q n (logipedia_mod m n) \<longrightarrow>
          a * logipedia_mod m n - n * b =
            gcd_aux q n (logipedia_mod m n))))"
  sorry

end
