  induction-step clause for a Bezout-style characterization of the recursive
  greatest-common-divisor auxiliary function, with the concluding equality
  differing only by the order of a product. This file contains no proof.
*)

let logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux = new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
  `(logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux 0 m n = m) /\
   (logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux (SUC p) m n =
      if m MOD n = 0 then n
      else logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux p n (m MOD n))`;;

let statement =
  `!p:num. !q:num.
     (!m n:num.
        0 < n
        ==> n <= m
        ==> n <= q
        ==> ?a b:num.
              a * n - b * m = logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux q m n \/
              b * m - a * n = logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux q m n)
     ==> !m n:num.
           0 < n
           ==> n <= m
           ==> n <= SUC q
           ==> ~(n divides m)
           ==> !a:num.
                 (?b:num.
                    a * (m MOD n) - b * n =
                      logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux q n (m MOD n) \/
                    b * n - a * (m MOD n) =
                      logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux q n (m MOD n))
                 ==> !b:num.
                       (a * (m MOD n) - b * n =
                          logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux q n (m MOD n) \/
                        b * n - a * (m MOD n) =
                          logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux q n (m MOD n))
                       ==> a * (m MOD n) - b * n =
                             logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux q n (m MOD n)
                       ==> a * (m MOD n) - n * b =

title: let_clause_1544
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; gcd.let_clause_1544, catalog title "gcd.let_clause_1544": a natural-number
;; bounded-gcd induction hypothesis and successor-step premises imply that
;; commuting b*n to n*b preserves the stated truncated-difference equality.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source natural remainder is totalized by mod(dividend, 0) = dividend.

(defun logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-mod (dividend divisor)
  (if (zp divisor)
      (nfix dividend)
    (mod (nfix dividend) (nfix divisor))))

;; This is the source module's gcd_aux recursion: zero fuel returns the
;; dividend; positive fuel returns the divisor when it divides the dividend
;; and otherwise recurses on the corresponding remainder.

(defun logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-aux
    (fuel dividend divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (zp fuel)
      (nfix dividend)
    (if (equal
         (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-mod
          dividend divisor)
         0)
        (nfix divisor)
      (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-aux
       (- (nfix fuel) 1)
       (nfix divisor)
       (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-mod
        dividend divisor)))))

(defun logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-minus (left right)
  (nfix (- (nfix left) (nfix right))))

;; Source divisibility is the existence of a natural quotient.

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-divides-p
    (divisor dividend)
  (exists (quotient)
    (and
     (natp divisor)
     (natp dividend)
     (natp quotient)
     (equal dividend (* divisor quotient)))))

;; This is the disjunction occurring in both source existential clauses.

(defun logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-alternative-p
    (fuel dividend divisor a b)
  (let ((bounded-gcd
         (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-aux
          fuel dividend divisor)))
    (or
     (equal
      (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-minus
       (* a divisor)
       (* b dividend))
      bounded-gcd)
     (equal
      (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-minus
       (* b dividend)
       (* a divisor))
      bounded-gcd))))

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-pair-exists-p
    (fuel dividend divisor)
  (exists (a b)
    (and
     (natp a)
     (natp b)
     (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-alternative-p
      fuel dividend divisor a b))))

;; This predicate preserves the source induction hypothesis:
;; forall m n, 0 < n -> n <= m -> n <= q -> exists a b, ...

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-induction-hypothesis-p
    (q)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n))
     (implies
      (< 0 n)
      (implies
       (<= n m)
       (implies
        (<= n q)
        (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-pair-exists-p
         q m n)))))))

;; The step's existential premise fixes a and quantifies only b.

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-step-witness-p
    (q m n a)
  (exists (b)
    (and
     (natp b)
     (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-alternative-p
      q
      n
      (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-mod m n)
      a
      b))))

(defun logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-forward-equality-p
    (q m n a b)
  (let ((remainder
         (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-mod m n)))
    (equal
     (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-minus
      (* a remainder)
      (* b n))
     (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-aux
      q n remainder))))

(defun logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-commuted-equality-p
    (q m n a b)
  (let ((remainder
         (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-mod m n)))
    (equal
     (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-minus
      (* a remainder)
      (* n b))
     (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-aux
      q n remainder))))

;; For each source b, retain both the disjunctive premise and the forward
;; equality premise before stating the equality with the commuted product.

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-all-b-clause-p
    (q m n a)
  (forall (b)
    (implies
     (natp b)
     (implies
      (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-alternative-p
       q
       n
       (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-mod m n)
       a
       b)
      (implies
       (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-forward-equality-p
        q m n a b)
       (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-commuted-equality-p
        q m n a b))))))

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-all-a-clause-p
    (q m n)
  (forall (a)
    (implies
     (natp a)
     (implies
      (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-step-witness-p
       q m n a)
      (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-all-b-clause-p
       q m n a)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-successor-clause-p
    (q)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n))
     (implies
      (< 0 n)
      (implies
       (<= n m)
       (implies
        (<= n (+ q 1))
        (implies
         (not
          (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-divides-p
           n m))
         (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-all-a-clause-p
          q m n))))))))

;; Parameter p is intentionally quantified although it is unused after its
;; binder, exactly as in the source declaration.

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-statement ()
  (forall (p q)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp p)
      (natp q))
     (implies
      (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-induction-hypothesis-p
       q)
      (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-1544-successor-clause-p
       q)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- gcd.let_clause_1544 (catalog title "gcd.let_clause_1544"): a local
-- natural-number equality step for the recursive auxiliary greatest common
-- divisor, commuting the factors in one product. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module let-clause-1544 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 1 _∨_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_ Divides

data ⊥ : Set where

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> A ∨ B
  right : B -> A ∨ B

data _≤_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} -> zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} -> m ≤ n -> suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor dividend =
  Σ Nat (\ quotient -> dividend ≡ divisor * quotient)

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

eqb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
eqb zero zero = true
eqb zero (suc n) = false
eqb (suc m) zero = false
eqb (suc m) (suc n) = eqb m n

mod-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
mod-aux zero n m = n
mod-aux (suc p) n m with leb n m
... | true = n
... | false = mod-aux p (n - suc m) m

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod n zero = n
naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

dividesb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
dividesb n m = eqb (naturalMod m n) zero

gcd-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd-aux zero m n = m
gcd-aux (suc p) m n with dividesb n m
... | true = n
... | false = gcd-aux p n (naturalMod m n)

let-clause-1544 : Set
let-clause-1544 =
  (p q : Nat) ->
  ((m n : Nat) ->
    zero < n ->
    n ≤ m ->
    n ≤ q ->
    Σ Nat (\ a ->
      Σ Nat (\ b ->
        ((a * n) - (b * m) ≡ gcd-aux q m n) ∨
        ((b * m) - (a * n) ≡ gcd-aux q m n)))) ->
  (m n : Nat) ->
  zero < n ->
  n ≤ m ->
  n ≤ suc q ->
  (Divides n m -> ⊥) ->
  (a : Nat) ->
  Σ Nat (\ b ->
    ((a * naturalMod m n) - (b * n) ≡
      gcd-aux q n (naturalMod m n)) ∨
    ((b * n) - (a * naturalMod m n) ≡
      gcd-aux q n (naturalMod m n))) ->
  (b : Nat) ->
  (((a * naturalMod m n) - (b * n) ≡
      gcd-aux q n (naturalMod m n)) ∨
    ((b * n) - (a * naturalMod m n) ≡
      gcd-aux q n (naturalMod m n))) ->
  ((a * naturalMod m n) - (b * n) ≡
    gcd-aux q n (naturalMod m n)) ->
  (a * naturalMod m n) - (n * b) ≡
    gcd-aux q n (naturalMod m n)

% Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
% gcd.let_clause_1544 (catalog title "gcd.let_clause_1544"): a Bezout-style
% property for the fuel-recursive auxiliary gcd is carried through a
% nondivisible Euclidean remainder step, ending with the same truncated
% difference after commuting its final product. This file contains no proof.

gcd_let_clause_1544: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  mod_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 OR n <= m THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(p - 1, nat_subtract(n, m + 1), m)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  source_mod(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(n, n, m - 1)
    ENDIF

  dividesb(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    source_mod(value, divisor) = 0

  gcd_aux(p, m, n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 THEN
      m
    ELSIF dividesb(n, m) THEN
      n
    ELSE
      gcd_aux(p - 1, n, source_mod(m, n))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  let_clause_1544_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p, q: nat):
      (FORALL (m, n: nat):
        0 < n IMPLIES
          n <= m IMPLIES
            n <= q IMPLIES
              EXISTS (a, b: nat):
                nat_subtract(a * n, b * m) = gcd_aux(q, m, n)
                  OR nat_subtract(b * m, a * n) = gcd_aux(q, m, n))
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (m, n: nat):
          0 < n IMPLIES
            n <= m IMPLIES
              n <= q + 1 IMPLIES
                NOT nat_divides(n, m) IMPLIES
                  (FORALL (a: nat):
                    (EXISTS (b: nat):
                      nat_subtract(a * source_mod(m, n), b * n)
                          = gcd_aux(q, n, source_mod(m, n))
                        OR
                      nat_subtract(b * n, a * source_mod(m, n))
                          = gcd_aux(q, n, source_mod(m, n)))
                    IMPLIES
                      (FORALL (b: nat):
                        (nat_subtract(a * source_mod(m, n), b * n)
                            = gcd_aux(q, n, source_mod(m, n))
                          OR
                        nat_subtract(b * n, a * source_mod(m, n))
                            = gcd_aux(q, n, source_mod(m, n)))
                        IMPLIES
                          nat_subtract(a * source_mod(m, n), b * n)
                            = gcd_aux(q, n, source_mod(m, n))
                        IMPLIES
                          nat_subtract(a * source_mod(m, n), n * b)
                            = gcd_aux(q, n, source_mod(m, n)))))

END gcd_let_clause_1544

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- "gcd.let_clause_15441" (catalog title "gcd.let_clause_15441"): for natural
-- numbers in the fuel-recursive Euclidean gcd construction, an equality with
-- the product b * n remains valid when that product is reordered as n * b.
-- This file contains no proof.

namespace gcd

def gcdAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      if n ∣ m then n else gcdAux p n (m % n)

theorem let_clause_15441 :
    ∀ p q : Nat,
      (∀ m n : Nat, 0 < n → n ≤ m → n ≤ q → ∃ a b : Nat,
        a * n - b * m = gcdAux q m n ∨
        b * m - a * n = gcdAux q m n) →
      ∀ m n : Nat, 0 < n → n ≤ m → n ≤ Nat.succ q → ¬n ∣ m →
        ∀ a : Nat,
          (∃ b : Nat,
            a * (m % n) - b * n = gcdAux q n (m % n) ∨
            b * n - a * (m % n) = gcdAux q n (m % n)) →
          ∀ b : Nat,
            (a * (m % n) - b * n = gcdAux q n (m % n) ∨
              b * n - a * (m % n) = gcdAux q n (m % n)) →
            b * n - a * (m % n) = gcdAux q n (m % n) →
            n * b - a * (m % n) = gcdAux q n (m % n) := sorry

end gcd

(*

  gcd.let_clause_15441 (catalog title "gcd.let_clause_15441"): a nested
  natural-number statement about fuel-recursive gcd values and Bezout-style
  truncated differences, concluding that exchanging the order of the factors
  in one product preserves the stated equality. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Fixpoint gcd_aux (p m n : nat) : nat :=
  match p with
  | O => m
  | S q =>
      if Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo m n) O
      then n
      else gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n)
  end.

Definition gcd_divides (divisor value : nat) : Prop :=
  exists quotient : nat, value = divisor * quotient.

Theorem let_clause_15441 :
  forall p q : nat,
    (forall m n : nat,
      O < n ->
      n <= m ->
      n <= q ->
      exists a b : nat,
        a * n - b * m = gcd_aux q m n \/
        b * m - a * n = gcd_aux q m n) ->
    forall m n : nat,
      O < n ->
      n <= m ->
      n <= S q ->
      ~ gcd_divides n m ->
      forall a : nat,
        (exists b : nat,
          a * (Nat.modulo m n) - b * n =
            gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n) \/
          b * n - a * (Nat.modulo m n) =
            gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n)) ->
        forall b : nat,
          (a * (Nat.modulo m n) - b * n =
             gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n) \/
           b * n - a * (Nat.modulo m n) =
             gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n)) ->
          b * n - a * (Nat.modulo m n) =
            gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n) ->
          n * b - a * (Nat.modulo m n) =
            gcd_aux q n (Nat.modulo m n).

begin

primrec logipedia_mod_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod_aux 0 n m = n"
| "logipedia_mod_aux (Suc p) n m =

where

definition logipedia_dividesb :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "logipedia_dividesb n m = (logipedia_mod m n = 0)"

fun gcd_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "gcd_aux 0 m n = m"
| "gcd_aux (Suc p) m n =
    (if logipedia_dividesb n m
     then n
     else gcd_aux p n (logipedia_mod m n))"

theorem let_clause_15441:
  "\<forall>p q :: nat.
    (\<forall>m n :: nat.
      0 < n \<longrightarrow>
      n \<le> m \<longrightarrow>
      n \<le> q \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>a b :: nat.
        a * n - b * m = gcd_aux q m n \<or>
        b * m - a * n = gcd_aux q m n)) \<longrightarrow>
    (\<forall>m n :: nat.
      0 < n \<longrightarrow>
      n \<le> m \<longrightarrow>
      n \<le> Suc q \<longrightarrow>
      \<not> n dvd m \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>a :: nat.
        (\<exists>b :: nat.
          a * logipedia_mod m n - b * n =
            gcd_aux q n (logipedia_mod m n) \<or>
          b * n - a * logipedia_mod m n =

        (\<forall>b :: nat.

             gcd_aux q n (logipedia_mod m n) \<or>
           b * n - a * logipedia_mod m n =
             gcd_aux q n (logipedia_mod m n)) \<longrightarrow>
          b * n - a * logipedia_mod m n =
            gcd_aux q n (logipedia_mod m n) \<longrightarrow>
          n * b - a * logipedia_mod m n =
            gcd_aux q n (logipedia_mod m n))))"

   (equal

    (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-15441-gcd-aux q m n))))

      (natp n)

      (<= n m)

     (logipedia-gcd-let-clause-15441-bezout-exists-p q m n))))

        (* b n)))

-- divisor, commuting the factors in the second truncated difference. This

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 1 _∨_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_ Divides

data ⊥ : Set where

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> A ∨ B
  right : B -> A ∨ B

data _≤_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} -> zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} -> m ≤ n -> suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor dividend =
  Σ Nat (\ quotient -> dividend ≡ divisor * quotient)

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

eqb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
eqb zero zero = true
eqb zero (suc n) = false
eqb (suc m) zero = false
eqb (suc m) (suc n) = eqb m n

mod-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
mod-aux zero n m = n
mod-aux (suc p) n m with leb n m
... | true = n
... | false = mod-aux p (n - suc m) m

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod n zero = n
naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

dividesb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
dividesb n m = eqb (naturalMod m n) zero

gcd-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd-aux zero m n = m
gcd-aux (suc p) m n with dividesb n m
... | true = n
... | false = gcd-aux p n (naturalMod m n)

let-clause-15441 : Set
let-clause-15441 =
  (p q : Nat) ->

    zero < n ->
    n ≤ m ->

    Σ Nat (\ a ->

        ((b * m) - (a * n) ≡ gcd-aux q m n)))) ->
  (m n : Nat) ->
  zero < n ->
  n ≤ m ->
  n ≤ suc q ->
  (Divides n m -> ⊥) ->
  (a : Nat) ->
  Σ Nat (\ b ->
    ((a * naturalMod m n) - (b * n) ≡
      gcd-aux q n (naturalMod m n)) ∨
    ((b * n) - (a * naturalMod m n) ≡
      gcd-aux q n (naturalMod m n))) ->
  (b : Nat) ->
  (((a * naturalMod m n) - (b * n) ≡
      gcd-aux q n (naturalMod m n)) ∨
    ((b * n) - (a * naturalMod m n) ≡
      gcd-aux q n (naturalMod m n))) ->
  ((b * n) - (a * naturalMod m n) ≡
    gcd-aux q n (naturalMod m n)) ->

% Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
% gcd.let_clause_15441 (catalog title "gcd.let_clause_15441"): a Bezout-style
% property for the fuel-recursive auxiliary gcd is carried through a
% nondivisible Euclidean remainder step, ending with the same truncated
% difference after commuting its leading product. This file contains no proof.

gcd_let_clause_15441: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  mod_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 OR n <= m THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(p - 1, nat_subtract(n, m + 1), m)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  source_mod(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(n, n, m - 1)
    ENDIF

  dividesb(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    source_mod(value, divisor) = 0

  gcd_aux(p, m, n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 THEN
      m
    ELSIF dividesb(n, m) THEN
      n
    ELSE
      gcd_aux(p - 1, n, source_mod(m, n))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  let_clause_15441_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p, q: nat):
      (FORALL (m, n: nat):
        0 < n IMPLIES
          n <= m IMPLIES
            n <= q IMPLIES
              EXISTS (a, b: nat):
                nat_subtract(a * n, b * m) = gcd_aux(q, m, n)
                  OR nat_subtract(b * m, a * n) = gcd_aux(q, m, n))
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (m, n: nat):
          0 < n IMPLIES
            n <= m IMPLIES
              n <= q + 1 IMPLIES
                NOT nat_divides(n, m) IMPLIES
                  (FORALL (a: nat):
                    (EXISTS (b: nat):
                      nat_subtract(a * source_mod(m, n), b * n)
                          = gcd_aux(q, n, source_mod(m, n))
                        OR
                      nat_subtract(b * n, a * source_mod(m, n))
                          = gcd_aux(q, n, source_mod(m, n)))
                    IMPLIES
                      (FORALL (b: nat):
                        (nat_subtract(a * source_mod(m, n), b * n)
                            = gcd_aux(q, n, source_mod(m, n))
                          OR
                        nat_subtract(b * n, a * source_mod(m, n))
                            = gcd_aux(q, n, source_mod(m, n)))
                        IMPLIES
                          nat_subtract(b * n, a * source_mod(m, n))
                            = gcd_aux(q, n, source_mod(m, n))
                        IMPLIES
                          nat_subtract(n * b, a * source_mod(m, n))
                            = gcd_aux(q, n, source_mod(m, n)))))

END gcd_let_clause_15441

-- gcd.let_clause_1545 (catalog title "gcd.let_clause_1545"): from the
-- module's zero greatest-common-divisor and zero-divisibility hypotheses,
-- including their quotient equalities, the first natural input is zero.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module let-clause-1545 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 Divides

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor dividend =
  Σ Nat (\ quotient -> dividend ≡ divisor * quotient)

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

eqb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
eqb zero zero = true
eqb zero (suc n) = false
eqb (suc m) zero = false
eqb (suc m) (suc n) = eqb m n

match-bool-type : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Bool -> A
match-bool-type case-true case-false true = case-true
match-bool-type case-true case-false false = case-false

mod-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
mod-aux zero n m = n
mod-aux (suc p) n m with leb n m
... | true = n
... | false = mod-aux p (n - suc m) m

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod n zero = n
naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

dividesb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
dividesb n m = eqb (naturalMod m n) zero

gcd-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd-aux zero m n = m
gcd-aux (suc p) m n with dividesb n m
... | true = n
... | false = gcd-aux p n (naturalMod m n)

gcd : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd n m =
  match-bool-type
    (gcd-aux n m n)
    (gcd-aux m n m)
    (leb n m)

let-clause-1545 : Set
let-clause-1545 =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  gcd m n ≡ zero ->
  Divides zero n ->
  (q1 : Nat) ->
  n ≡ zero * q1 ->
  Divides zero m ->
  (q2 : Nat) ->
  m ≡ zero * q2 ->
  m ≡ zero

% natural-number gcd is zero, nested zero-divisibility witnesses force the
% first number to be zero. This file contains no proof.

gcd_let_clause_1545: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  mod_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 OR n <= m THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(p - 1, nat_subtract(n, m + 1), m)
    ENDIF

      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(n, n, m - 1)

;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact gcd.lt_O_gcd,
;; catalog title "gcd.lt_O_gcd": for all natural numbers m and n, positivity
;; of n implies positivity of their module-defined greatest common divisor.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source remainder is totalized by mod(dividend, 0) = dividend.

(defun logipedia-gcd-lt-o-gcd-mod (dividend divisor)
  (if (zp divisor)
      (nfix dividend)
    (mod (nfix dividend) (nfix divisor))))

;; This bounded Euclidean recursion is the source module's gcd_aux: index zero
;; returns the dividend; a successor returns the divisor when it divides the
;; dividend and otherwise recurses on the corresponding remainder.

(defun logipedia-gcd-lt-o-gcd-aux
    (index dividend divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (zp index)
      (nfix dividend)
    (if (equal
         (logipedia-gcd-lt-o-gcd-mod dividend divisor)
         0)
        (nfix divisor)
      (logipedia-gcd-lt-o-gcd-aux
       (- (nfix index) 1)
       (nfix divisor)
       (logipedia-gcd-lt-o-gcd-mod
        dividend divisor)))))

;; The source gcd selects the bounded call whose recursion index is the
;; smaller input.

(defun logipedia-gcd-lt-o-gcd (n m)
  (if (<= (nfix n) (nfix m))
      (logipedia-gcd-lt-o-gcd-aux
       (nfix n) (nfix m) (nfix n))
    (logipedia-gcd-lt-o-gcd-aux
     (nfix m) (nfix n) (nfix m))))

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-lt-o-gcd-statement ()
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n))
     (implies
      (< 0 n)
      (< 0 (logipedia-gcd-lt-o-gcd m n))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact gcd.lt_O_gcd
-- (catalog title "gcd.lt_O_gcd"): if the second natural-number input is
-- positive, then the module-defined greatest common divisor is positive.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module lt_O_gcd where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_)

infix 4 _<_

data _<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc : {n : Nat} -> zero < suc n
  suc<suc : {m n : Nat} -> m < n -> suc m < suc n

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

eqb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
eqb zero zero = true
eqb zero (suc n) = false
eqb (suc m) zero = false
eqb (suc m) (suc n) = eqb m n

match-bool-type : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Bool -> A
match-bool-type case-true case-false true = case-true
match-bool-type case-true case-false false = case-false

mod-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
mod-aux zero n m = n
mod-aux (suc p) n m with leb n m
... | true = n
... | false = mod-aux p (n - suc m) m

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod n zero = n
naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

dividesb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
dividesb n m = eqb (naturalMod m n) zero

gcd-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd-aux zero m n = m
gcd-aux (suc p) m n with dividesb n m
... | true = n
... | false = gcd-aux p n (naturalMod m n)

gcd : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd n m =
  match-bool-type
    (gcd-aux n m n)
    (gcd-aux m n m)
    (leb n m)

lt-O-gcd : Set
lt-O-gcd =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  zero < n ->
  zero < gcd m n

(*

  gcd.not_divides_to_gcd_aux (catalog title

  if n does not divide m, then the successor-fuel auxiliary gcd call equals
  the recursive call on n and the remainder of m modulo n. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition gcd_source_modulo (m n : nat) : nat :=
  match n with
  | O => m
  | S n' => Nat.modulo m (S n')
  end.

Definition gcd_divides (divisor value : nat) : Prop :=
  exists quotient : nat, value = divisor * quotient.

Fixpoint gcd_aux (p m n : nat) : nat :=
  match p with
  | O => m
  | S q =>
      if Nat.eqb (gcd_source_modulo m n) O
      then n
      else gcd_aux q n (gcd_source_modulo m n)
  end.

Theorem not_divides_to_gcd_aux :
  forall p m n : nat,
    O < n ->
    ~ gcd_divides n m ->
    gcd_aux (S p) m n = gcd_aux p n (gcd_source_modulo m n).
Admitted.

primrec logipedia_mod_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod_aux 0 n m = n"
| "logipedia_mod_aux (Suc p) n m =
    (if n \<le> m then n else logipedia_mod_aux p (n - Suc m) m)"

where

    (case m of
      0 \<Rightarrow> n
    | Suc p \<Rightarrow> logipedia_mod_aux n n p)"

    (if logipedia_dividesb n m
     then n

  "\<forall>p m n :: nat.
    0 < n \<longrightarrow>
    \<not> n dvd m \<longrightarrow>

% Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
% gcd.not_divides_to_gcd_aux (catalog title "gcd.not_divides_to_gcd_aux"):
% for natural p, m, and positive n, if n does not divide m then the source
% fuel-recursive auxiliary gcd at successor fuel equals its recursive call
% on n and the remainder of m modulo n. This file contains no proof.

gcd_not_divides_to_gcd_aux: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  mod_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 OR n <= m THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(p - 1, nat_subtract(n, m + 1), m)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  source_mod(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(n, n, m - 1)
    ENDIF

  dividesb(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    source_mod(value, divisor) = 0

  gcd_aux(p, m, n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 THEN
      m
    ELSIF dividesb(n, m) THEN
      n
    ELSE
      gcd_aux(p - 1, n, source_mod(m, n))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  not_divides_to_gcd_aux_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p, m, n: nat):
      0 < n IMPLIES
        (NOT nat_divides(n, m)) IMPLIES
          gcd_aux(p + 1, m, n) = gcd_aux(p, n, source_mod(m, n))

END gcd_not_divides_to_gcd_aux

namespace gcd

def prime (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  1 < n ∧ ∀ d : Nat, d ∣ n → 1 < d → d = n

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
  gcd.prime_to_gcd_1 (catalog title "gcd.prime_to_gcd_1"): if a natural
  prime does not divide another natural number, then their greatest common
  divisor is one. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition gcd_divides (divisor value : nat) : Prop :=
  exists quotient : nat, value = divisor * quotient.

Definition gcd_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  1 < p /\
  forall divisor : nat,
    gcd_divides divisor p ->
    1 < divisor ->
    divisor = p.

Theorem prime_to_gcd_1 :
  forall n m : nat,
    gcd_prime n ->
    ~ gcd_divides n m ->
    Nat.gcd n m = 1.
Admitted.

  module-defined greatest common divisor is one. This file contains no proof.

  `(logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux 0 m n = m) /\
   (logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux (SUC p) m n =
      if m MOD n = 0 then n
      else logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux p n (m MOD n))`;;

let logipedia_gcd_gcd = new_definition
  `logipedia_gcd_gcd (n:num) m =
     if n <= m
     then logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux n m n
     else logipedia_gcd_gcd_aux m n m`;;

title: prime_to_gcd_1
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; gcd.prime_to_gcd_1, catalog title "gcd.prime_to_gcd_1": for natural
;; numbers n and m, if n is prime and does not divide m, then the module's
;; greatest common divisor of n and m is one. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; The source remainder is totalized by mod(dividend, 0) = dividend.

(defun logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-mod (dividend divisor)
  (if (zp divisor)
      (nfix dividend)
    (mod (nfix dividend) (nfix divisor))))

;; This bounded Euclidean recursion is the source module's gcd_aux: index zero
;; returns the dividend; a successor returns the divisor when it divides the
;; dividend and otherwise recurses on the corresponding remainder.

(defun logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-aux
    (index dividend divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix index)))
  (if (zp index)
      (nfix dividend)
    (if (equal
         (logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-mod dividend divisor)
         0)
        (nfix divisor)
      (logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-aux
       (- (nfix index) 1)
       (nfix divisor)
       (logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-mod
        dividend divisor)))))

;; The source gcd selects the bounded call whose recursion index is the
;; smaller input.

(defun logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1 (n m)
  (if (<= (nfix n) (nfix m))
      (logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-aux
       (nfix n) (nfix m) (nfix n))
    (logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-aux
     (nfix m) (nfix n) (nfix m))))

;; Source divisibility is the existence of a natural quotient.

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-divides-p
    (divisor dividend)
  (exists (quotient)
    (and
     (natp divisor)
     (natp dividend)
     (natp quotient)
     (equal dividend (* divisor quotient)))))

;; The source prime predicate says that n is greater than one and every
;; divisor of n that is greater than one is n itself.

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-prime-divisors-p
    (n)
  (forall (divisor)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp divisor)
      (logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-divides-p
       divisor n)
      (< 1 divisor))
     (equal divisor n))))

(defun logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-prime-p (n)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (< 1 n)
   (logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-prime-divisors-p
    n)))

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-statement ()
  (forall (n m)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp m)
      (logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-prime-p n))
     (implies
      (not
       (logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1-divides-p
        n m))
      (equal
       (logipedia-gcd-prime-to-gcd-1 n m)
       1)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- gcd.prime_to_gcd_1 (catalog title "gcd.prime_to_gcd_1"): if a prime
-- natural number does not divide another natural number, then their greatest
-- common divisor is one. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module prime-to-gcd-1 where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _-_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 2 _∧_
infix 4 _≤_ _<_ Divides

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Empty

data _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  _,_ : A -> B -> A ∧ B

data _≤_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} -> zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} -> m ≤ n -> suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

Divides : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Divides divisor dividend =
  Σ Nat (\ quotient -> dividend ≡ divisor * quotient)

Prime : Nat -> Set
Prime p =
  (suc zero < p) ∧
  ((d : Nat) -> Divides d p -> suc zero < d -> d ≡ p)

leb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
leb zero n = true
leb (suc m) zero = false
leb (suc m) (suc n) = leb m n

eqb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
eqb zero zero = true
eqb zero (suc n) = false
eqb (suc m) zero = false
eqb (suc m) (suc n) = eqb m n

match-bool-type : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Bool -> A
match-bool-type case-true case-false true = case-true
match-bool-type case-true case-false false = case-false

mod-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
mod-aux zero n m = n
mod-aux (suc p) n m with leb n m
... | true = n
... | false = mod-aux p (n - suc m) m

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod n zero = n
naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

dividesb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
dividesb n m = eqb (naturalMod m n) zero

gcd-aux : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd-aux zero m n = m
gcd-aux (suc p) m n with dividesb n m
... | true = n
... | false = gcd-aux p n (naturalMod m n)

gcd : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcd n m =
  match-bool-type
    (gcd-aux n m n)
    (gcd-aux m n m)
    (leb n m)

prime-to-gcd-1 : Set
prime-to-gcd-1 =
  (n m : Nat) ->
  Prime n ->
  Not (Divides n m) ->
  gcd n m ≡ suc zero

% gcd.prime_to_gcd_1 (catalog title "gcd.prime_to_gcd_1"): a prime natural
% number that does not divide another natural has gcd one with it.
% This file contains no proof.

gcd_prime_to_gcd_1: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  mod_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 OR n <= m THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(p - 1, nat_subtract(n, m + 1), m)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  source_mod(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(n, n, m - 1)
    ENDIF

  dividesb(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    source_mod(value, divisor) = 0

  gcd_aux(p, m, n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 THEN
      m
    ELSIF dividesb(n, m) THEN
      n
    ELSE
      gcd_aux(p - 1, n, source_mod(m, n))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  source_gcd(n, m: nat): nat =

  LogNatBinaryFunction and LogNatToBinaryFunction explicitly encode those

  LogNatBinaryFunction LogNatToBinaryFunction

${

    A. p e. NN0

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- "gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S" (catalog title "gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S"):
-- at every successor recursion index, the binary natural-number function that
-- returns the second input when it divides the first, and otherwise applies
-- the preceding auxiliary greatest-common-divisor function to that input and
-- their remainder, is Leibniz-equal to the auxiliary body.
-- This file contains no proof.

namespace gcd

def dividesb (n m : Nat) : Bool :=
  m % n == 0

def gcdAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      bif dividesb n m then n else gcdAux p n (m % n)

def gcdAuxBody : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m, _n => m
  | Nat.succ p, m, n =>
      bif dividesb n m then n else gcdAux p n (m % n)

theorem sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S :
    ∀ p : Nat, ∀ P : (Nat → Nat → Nat) → Prop,
      P (fun (m n : Nat) ↦
        bif dividesb n m then n else gcdAux p n (m % n)) →
      P (gcdAuxBody (Nat.succ p)) := sorry

end gcd

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
  gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S (catalog title "gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S"): for
  every natural index, the concrete successor-indexed auxiliary gcd body is
  Leibniz-equal, in the symmetric direction, to its conditional recursive
  equation. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition logipedia_leibniz (A : Type) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  forall P : A -> Prop, P x -> P y.

Definition gcd_source_modulo (m n : nat) : nat :=
  match n with
  | O => m
  | S n' => Nat.modulo m (S n')
  end.

Definition gcd_source_dividesb (n m : nat) : bool :=
  Nat.eqb (gcd_source_modulo m n) O.

Fixpoint gcd_aux (p m n : nat) : nat :=
  match p with
  | O => m
  | S q =>
      if gcd_source_dividesb n m
      then n
      else gcd_aux q n (gcd_source_modulo m n)
  end.

Definition gcd_aux_body (p : nat) : nat -> nat -> nat :=
  match p with
  | O => fun m _ => m
  | S q =>
      fun m n =>
        if gcd_source_dividesb n m
        then n
        else gcd_aux q n (gcd_source_modulo m n)
  end.

Theorem gcd_sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S :
  forall p : nat,
    logipedia_leibniz
      (nat -> nat -> nat)
      (fun m n : nat =>
         if gcd_source_dividesb n m
         then n
         else gcd_aux p n (gcd_source_modulo m n))
      (gcd_aux_body (S p)).
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
  gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S, catalog title "gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S": for
  every natural recursion index, the curried gcd step function selected by
  the source divisibility test is Leibniz-equal to the abstract auxiliary gcd
  body at the successor index. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S
  imports Main
begin

primrec logipedia_mod_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod_aux 0 n m = n"
| "logipedia_mod_aux (Suc p) n m =
    (if n \<le> m then n else logipedia_mod_aux p (n - Suc m) m)"

definition logipedia_mod :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
where
  "logipedia_mod n m =
    (case m of
      0 \<Rightarrow> n
    | Suc p \<Rightarrow> logipedia_mod_aux n n p)"

definition logipedia_match_bool_type :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> 'a"
where
  "logipedia_match_bool_type case_true case_false b =
    (if b then case_true else case_false)"

definition logipedia_dividesb :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "logipedia_dividesb n m = (logipedia_mod m n = 0)"

definition logipedia_leibniz :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "logipedia_leibniz x y \<equiv>
    (\<forall>P :: 'a \<Rightarrow> bool. P x \<longrightarrow> P y)"

consts
  gcd_aux :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
  gcd_aux_body :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"

theorem sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S:
  "\<forall>p :: nat.
    logipedia_leibniz
      (\<lambda>m :: nat. \<lambda>n :: nat.
        logipedia_match_bool_type
          n
          (gcd_aux p n (logipedia_mod m n))
          (logipedia_dividesb n m))
      (gcd_aux_body (Suc p) :: nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat)"
  sorry

end

title: sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S, catalog title "gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S": at
;; every successor recursion index, the branch that returns the divisor when
;; it divides the dividend and otherwise recurses on the corresponding
;; remainder is Leibniz-equal at its binary natural-number function type to
;; the auxiliary gcd body. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Conservative interfaces for the source's natural-valued auxiliary gcd
;; function and its body, whose values are binary natural-number functions.

(defstub logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux
  (index first second)
  t)

(defstub logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-body
  (index)
  t)

(defstub logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-generic-apply
  (function-value first second)
  t)

;; The source remainder is totalized by mod(m, 0) = m.

(defun logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-mod
    (dividend divisor)
  (if (zp divisor)
      (nfix dividend)
    (mod (nfix dividend) (nfix divisor))))

(defun logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-dividesb
    (divisor dividend)
  (equal
   (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-mod
    dividend divisor)
   0))

(defun logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-step-function (index)
  (list 'logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-step-function index))

(defun logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-step-function-p
    (function-value)
  (and
   (consp function-value)
   (equal
    (car function-value)
    'logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-step-function)
   (consp (cdr function-value))
   (natp (cadr function-value))
   (equal (cddr function-value) nil)))

(defun logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-apply
    (function-value dividend divisor)
  (if
      (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-step-function-p
       function-value)
      (let ((index (cadr function-value)))
        (if
         (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-dividesb
          divisor dividend)
         (nfix divisor)
         (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux
          index
          (nfix divisor)
          (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-mod
           dividend divisor))))
    (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-generic-apply
     function-value dividend divisor)))

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-typed-p ()
  (forall (index first second)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (natp first)
      (natp second))
     (natp
      (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux
       index first second)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-function-value-p
    (function-value)
  (forall (first second)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp first)
      (natp second))
     (natp
      (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-apply
       function-value first second)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-body-typed-p ()
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-function-value-p
      (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-body index)))))

;; Equality of the reified function values is Leibniz equality at the complete
;; source binary-function type, rather than merely pointwise equality.

(defun-sk logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-leibniz-p ()
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (equal
      (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-step-function index)
      (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-body
       (+ 1 index))))))

(defun logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-statement ()
  (implies
   (and
    (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-typed-p)
    (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-gcd-aux-body-typed-p))
   (logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s-leibniz-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
-- gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S (catalog title "gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S"): at
-- every successor recursion index, the binary natural-number function that
-- returns the second input when it divides the first, and otherwise applies
-- the preceding auxiliary greatest-common-divisor function to that input and
-- their remainder, is Leibniz-equal to the auxiliary greatest-common-divisor
-- body. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

Leibniz :
  {level : Level} ->
  (A : Set level) ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set (lsuc level)
Leibniz {level} A x y =
  (P : A -> Set level) ->
  P x ->
  P y

eqb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
eqb zero zero = true
eqb zero (suc n) = false
eqb (suc m) zero = false
eqb (suc m) (suc n) = eqb m n

match-bool-type : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Bool -> A
match-bool-type case-true case-false true = case-true
match-bool-type case-true case-false false = case-false

module Statement
  (mod-aux gcd-aux gcd-aux-body : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat) where

  naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
  naturalMod n zero = n
  naturalMod n (suc m) = mod-aux n n m

  dividesb : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
  dividesb n m = eqb (naturalMod m n) zero

  sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-S : Set₁
  sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-S =
    (p : Nat) ->
    Leibniz
      (Nat -> Nat -> Nat)
      (\ m n ->
        match-bool-type
          n
          (gcd-aux p n (naturalMod m n))
          (dividesb n m))
      (gcd-aux-body (suc p))

  gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S (catalog title "gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S"):
  for every natural-number index, Leibniz equality identifies the curried
  function that returns n when the source divisibility test on n and m is
  true, and otherwise returns gcd_aux p n (m mod n), with gcd_aux_body at the

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val logipedia_gcd_auxiliary_type =

val logipedia_leibniz_def = new_definition (

  ``logipedia_leibniz (x : 'a) (y : 'a) <=>
      !P : 'a -> bool. P x ==> P y``);

val _ = new_constant (

val gcd_sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S =

        (\(m : num) (n : num).

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
  gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S
  (logipedia__metamath__gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S), catalog title
  "gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S": for every natural number p, the binary
  function that returns n when the total remainder of m modulo n is zero
  and otherwise returns gcd_aux p n applied to that remainder is Leibniz
  equal to the gcd auxiliary body at the successor of p. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  LogGcdAux and LogGcdAuxBody represent the fixed source constants of type

    NN0 -> NN0 -> NN0 -> NN0.

  LogNatBinaryFunction is the curried function space NN0 -> NN0 -> NN0,
  and LogNatToBinaryFunction is NN0 -> LogNatBinaryFunction. The term

    if ( n = 0 , m , ( m mod n ) )

  is exactly the source's total div_mod.mod m n. Since primes.dividesb n m
  is nat.eqb of that remainder with zero, the outer SetMM conditional is
  exactly bool.match_bool_type with true branch n and false branch
  gcd_aux p n (div_mod.mod m n). A predicate on the binary-function carrier
  is represented extensionally by a subset q of LogNatBinaryFunction.
  Therefore universal transport of membership from the displayed binary
  function to gcd_aux_body (S p) is exactly the source definition of
  leibniz.leibniz in its stated direction. Every declaration is an unproved
  $a statement encoding; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c
  LogGcdAux LogGcdAuxBody
  LogNatBinaryFunction LogNatToBinaryFunction
$.

log-gcd-aux-syntax $a class ( LogGcdAux ) $.
log-gcd-aux-body-syntax $a class ( LogGcdAuxBody ) $.
log-nat-binary-function-syntax $a class ( LogNatBinaryFunction ) $.
log-nat-to-binary-function-syntax $a class
  ( LogNatToBinaryFunction )
$.

log-nat-binary-function-definition $a |-
  ( LogNatBinaryFunction ) =
    ( ( NN0 ^m NN0 ) ^m NN0 )
$.

log-nat-to-binary-function-definition $a |-
  ( LogNatToBinaryFunction ) =
    ( ( LogNatBinaryFunction ) ^m NN0 )
$.

${
  $d m n p q $.

  logipedia-gcd-sym-eq-gcd-aux-body-s $a |-
    (
      (
        ( LogGcdAux ) e. ( LogNatToBinaryFunction )
        /\
        ( LogGcdAuxBody ) e. ( LogNatToBinaryFunction )
      )
      /\
      A. p e. NN0
        (
          (
            m e. NN0 |->
              (
                n e. NN0 |->
                  if (
                    if (
                      n = 0 ,
                      m ,
                      ( m mod n )
                    )
                    =
                    0 ,
                    n ,
                    (
                      (
                        ( ( LogGcdAux ) ` p )
                        `
                        n
                      )
                      `
                      if (
                        n = 0 ,
                        m ,
                        ( m mod n )
                      )
                    )
                  )
              )
          ) e. ( LogNatBinaryFunction )
          /\
          A. q e. ~P ( LogNatBinaryFunction )
            (
              (
                m e. NN0 |->
                  (
                    n e. NN0 |->
                      if (
                        if (
                          n = 0 ,
                          m ,
                          ( m mod n )
                        )
                        =
                        0 ,
                        n ,
                        (
                          (
                            ( ( LogGcdAux ) ` p )
                            `
                            n
                          )
                          `
                          if (
                            n = 0 ,
                            m ,
                            ( m mod n )
                          )
                        )
                      )
                  )
              ) e. q
              ->
              ( ( LogGcdAuxBody ) ` ( p + 1 ) ) e. q
            )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

title: sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
% gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S (catalog title "gcd.sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S"): at
% every successor natural index, the divisibility case split between the
% divisor and the preceding auxiliary gcd call on the remainder is
% Leibniz-equal, as a curried binary natural-number function, to the auxiliary
% gcd body. This file contains no proof.

gcd_sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S: THEORY
BEGIN
  gcd_aux, gcd_aux_body: [nat -> [nat -> [nat -> nat]]]
  binary_nat_function: TYPE = [nat -> [nat -> nat]]

  leibniz(x: binary_nat_function)(y: binary_nat_function): bool =
    FORALL (P: [binary_nat_function -> bool]): P(x) IMPLIES P(y)

  nat_subtract(minuend, subtrahend: nat): nat =
    IF subtrahend <= minuend THEN
      minuend - subtrahend
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  mod_aux(p, n, m: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF p = 0 OR n <= m THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(p - 1, nat_subtract(n, m + 1), m)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE p

  mod(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m = 0 THEN
      n
    ELSE
      mod_aux(n, n, m - 1)
    ENDIF

  dividesb(n, m: nat): bool =
    mod(m, n) = 0

  sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S_statement: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      leibniz
        (LAMBDA (m: nat):
          (LAMBDA (n: nat):
            IF dividesb(n, m) THEN
              n
            ELSE
              gcd_aux(p)(n)(mod(m, n))
            ENDIF))
        (gcd_aux_body(p + 1))

END gcd_sym_eq_gcd_aux_body_S

;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact logic.eq_f2,
;; catalog title "logic.eq_f2": every curried binary function preserves the
;; logic module's polymorphic equality in both arguments. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Type tags, function values, and arguments remain universally quantified.
;; The source equality has reflexivity and unrestricted predicate
;; substitution, so it is bidirectionally equivalent to identity: substitution
;; yields identity, and identity yields source equality by reflexivity. The
;; type-indexed wrapper below therefore represents it exactly with ACL2 EQUAL.

(defstub logipedia-logic-eq-f2-member-p
  (type value)
  t)

(defstub logipedia-logic-eq-f2-apply
  (function argument)
  t)

(defun logipedia-logic-eq-f2-source-equal-p
    (type left right)
  (declare (ignore type))
  (equal left right))

(defun-sk logipedia-logic-eq-f2-function-p
    (a-type b-type c-type function)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-member-p a-type x)
      (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-member-p b-type y))
     (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-member-p
      c-type
      (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-apply
       (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-apply function x)
       y)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-logic-eq-f2-statement ()
  (forall (a-type b-type c-type function x1 x2 y1 y2)
    (implies
     (and
      (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-function-p
       a-type b-type c-type function)
      (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-member-p a-type x1)
      (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-member-p a-type x2)
      (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-member-p b-type y1)
      (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-member-p b-type y2))
     (implies
      (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-source-equal-p
       a-type x1 x2)
      (implies
       (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-source-equal-p
        b-type y1 y2)
       (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-source-equal-p
        c-type
        (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-apply
         (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-apply function x1)
         y1)
        (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-apply
         (logipedia-logic-eq-f2-apply function x2)
         y2)))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

  x1, x2, and z, w in i encode y1, y2. Thus the final implication is exactly
  logic.eq A x1 x2 -> logic.eq B y1 y2 ->

        A. x e. h
          A. y e. h

                  ->

open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set

pred (suc n) =

  (n : Nat) ->
  zero < n ->
  suc (pred n) == n

;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; nat.eq_leb_body_S, catalog title "nat.eq_leb_body_S": for every natural
;; number, the Boolean less-than-or-equal body at its successor is
;; Leibniz-equal to the function that is false at zero and applies
;; less-than-or-equal to the predecessors at a successor. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Conservative interfaces for the source's Boolean-valued functions.

(defstub logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s-leb
  (left right)
  t)

(defstub logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s
  (left right)
  t)

;; On ACL2 naturals, O is 0 and S is addition by one. This is the source
;; match_nat_type specialized to a Boolean zero case and a LEB successor
;; case.
(defun logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s-successor-case (n m)
  (if (equal m 0)
      nil
    (logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s-leb n (- m 1))))

(defun-sk logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s-leb-typed-p ()
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left)
      (natp right))
     (booleanp
      (logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s-leb left right)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s-typed-p ()
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left)
      (natp right))
     (booleanp
      (logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s left right)))))

;; Leibniz equality of the source functions nat -> bool is extensional
;; equality at every natural argument.
(defun-sk logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s-pointwise-p ()
  (forall (n m)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp m))
     (equal
      (logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s (+ n 1) m)
      (logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s-successor-case n m)))))

(defun logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s-statement ()
  (implies
   (and
    (logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s-leb-typed-p)
    (logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s-typed-p))
   (logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s-pointwise-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact nat.eq_leb_body_S
-- (catalog title "nat.eq_leb_body_S"): for every natural number, the Boolean
-- less-than-or-equal body at its successor is Leibniz-equal to the natural
-- eliminator returning false at zero and less-than-or-equal with the
-- predecessor at each successor. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module eq_leb_body_S where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false)

Leibniz :
  {level : Level} ->
  (A : Set level) ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set (lsuc level)
Leibniz {level} A x y =
  (P : A -> Set level) ->
  P x ->
  P y

module Statement
  (match-nat-type : (A : Set) -> A -> (Nat -> A) -> Nat -> A)
  (leb leb-body : Nat -> Nat -> Bool) where

  eq-leb-body-S : Set₁
  eq-leb-body-S =
    (n : Nat) ->
    Leibniz
      (Nat -> Bool)
      (leb-body (suc n))
      (\ m -> match-nat-type Bool false (\ q -> leb n q) m)

  successor q. This file contains no proof.

$(
  Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
  nat.eq_leb_body_S (logipedia__metamath__nat.eq_leb_body_S), catalog title
  "nat.eq_leb_body_S": for every natural number n, the less-than-or-equal
  Boolean body at successor n is Leibniz equal, as a function from natural
  numbers to Booleans, to the natural-number match function that returns
  false at zero and leb n q at successor q. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  LogLeb and LogLebBody represent the fixed source constants of type

    NN0 -> NN0 -> {0,1}.

  LogMatchNatBool is nat.match_nat_type specialized to the Boolean carrier,
  with source type

    {0,1} -> (NN0 -> {0,1}) -> NN0 -> {0,1}.

  The nested maps-to terms preserve the source lambdas over m and q, and
  n + 1 is the natural-number successor S n. A predicate on the unary-function
  carrier is represented extensionally by a subset p of that carrier.
  Universal transport of membership from leb_body (S n) to the matcher
  function is exactly the source definition of leibniz.leibniz at the
  function type. Every declaration is an unproved $a statement encoding;
  this artifact introduces no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c
  LogLeb LogLebBody LogMatchNatBool
  LogNatBoolUnaryFunction LogNatBoolBinaryFunction LogMatchNatBoolFunction
$.

log-leb-syntax $a class ( LogLeb ) $.
log-leb-body-syntax $a class ( LogLebBody ) $.
log-match-nat-bool-syntax $a class ( LogMatchNatBool ) $.
log-nat-bool-unary-function-syntax $a
  class ( LogNatBoolUnaryFunction )
$.
log-nat-bool-binary-function-syntax $a
  class ( LogNatBoolBinaryFunction )
$.
log-match-nat-bool-function-syntax $a
  class ( LogMatchNatBoolFunction )
$.

log-nat-bool-unary-function-definition $a |-
  ( LogNatBoolUnaryFunction ) = ( { 0 , 1 } ^m NN0 )
$.

log-nat-bool-binary-function-definition $a |-
  ( LogNatBoolBinaryFunction ) =
    ( ( LogNatBoolUnaryFunction ) ^m NN0 )
$.

log-match-nat-bool-function-definition $a |-
  ( LogMatchNatBoolFunction ) =
    (
      (
        ( LogNatBoolUnaryFunction )
        ^m
        ( LogNatBoolUnaryFunction )
      )
      ^m
      { 0 , 1 }
    )
$.

${
  $d m n p q $.

  logipedia-nat-eq-leb-body-s $a |-
    (
      (
        ( LogLeb ) e. ( LogNatBoolBinaryFunction )
        /\
        ( LogLebBody ) e. ( LogNatBoolBinaryFunction )
      )
      /\
      (
        ( LogMatchNatBool ) e. ( LogMatchNatBoolFunction )
        /\
        A. n e. NN0
          (
            (
              m e. NN0 |->
                (
                  (
                    ( LogMatchNatBool ` 0 )
                    `
                    (
                      q e. NN0 |->
                        ( ( LogLeb ` n ) ` q )
                    )
                  )
                  `
                  m
                )
            ) e. ( LogNatBoolUnaryFunction )
            /\
            A. p e. ~P ( LogNatBoolUnaryFunction )
              (
                ( ( LogLebBody ` ( n + 1 ) ) e. p )
                ->
                (
                  (
                    m e. NN0 |->
                      (
                        (
                          ( LogMatchNatBool ` 0 )
                          `
                          (
                            q e. NN0 |->
                              ( ( LogLeb ` n ) ` q )
                          )
                        )
                        `
                        m
                      )
                  )
                  e.
                  p
                )
              )
          )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

  (left right)

;; match_nat_type specialized to its natural-valued zero and successor cases.
(defun logipedia-nat-eq-minus-body-s-successor-case (n m)
  (if (equal m 0)

  (forall (left right)

      (logipedia-nat-eq-minus-body-s-successor-case n m)))))

module eq_times_body_S where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; suc)

Leibniz :
  {level : Level} ->
  (A : Set level) ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set (lsuc level)
Leibniz {level} A x y =
  (P : A -> Set level) ->
  P x ->

module Statement
  (plus times times-body : Nat -> Nat -> Nat) where

  eq-times-body-S : Set₁
  eq-times-body-S =
    (n : Nat) ->
    Leibniz
      (Nat -> Nat)
      (times-body (suc n))

% Statement-only formalization of the Logipedia corpus artifact
% nat.eqb_true_to_eq (catalog title "nat.eqb_true_to_eq"): a true Boolean
% equality test on two natural numbers implies that they are equal. This file
% contains no proof.

nat_eqb_true_to_eq: THEORY
BEGIN

  source_eqb(n, m: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      m = 0
    ELSE
      IF m = 0 THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        source_eqb(n - 1, m - 1)
      ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  eqb_true_to_eq_statement: bool =
    FORALL (n, m: nat):
      source_eqb(n, m) = TRUE IMPLIES n = m

END nat_eqb_true_to_eq

-- Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact "nat.sym_eq_eqb"
-- (catalog title "nat.sym_eq_eqb"): at every natural argument, the naturally
-- filtered body of the recursive Boolean equality test is Leibniz-equal to
-- the corresponding partially applied equality test. This file contains no proof.

namespace nat

def Leibniz (A : Type) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : A → Prop, P x → P y

def filterNatType (R : Type) (f : Nat → R) (n : Nat) : R :=
  f n

def eqb : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, 0 => true
  | 0, Nat.succ _ => false
  | Nat.succ _, 0 => false
  | Nat.succ n, Nat.succ m => eqb n m

def eqbBody : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, 0 => true
  | 0, Nat.succ _ => false
  | Nat.succ _, 0 => false
  | Nat.succ n, Nat.succ m => eqb n m

theorem sym_eq_eqb :
    ∀ n : Nat,
      Leibniz (Nat → Bool)
        (filterNatType (Nat → Bool) eqbBody n)
        (eqb n) := sorry

end nat

  nat.sym_eq_eqb (logipedia__metamath__nat.sym_eq_eqb), catalog title
  "nat.sym_eq_eqb": for every natural number, filter_nat_type applied to
  eqb_body at that number is Leibniz equal to eqb at the same number, as
  functions from naturals to Booleans. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  LogEqb and LogEqbBody represent the fixed source constants of type

    NN0 -> NN0 -> {0,1}.

  LogFilterNatTypeNatBool represents nat.filter_nat_type specialized to
  results of type NN0 -> {0,1}, with type

    (NN0 -> NN0 -> {0,1}) -> NN0 -> NN0 -> {0,1}.

  LogNatBoolUnaryFunction and LogNatBoolBinaryFunction explicitly encode
  those curried function spaces. A predicate on the unary-function carrier
  is represented extensionally by a subset p of that carrier. Universal
  transport of membership from the filtered eqb_body value to eqb n is
  exactly the source definition of leibniz.leibniz at the function type.
  Every declaration introduced by this artifact is an unproved $a statement
  encoding; this artifact adds no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c
  LogEqb LogEqbBody LogFilterNatTypeNatBool
  LogNatBoolUnaryFunction LogNatBoolBinaryFunction
$.

log-eqb-syntax $a class ( LogEqb ) $.
log-eqb-body-syntax $a class ( LogEqbBody ) $.
log-filter-nat-type-nat-bool-syntax $a
  class ( LogFilterNatTypeNatBool )
$.
log-nat-bool-unary-function-syntax $a
  class ( LogNatBoolUnaryFunction )
$.
log-nat-bool-binary-function-syntax $a
  class ( LogNatBoolBinaryFunction )
$.

log-nat-bool-unary-function-definition $a |-
  ( LogNatBoolUnaryFunction ) = ( { 0 , 1 } ^m NN0 )
$.

log-nat-bool-binary-function-definition $a |-
  ( LogNatBoolBinaryFunction ) =
    ( ( LogNatBoolUnaryFunction ) ^m NN0 )
$.

${
  $d n p $.

  logipedia-nat-sym-eq-eqb $a |-
    (
      (
        ( LogEqb ) e. ( LogNatBoolBinaryFunction )
        /\
        ( LogEqbBody ) e. ( LogNatBoolBinaryFunction )
      )
      /\
      (
        ( LogFilterNatTypeNatBool ) e.
          (
            ( LogNatBoolBinaryFunction )
            ^m
            ( LogNatBoolBinaryFunction )
          )
        /\
        A. n e. NN0
          A. p e. ~P ( LogNatBoolUnaryFunction )
            (
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( LogFilterNatTypeNatBool )
                    `
                    ( LogEqbBody )
                  )
                  `
                  n
                )
                e.
                p
              )
              ->
              ( ( ( LogEqb ) ` n ) e. p )
            )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

-- Leibniz equality relates the recursive Boolean equality-test step at a
-- successor to the fixed equality-test body at that successor. This file
-- contains no proof.

namespace nat

def Leibniz (A : Type) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : A → Prop, P x → P y

def matchNatType (R : Type) (caseO : R) (caseS : Nat → R) : Nat → R
  | 0 => caseO
  | Nat.succ n => caseS n

def eqb : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, m => matchNatType Bool true (fun _q ↦ false) m
  | Nat.succ n, m => matchNatType Bool false (fun q ↦ eqb n q) m

def eqbBody : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, m => matchNatType Bool true (fun _q ↦ false) m
  | Nat.succ n, m => matchNatType Bool false (fun q ↦ eqb n q) m

theorem sym_eq_eqb_body_S :
    ∀ n : Nat,
      Leibniz (Nat → Bool)
        (fun m ↦ matchNatType Bool false (fun q ↦ eqb n q) m)
        (eqbBody (Nat.succ n)) := sorry

end nat

  catalog title "nat.sym_eq_eqb_body_S": for every natural number n, the
  natural-number match function returning false at zero and eqb n q at
  successor q is Leibniz equal, as a function from natural numbers to
  Booleans, to eqb_body at successor n. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  NN0 is SetMM's natural-number carrier, and {0,1} is the Boolean carrier,
  with false represented by 0 and true by 1. The definitions below render
  nat.eqb and nat.eqb_body as the Boolean characteristic function of equality.
  They render nat.match_nat_type on Booleans by selecting the zero branch at
  zero and applying the successor branch to the predecessor otherwise.

  For any set p, membership in p is a predicate; conversely, every predicate
  on the source function type is represented extensionally by its set of
  satisfying functions. Thus the final assertion is exactly the source
  Leibniz-equality universal transport

    forall p, p matcher_function -> p (eqb_body (S n)),

  with no typing facts conjoined to the conclusion. The definitions and final
  $a declaration are unproved statement encodings; this file has no $p proof
  declaration.
$)

$c LogEqb LogEqbBody LogMatchNatBool $.

log-eqb-syntax $a class ( LogEqb ) $.
log-eqb-body-syntax $a class ( LogEqbBody ) $.
log-match-nat-bool-syntax $a class ( LogMatchNatBool ) $.

${
  $d f m n p q x $.

  log-eqb-definition $a |-
    ( LogEqb ) =
      (
        n e. NN0 |->
          (
            q e. NN0 |->
              if ( n = q , 1 , 0 )
          )
      )
  $.

  log-eqb-body-definition $a |-
    ( LogEqbBody ) =
      (
        n e. NN0 |->
          (
            m e. NN0 |->
              if ( n = m , 1 , 0 )
          )
      )
  $.

  log-match-nat-bool-definition $a |-
    ( LogMatchNatBool ) =
      (
        x e. { 0 , 1 } |->
          (
            f e. ( { 0 , 1 } ^m NN0 ) |->
              (
                m e. NN0 |->
                  if ( m = 0 , x , ( f ` ( m - 1 ) ) )
              )
          )
      )
  $.

  logipedia-nat-sym-eq-eqb-body-s $a |-
    A. n e. NN0
      A. p
        (
          (
            (
              m e. NN0 |->
                (
                  (
                    ( LogMatchNatBool ` 0 )
                    `
                    (
                      q e. NN0 |->
                        ( ( LogEqb ` n ) ` q )
                    )
                  )
                  `
                  m
                )
            )
            e.
            p
          )
          ->
          ( ( LogEqbBody ` ( n + 1 ) ) e. p )
        )
  $.
$}

;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; nat.sym_eq_minus_body_S, catalog title "nat.sym_eq_minus_body_S": for every
;; natural number, the function that returns its successor at zero and
;; subtracts the predecessor at successor inputs is Leibniz-equal to the
;; subtraction body at that successor. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; MINUS-BODY-AT reifies the curried source constant
;; minus_body : nat -> (nat -> nat). GENERIC-APPLICATION conservatively
;; supplies application for function objects not constructed in this file.

(defstub logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-minus
  (left right)
  t)

(defstub logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-minus-body-at
  (n)
  t)

(defstub logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-generic-application
  (function-object argument)
  t)

;; This reified value is exactly the source lambda
;; fun m => match_nat_type nat (S n) (fun q => minus n q) m.

(defun logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-successor-function (n)
  (list 'logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-successor-function n))

(defun logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-successor-function-p
    (function-object)
  (and
   (consp function-object)
   (equal
    (car function-object)
    'logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-successor-function)
   (consp (cdr function-object))
   (natp (cadr function-object))
   (equal (cddr function-object) nil)))

(defun logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-application
    (function-object argument)
  (if
      (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-successor-function-p
       function-object)
      (let ((n (cadr function-object)))
        (if (equal argument 0)
            (+ n 1)
          (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-minus
           n (- argument 1))))
    (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-generic-application
     function-object argument)))

(defun-sk logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-minus-typed-p ()
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left)
      (natp right))
     (natp
      (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-minus left right)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-natural-function-p
    (function-object)
  (forall (m)
    (implies
     (natp m)
     (natp
      (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-application
       function-object m)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-minus-body-typed-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-natural-function-p
      (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-minus-body-at n)))))

;; Leibniz equality, forall P, P(x) -> P(y), is equivalent to identity.
;; ACL2 object identity therefore represents equality at the complete source
;; function type without adding a function-extensionality assumption.

(defun-sk logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-equality-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (equal
      (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-successor-function n)
      (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-minus-body-at (+ n 1))))))

(defun logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-statement ()
  (implies
   (and
    (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-minus-typed-p)
    (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-minus-body-typed-p))
   (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-minus-body-s-equality-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- every natural number, the natural-number matching function built from its
-- successor and subtraction by the original number is Leibniz-equal to the
-- subtraction body at that successor. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module sym_eq_minus_body_S where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; suc)

  {level : Level} ->
  (A : Set level) ->
  A ->
  A ->

  (P : A -> Set level) ->

  (minus minus-body : Nat -> Nat -> Nat) where

  sym-eq-minus-body-S : Set₁

    (n : Nat) ->
    Leibniz
      (Nat -> Nat)
      (\ m -> match-nat-type Nat (suc n) (\ q -> minus n q) m)
      (minus-body (suc n))

def Leibniz (A : Type) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : A → Prop, P x → P y

def filterNatType (R : Type) (f : Nat → R) (n : Nat) : R :=

  | 0, m => m

-- at a natural number to the multiplication body at its successor.

def Leibniz (A : Type) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  forall P : A -> Prop, P x -> P y

Definition logipedia_leibniz (A : Type) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  forall P : A -> Prop, P x -> P y.

Definition logipedia_times_body (n : nat) : nat -> nat :=
  match n with
  | O => fun _ : nat => O
  | S k => fun m : nat => Nat.add m (Nat.mul k m)

    logipedia_leibniz

      (logipedia_times_body (S n)).

;; Statement-only formalization of Logipedia corpus artifact
;; nat.sym_eq_times_body_S, catalog title "nat.sym_eq_times_body_S": for every
;; natural number n, the function mapping m to plus m (times n m) is
;; Leibniz-equal at the unary natural-number function type to the
;; multiplication body at the successor of n. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; TIMES-BODY-AT reifies the curried source constant
;; times_body : nat -> (nat -> nat). Function values remain unrestricted ACL2
;; objects, with GENERIC-APPLICATION supplying application outside the lambda
;; family defined below.

(defstub logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-plus
  (left right)
  t)

(defstub logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-times
  (left right)
  t)

(defstub logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-times-body-at
  (n)
  t)

(defstub logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-generic-application
  (function-object argument)
  t)

;; This tagged value reifies the source lambda
;; fun m : nat => plus m (times n m), retaining its captured natural n.

(defun logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-plus-times-function (n)
  (list :logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-plus-times-function n))

(defun logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-application
    (function-object argument)
  (if
      (and
       (true-listp function-object)
       (equal (len function-object) 2)
       (equal
        (car function-object)
        :logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-plus-times-function))
      (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-plus
       argument
       (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-times
        (cadr function-object)
        argument))
    (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-generic-application
     function-object argument)))

(defun-sk logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-plus-typed-p ()
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left)
      (natp right))
     (natp
      (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-plus left right)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-times-typed-p ()
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left)
      (natp right))
     (natp
      (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-times left right)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-natural-function-p
    (function-object)
  (forall (m)
    (implies
     (natp m)
     (natp
      (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-application
       function-object m)))))

(defun-sk logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-times-body-typed-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-natural-function-p
      (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-times-body-at n)))))

;; ACL2 object identity directly represents Leibniz equality at the complete
;; source function type nat -> nat.

(defun-sk logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-leibniz-p ()
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (equal
      (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-plus-times-function n)
      (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-times-body-at (+ n 1))))))

(defun logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-statement ()
  (implies
   (and
    (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-plus-typed-p)
    (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-times-typed-p)
    (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-times-body-typed-p))
   (logipedia-nat-sym-eq-times-body-s-leibniz-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)

  A ->

      (Nat -> Nat)

;; permutation.axiom_invert_permut, catalog title

;; reified by tokens with total natural-valued application operations.

  (function natural)

(defun logipedia-permutation-invert-function-at
    (function natural)

    function natural)))

(defstub logipedia-permutation-invert-raw-higher-apply
  (value function natural)
  t)

(defun logipedia-permutation-invert-higher-apply
    (value function natural)
  (nfix
   (logipedia-permutation-invert-raw-higher-apply
    value function natural)))

(defun logipedia-permutation-invert-permut-value (index)
  (list 'logipedia-invert-permut index))

(defun logipedia-permutation-invert-permut-body-value (index)
  (list 'logipedia-invert-permut-body index))

(defun logipedia-permutation-filtered-invert-permut-body-value
    (index)

;; action on a reified natural-to-natural function and a natural argument.

    (index function natural)

   (logipedia-permutation-invert-permut-value index)
   function natural))

    (index function natural)

   (logipedia-permutation-invert-permut-body-value index)
   function natural))

    (index function natural)

   function natural))

;; predicate on the fixed higher-order value type.

  (left right)

  (predicate value)

;; source's abstract equality relates the permutation-inversion body to the

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Natural functions and higher-order values are reified by unrestricted
;; tokens with total natural-valued application operations.

(defstub logipedia-permutation-invert-body-s-raw-function-at
  (function natural)
  t)

(defun logipedia-permutation-invert-body-s-function-at
    (function natural)
  (nfix

    function natural)))

  (index function natural)

  (index function natural)

(defun logipedia-permutation-invert-body-s-invert-at
    (index function natural)
  (nfix
   (logipedia-permutation-invert-body-s-raw-invert-at
    index function natural)))

(defstub logipedia-permutation-invert-body-s-raw-higher-apply
  (value function natural)
  t)
